Mishneh Torah, Testimony 12:
Kol hannifsal baavera im heidu alav shene edim sheasa avera pelonit af al pi shello hitru bo shehare eno loke hare ze pasul leedut. bamme devarim amurim kesheavar al devarim sheppashat beyisrael shehen avera. kegon shennishba lashsheker o lashshav o gazal o ganav o achal nevela vechayyotze bo. aval im rauhu edim over al davar shekkarov haose lihyot shogeg tzerichin lehazehiro veachar kach yippasel. ketzad. rauhu kosher o mattir beshabbat tzerichin lehodio shezze chillul shabbat mippene sherov haam enan yodin ze. vechen im rauhu ose melacha beshabbat o bayyom tov tzerichin lehodio shehayyom shabbat shemma shocheach hu. vechen hamesachek bekubbiyya tamid o mi shennaasa moches o gabbay shemmosif leatzmo tzerichin haedim lehodio shehaose davar ze pasul leedut. sherov haam enan yodim devarim ellu. vechen kol kayyotze baze. kelalo shel davar kol avera shehaddevarim marim laedim shezze yada shehu rasha veavar bezadon af al pi shello hitru bo hare ze pasul leedut veeno loke: 
En adam nifsal baavera al pi atzmo. ketzad. hare shebba levet din veamar shegganav o gazal o hilva beribbit. af al pi shemmeshallem al pi atzmo eno nifsal. vechen im amar sheachal nevela o baal asura eno nifsal ad sheyyihyu sham shene edim sheen adam mesim et atzmo rasha. lefichach reuven sheheid alav shimon shehilva beribbit veheid levi veamar li hilva beribbit. hare reuven nifsal beedut shimon velevi af al pi shehare hoda levi shellava beribbit eno mesim atzmo rasha veneeman al reuven veeno neeman al atzmo. vechen mi sheheid sheppeloni revao ben beanso shel nirba ben birtzono hu veacher mitztarfin lehargo. peloni ba al ishti hu veacher mitztarfin lehargo aval lo lehargah. vechen kol kayyotze baze. peloni rava et shori hu veacher mitztarfin lehargo sheen adam karov etzel mamono: 
Shenayim sheheidu al echad shehu pasul baavera meellu haaverot uvau shenayim veheidu sheasa teshuva vechazar bo o shellaka hare ze kasher. aval im bau shenayim vehichchishum veamru lo asa avera zo velo nifsal hare ze safek pasul. lefichach lo yaid veen motziin mamon beeduto velo yadun ad sheyyivvada sheasa teshuva: 
Kol mi shennitchayyev malkot ben sheasa teshuva ben shellaka bevet din chozer lechashruto. aval shear pesule edut shehen pesulin mishshum mamon shechamsu o sheggazlu af al pi sheshshillemu tzerichin teshuva vahare hen pesulin ad sheyyivvada shechazru bahen middarkan hara: 
Meematay chazarat malvim beribbit mishsheyyikreu shitrotehen meatzman. veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura shello yalvu beribbit afillu leakkum: 
Meematay chazarat hamesachakin bekubbiyya mishsheyyishberu et pasifsehem. veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura shello yaasu afillu bechinnam: 
Meematay chazarat mafriche yonim mishsheyyishberu et hakkelim shetztzadin bahen. veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura sheafillu bammidbar lo yaasu: 
Meematay chazarat sochare sheviit mishshettaggia sheviit veyibbadku. velo chazarat devarim bilvad ella kotev ani peloni ben peloni kanasti matayim zuz mipperot sheviit vahare hem netunim bemattana laaniyyim: 
Meematay chazarat hammoel bishvua mishsheyyavo levet din sheen makkirin oto veyomar lahem chashud ani o yitchayyev shevua bevet din sheen makkirin oto bemamon chashuv yeshallem velo yirtze lehishshava. vechen tabbach shehaya bodek leatzmo umocher veyatzat terefa mittachat yado shehare hu bichlal ochle terefa shehen pesulin leedut. hare ze pasul leedut ad sheyyerae mimmaasav shennicham al raato. veyilbash shechorim vichasse shechorim veyelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto veyachzir aveda bemamon chashuv. o yotzi terefa mittachat yado bedavar chashuv: 
Vechen ed zomem shehalach lemakom sheen makkirin oto venatnu lo mamon chashuv lehaid besheker velo ratza hare ze asa teshuva vechazar lechashruto. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 13:
Hakkerovim pesulim leedut min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 16)</small> "lo yumetu avot al banim". mippi hashshemua lamdu shebbichlal lav ze shello yumetu avot al pi banim velo banim al pi avot. vehu haddin lishar kerovim. en pesulin middin tora ella kerovim mimmishpachat av bilvad. vehem haav im habben veim ben habben. vehaachin min haav ze im ze uvenehen ze im ze veen tzarich lomar haddodim im ben achiv. aval shear hakkerovim min haem o midderech haishut kullan pesulin middivrehem: 
Haggerim enan bedin hakkerovim. afillu shene achim teomim shennitgayyeru meidin ze laze. shehagger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad hu chashuv: 
Haachim ze im ze ben min haem ben min haav hare hen rishon berishon. uvenehem ze im ze sheni besheni. uvene benehem ze im ze shelishi bishlishi: 
Uleolam shelishi berishon kasher veen tzarich lomar shelishi besheni. aval sheni besheni veen tzarich lomar sheni berishon shenehem pesulim: 
Haav im beno kerishon berishon hu. lefichach haav im ben beno pasul. veim ben ben beno shehu revii mimmennu kasher mippene shehu shelishi berishon. vechen hadderech binkevot. ketzad. shete achayot o ach vaachoto ben min haav ben min haem hare hem rishon berishon. benehem ben zecharim ben nekevot sheni besheni. bene benehem o benot benotehen shelishi bishlishi. kederech sheatta mone bizcharim rishon sheni ushelishi kach atta mone binkevot: 
Kol ishsha sheatta pasul lah kach atta pasul levalah shehabbaal keishto. vechol baal sheatta pasul lo kach atta pasul leishto shehaishsha kevalah: 
Kol shete nashim shehen zo im zo sheni besheni balehen meidin ze laze. aval im haya rishon berishon kegon shellakach ze ishsha veze bittah en meidin ze laze: 
Vechen bale achayot pesulin ze laze vahare hen rishon berishon: 
Vechen lo yaid leven achot ishto velo levaal bat achot ishto. aval meid hu leven baal achot ishto sheyyesh lo meishsha acheret: 
Kol ish sheen atta meid lo mippene shehu baal kerovatcha hare atta meid lishar kerovav kegon beno veachiv. vechen kol ishsha sheen atta meid lah mippene shehi eshet kerovcha hare atta meid lishar keroveha: 
Avi kalla vaavi chatan meidim ze laze: 
Ache haach min haem meidin ze laze shehare en benehen kurva kelal. ketzad. rachel shennisset leyosef veyalda mimmenna reuven. vehaya leyosef ben meishsha acheret vehu menashshe. umet yosef venisset leshimon veyalda mimmennu yehuda. hare menashshe vihuda meidin ze laze: 
Haish im ishto rishon berishon. lefichach eno meid lo livnah. velo leeshet benah. velo levittah. velo levaal bittah. velo leaviha. velo leimmah. velo levaal immah. velo leeshet aviha: 
Ishto arusa af al pi shello nigmera haishut hare hi kinsua leinyan edut. [bamme devarim amurim] baarusato atzmah sheeno meid lah. aval im heid likrove arusato kegon baal achotah o benah uvittah vechayyotze bahen en poslin otah ad sheyyissaenna: 
Ze sheppasla tora edut hakkerovim lo mippene shehen bechezkat ohavin ze et ze. shehare eno meid lo lo letovato velo leraato. ella gezerat hakkatuv hu. lefichach haohev vehassone kasher leedut af al pi shehu pasul ledayyanut. shello gazra tora ella al hakkerovim:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 14: Kol mi sheen atta meoyd lo mippene shehu baal kerovatcha. im meta ishto af al pi shehinnicha lo banim hare ze nitrachek vechasher:

Mi shehaya yodea lachavero edut ad shello naasa chatano venaasa chatano. o sheyyada haedut vehu pikkeach veachar kach nitcharesh. patuach venistamme af al pi sheyyachol lechavven middat hakkarka shehu meid bah umesayyem metzareha. shafuy venishtatta. hare ze pasul. aval im haya yodea lo edut ad shello naasa chatano venaasa chatano umeta bitto. pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach kasher. ze hakkelal kol shettechillato vesofo bechashrut af al pi shennifsal bentayim kasher. techillato befaslut af al pi shessofo bechashrut pasul. lefichach mi shehaya yodea beedut vehu katan uva veheid bah keshehu gadol enah kelum:

Veyesh devarim shessomchin bahen al edut shemmeid keshehu gadol hoil vehem devarim shel divrehem. veellu hen haddevarim sheadam neeman lehaid begadlo al ma sheraa bekatno. neeman adam lomar ze ketav yado shel avi o shel rabbi o shel achi mippene shekkiyyum shetarot middivrehem. zachur ani biflonit shennisset venaasa lah minhag habbetulot. hoil verov nashim betulot nissaot uchetubba middivrehem. shehammakom hazze bet happeras mippene shettumato middivrehem. vead kan hayinu bain beshabbat shetztzimtzum hattechum ad alpayim amma bilvad middivrehem. shehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer litbol veleechol bitrumato laerev. veshehaya cholek immanu teruma. veshehayinu molichim challa umattanot lifloni kohen al yede atzmo. veamar li abba mishpacha zo keshera mishpacha zo pesula. veachalnu bakotzatza shel peloni sheheechiluni echav kede lehodia sheachihem peloni nasa ishsha sheenah hogenet lo. shekkol ellu haddevarim lehachazik ze hakkohen leechol bitruma shel divrehem o lidchoto mimmenna:
Kol ellu shemmeid bahen haggadol bema sheyyada keshehaya katan. im haya akkum o eved kesheraa devarim ellu veheid achar shennitgayyer venishtachrer eno neeman:

Mi shehaya yodea lachavero beedut ad shello naasa gazlan venaasa gazlan. hu eno meid al ketav yado. aval im huchzak ketav yado shebbishtar ze bevet din kodem sheyyease gazlan hare ze shetar kasher. vechen im naasa chatano hu eno meid al ketav yado aval acherim meidin. af al pi shello huchzak bevet din ella achar shennaasa chatano hare ze kasher. sheeno dome happasul baavera lefasul bikriva. shehappasul baavera chashud lezayyef:

Shetar sheyyesh bo shene edim bilvad ushenehem kerovim ze laze o echad mishshenehem pasul baavera. af al pi shemmasar lo hashshetar bifne edim kesherim hare hu kecheres mippene shehu mezuyyaf mittocho:

Hakkotev kol nechasav lishne bene adam beedut achat vehaedim kerovim leechad mimmekabbele hammattana urechokim min hashsheni. hare hashshetar pasul mippene shehu edut achat. aval im katav bishtar echad shennatatti liruven chatzer pelonit veshennatatti leshimon sade pelonit. nimtzeu haedim kerovim laze urechokim mizze. ze shehem rechokim mimmennu mattenato kayyemet sheellu shete eduyot af al pi shehen bishtar echad. lema ze dome leomer heyu alay edim shennatatti liruven kach vechach veshennatatti leshimon kach vechach veshellaviti millevi kach vechach sheaf al pi shekkatav bishtar echad vehammakne ish echad hare ellu shalosh eduyyot sheenan teluyot zo bazo:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 15:
Kol edut shettavo hanaa leadam mimmenna eno meid bah shezze hu kemeid al atzmo. lefichach bene hair shebba mearer learer alehem bammerchatz o birchov shel ir. en echad mibbaale hair meid bedavar ze velo dan ad sheyyesallek atzmo bekinyan gamur veachar kach yaid o yadin: 
Bene hair shennignav sefer tora shellahen hoil velishmia hu asuy shei efshar leadam lesallek atzmo mimmennu en danin bedayyane otah hair veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haomer tenu mane laaniyye iri en danin bedayyane otah hair veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu haaniyyim semuchim alehem ufoskin alehen tzedaka. afillu amru shenayim meanshe otah hair anu nitten davar hakkatzuv alenu venaid en shomin lahem. shehanaa hu lahem sheyyitashsheru aniyyim ellu hoil vehen semuchin al bene hair. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Karka shebben shene shuttafin shebba mearer lehotziah mittachat yad hashuttaf. eno meid leshuttafo aleha ella im sillek atzmo mimmenna vekanu miyyado shennetanah lashshuttaf vesheim ba baal chov shello uterafah miyyad hashuttaf meshallem lo dameha. veachar kach meid lo aleha. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haorer al hassade im yesh bah perot en haaris meid lo aleha. shehare rotze haaris lehaamidah beyad bealeha kede sheyyittol chelko bapperot. veim en bah perot meid. aval hassocher im lakach hassechirut beyado veamar kol mi shettitkayyem sade zo beyado yittol hare ze meid. veim kevar natan hassechirut levaal hassade eno meid. kevan sheim tetze hassade lamarer chayyav litten lo sechar kol hashshanim sheyyashav bah eno meid. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shimon shellava vehaya reuven arev uva yehuda learer al shimon hallo vehotzi karka mittachat yado. im yesh leshimon sade acheret keneged hachov hare reuven hearev yesh lo lehaid al oto karka shehi shel shimon. sheen lo hanaa baze sheim lekachah yehuda hare sade acheret sheyyippara mimmenna baal chovo. vechen lokeach rishon meid lelokeach sheni shellakach acharav shezze hassade shello. vehu sheyyesh lammocher sade ben chorin keneged deme sade shel lokeach rishon. sheen lelokeach rishon hanaa baamidat ze hassade beyad lokeach sheni. sheafillu nitraf lokeach harishon al hammocher hu chozer vahare yesh lo sade acheret sheyyigbe mimmenna:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 16: Reuven sheggazal sade o tallit mishshimon uva yehuda veirer al reuven veamar sade zo o tallit zo shelli hi. en shimon yachol lehaid liruven sheen zo hassade shel yehuda velo zo hattallit shel yehuda. shehare shimon rotze lehaamid sade zo o tallit zo beyad reuven shehu gezalah mimmennu kede sheyyachzeru lo miyyad haggazlan. shehare efshar shettihye haraya shel shimon shemmotzi bah miyyad reuven efshar sheeno yachol lehotzi bah miyyad yehuda. vechen im machar reuven hassade haggezula o horishah lelevi uva yehuda learer al levi. en shimon meid sheenah shel yehuda shemma nachat ruach yesh lo lehotziah miyyad levi:

Machar hattallit haggezula lelevi uva yehuda learer. im met reuven shimon meid aleha sheenah shel yehuda shehare en tallit zo chozeret leshimon leolam shekkevar kenaah hallokeach beyeush veshinnuy reshut uchevar met reuven haggazlan veen lo mimmi yittol dameha. aval im adayin reuven kayyam en shimon meid af al hattallit. shehanaa hi lo shello taamod beyad yehuda kede sheyyavi reaya sheruven gezalah vishallem dameha. vechen im hayta hattallit beyad yorshe reuven en shimon meid aleha mippene shessofah sheim taamod beyad hayyoresh lachzor lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beacharayut uva yehuda learer al shimon ulehotziah mittachat yado. en reuven meid lo aleha. af al pi sheen aleha acharayut hare hu rotze shettaamod beyad shimon kede sheyyavo baal chov shel reuven veyitrefenna bechovo velo yihye lo rasha velo yeshallem:

Reuven shemmachar para o tallit leshimon uva yehuda learer ulehotzi miyyad shimon. reuven meid lo aleha shehi shel shimon sheafillu amda beyad shimon en baal chovo shel reuven toref min hammittaltelin vaafillu hayu appoteke. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya shimon mode shezzo happara vehattallit hem shel reuven hammocher bevadday vehu yodea shebbeemet hen shello. aval im lo hoda shimon en reuven meid leabbed zechut yehuda. sheim tetze mittachat yede shimon yachzor shimon veyitba damim veyomar lo macharta li davar sheeno shellecha shehare bau edim veamru shehen shel yehuda. bamme devarim amurim sheyyaid reuven leabbed zechut yehuda veyaamid hammittaltelin beyad shimon keshebbau edim veheidu shehem yodim sheruven ze lo hayta lo karka meolam. aval im lo bau edim lechach af al happara vehattallit eno meid. velamma eno meid alehen. shemma hikna otam levaal chovo aggav karka vechatav deikne vehikna lo mittaltelin aggav karka shennimtza baal chovo toref af happara vehattallit. lefichach lo yaid alehen shehare rotze lehaamidan beyad shimon kede sheyyavo baal chovo veyitrefem. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu. udevarim ellu enan teluyin ella bedaat haddayyan veotzem binato sheyyavin ikkar hammishpatim veyeda davar haggorem ledavar acher veyaamik lirot. im yimmatze sheyyesh leze haed tzad hanaa beedut zo afillu bederech rechoka veniflaa hare ze lo yaid bah. uchederech shello yaid bedavar ze shemma nogea beeduto hu kach lo yadun beoto davar. vechen shear mine pesulin keshem shepposlin beedim kach poslin bedayyanim:

Ulefichach en somchin besanhedrin shenayim hakkerovim ze laze ben besanhedri ketanna ben besanhedri gedola. aval ellu shemmosifin ad shiva leabber hashshana kemo shebbearnu behilchot kiddush hachodesh yerae li sheim haya bahen kerovim en bechach kelum:

Kol hakkasher ladun kasher lehaid. veyesh kasher lehaid veeno kasher ladun. haohev. vehassone. vehagger. vehameshuchrar. vechen hazzaken. vehassaris. vehammamzer. vesuma beachat meenav. kesherin lehaid veenan kesherim ladun dine nefashot kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 17: Mi sheheidu lo anashim rabbim ugedolim bechachma uveyira shehem omrim sherau peloni sheavar avera pelonit. o shellava mippeloni. af al pi shehu maamin haddavar belibbo keillu raahu lo yaid ad sheyyire haddavar beenav o yode lo hallo mippiv veyomar lo heye alay ed sheppeloni hilva li mane. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "vehu ed o raa o yada". veen lecha edut shemmitkayyemet biriyya o bidia ella edut mamon. vechol hammeid mippi acherim hare ze ed sheker veover belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 13)</small> "lo taane vereacha ed shaker":

Lefichach meayyemin af al ede hammamon. vechetzad meayyemin alehen. [meayyemin alehem] bifne hakkol. umodiin otan koach edut sheker uvoshet hammeid bah baolam hazze uvaolam habba. veachar kach motziin et kol haadam lachutz umeshayyerin et haggadol shebbaedim veomer lo emor heach atta yodea shezze chayyav laze. im amar shehu amar li chayyav ani lo o ish peloni amar li shehu chayyav lo lo amar kelum ad sheyyomar befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyav lo. vehayu machnisin et haed hashsheni uvodkin oto kach. nimtzeu divrehen mechuvvanin nosin venotnin baddavar vegomrin haddin:

Hammatmin edim lachavero vehoda lo beno leven atzmo vehaedim roin veshomin shehu omer lo vadday yesh lecha etzli kach vechach aval mityare ani shemma techufeni bedin lemachar hare zo enah edut ad sheyyode bifne edim:

Echad hammode bifne edim. veamar derech hodaa ze yesh lo etzli kach vechach. o sheamar attem eday o sheamar heyu alay edim. ben sheamar hallo ben sheamar hammalve veshatak hallo derech maamin lidvarav. hare ellu edim. veen tzarich lomar im kanu miyyado o sheamar lahem kitvu alay shetar sheyyesh laze etzli kach vechach vechol kayyotze bidvarim ellu hare hem hodaa umeidin al piv:
Talmid sheamar lo rabbo yodea atta sheim notnin li kol mamon haolam eni meshakker mane yesh li etzel peloni veyesh li alav ed echad lech vehitztaref immo. im nitztaref hare ze ed sheker:

Amar lo bo vaamod im haed velo taid kede sheyyire hallo vifached veyaale al dato sheattem shene edim veyode meatzmo hare ze asur laamod uleharot shehu ed af al pi sheeno meid. veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak":
Hassocher ede sheker lehaid lachavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. vechen ed echad shekkavash eduto velo heid patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 18:
Mi sheheid besheker venoda beedim sheheid besheker zehu shennikra ed zomem. umitzvat ase laasot lo kema sheratza laasot beeduto lachavero. im baavera shechayyavin aleha sekila heidu vehuzemu niskalin kullan. veim bisrefa nisrafin vechen shear hammitot. veim heidu bemalkot loke kol echad mehen kishar mechuyyeve malkot. veomdin kocho umalkin oto. veim heidu lechayyevo mamon meshalleshin hammamon benehen lefi minyan haedim. kol echad veechad yitten chelek hammaggia lo. veen lokin bimkom tashlumin: 
Bamme devarim amurim beedim shehuzemu. aval shete kittot hammachchishot zo et zo veen kan edut en onshin et achat mehen. lefi sheen anu yodim mi hi hakkat hashshakranit. uma ben hachechasha lahazama. hahachchasha baedut atzmah zot omeret haya haddavar hazze vezot omeret lo haya haddavar hazze o yavo mikkelal devareha shello haya. vehahazama baedim atzman veellu haedim shehezimum enan yodim im nihya haddavar o lo haya. ketzad. edim shebbau veamru rainu ze sheharag et hannefesh o lava mane mippeloni beyom peloni bemakom peloni. veachar sheheidu venivdeku bau shenayim acherim veamru beyom ze uvemakom ze hayinu immachem veim ellu kol hayyom. velo hayu devarim meolam lo ze harag et ze velo ze hilva et ze hare zo hachechasha. vechen im amru lahem heach attem meidim kach veze hahoreg o hanneherag o hallo o hammalve haya immanu beyom ze bimdina acheret. hare zo edut muchcheshet shezze kemi sheamar lo harag ze et ze velo ze hilva et ze shehare immanu hayu velo nihya davar ze. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu. aval im amru lahem anu en anu yodim im ze harag ze beyom ze birushalayim kemo sheattem omrin o lo harago. veanu meidim sheattem atzmechem heyitem immanu beyom ze bevavel. hare ellu zommim veneheragin o meshallemin. hoil vehaedim shehezimum lo hishgichu al atzmah shel edut kelal im emet haya o sheker: 
Veze sheheemina tora edut haacharonim al haedim harishonim gezerat hakkatuv hi. afillu hayu haedim harishonim mea uvau shenayim vehezimum veamru lahem anu meidim sheattem hammea kullechem immanu heyitem beyom peloni bemakom peloni hare ellu neenashin al pihem. shehashshenayim kemea umea kishnayim. vechen bishte kitte edim hammachchishot zo et zo en holchin achar harov ella dochin et shetehen: 
Edim zommin enan tzerichin hateraa. veedim shehuchchashu ulevassof huzammu hare ellu neheragin o lokin o meshallemin mippene shehachechasha techillat hazama hi ella sheadayin lo nigmera: 
En mezimin et haedim ella bifnehem. umachchishin et haedim shello bifnehem. veedim shehuzammu shello bifnehen hare huchchashu. lefichach im metu haedim shehezimum kodem sheyyazimu otam bifnehem en kan edut shehare hichchishu ze et ze: 
Ede nefashot shehuchchashu velo huzammu afillu ba hanneherag beraglav enam lokin. mippene shehu lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din veen lokin alav. aval bet din makkin otan makkat mardut kefi ma sheyyiru: 
Edim zommim tzerichin hacheraza. veheach hi hahachraza shellahen. kotvin vesholchin bechol ir veir peloni ufeloni heidu bechach vechach vehuzammu vaharagnum. o laku befanenu o anashnu otan kach vechach dinarin. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 20)</small> "vehannisharim yishmeu veyirau": 
Chiyyuv haedim zommim leshallem bemakom shechayyavin leshallem kenas hu ulefichach en meshallemin al pi atzman. ketzad. hare sheheidu venechkera edutan bevet din veachar kach amru shenehem edut sheker headnu veen laze etzel ze kelum. o sheamarnu headnu al ze bechach vechach vehuzamnu en meshallemin al pihen. aval im amru headnu al ze vehuzamnu bevet dino shel peloni venitchayyavnu litten lo kach vechach hare ellu meshallemin shezzo hodaa bemamon shennigmar dino litteno. veim amar haechad kach meshallem chelko:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 19:
Shennayim sheheidu veamru bemizrach habbira harag ze et hannefesh beshaa pelonit uvau shenayim veamru lahen bemaarav habbira hazzot heyitem immanu baet hazzot. im yachol haomed bemaarav lirot ma shebbammizrach enan zommin. veim eno yachol lirot hare ellu zommin veen omrin shemma meor enehem shel rishonim rav veroin merachok yeter mikkol adam. vechen im heidu shenayim veamru babboker harag ze et hannefesh birushalayim uvau shenayim veamru lahen beyom ze baerev heyitem immanu belud. im yachol adam lehallech afillu al hassus mirushalayim lelud mibboker ad erev enan zommin veim lav hare ellu zommin veen omrin shemma kar kal beyoter nizdammen lahen vekippelu et hadderech ella bedavar hammatzuy hayyadua lakkol meshaarin leolam umezimin otan: 
Shenayim sheamru beechad beshabbat harag ze et hannefesh bemakom peloni uvau shenayim veamru beyom ze immanu heyitem bemakom acher rachok aval bayyom shelleachar yom ze harago bevadday afillu heidu haacharonim shekkodem kamma yamim harago hare ze hahoreg im edav harishonim neheragin shehare huzemu. shebbeet sheheidu sheharag adayin lo nigmar dino lehareg. aval bau shene edim bishlishi beshabbat veamru beechad beshabbat nigmar dino shel peloni lahariga uvau shenayim veamru beechad beshabbat immanu heyitem bemakom peloni harachok ella meerev shabbat o besheni beshabbat nigmar dino. en edim ellu shehuzammu neheragin shehare mikkol makom beet sheheidu alav kevar nigmar dino lahariga. vechen leinyan tashlume kenas. ketzad. bau shenayim bishlishi beshabbat veamru beechad beshabbat ganav vetavach venigmar dino uvau shenayim veamru beechad beshabbat immanu heyitem bemakom rachok aval beerev shabbat nigmar dino. afillu amru [beechad] beshabbat ganav vetavach umachar uvesheni beshabbat nigmar dino en edim ellu shehuzammu meshallemin shehare mikkol makom beet sheheidu alav chayyav haya leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En ede hashshetar naasin zommin ad sheyyomru bevet din shetar ze bizmanno ketavnuhu velo icharnuhu. aval im lo amru ken af al pi shezzemanno shel shetar beechad benisan birushalayim uvau edim veheidu sheede hashshetar hayu immahem bevavel beyom ze. hashshetar kasher vehaedim kesherim sheefshar shekketavuhu veicharuhu ucheshehayu birushalayim beechad baadar katvu shetar ze sham veicharu zemanno vechatvu zemanno benisan. amru bizmanno ketavnuhu vehuzammu im yesh sham edim sheyyodim hayyom shechatmu al hashshetar o edim sherau ze hashshetar vachatimat yadam bo beyom peloni. kevan shehuzammu hare nifselu lemafrea miyyom shennoda shechatmu al hashshetar. shehaedim hachatumim al hashshetar hare hen kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din beet hachatima. aval im en edim sherau edutan velo rau hashshetar mikkodem en nifsalin ella meet sheheidu bevet din shezze ketav yadan veamru bizmanno ketavnuhu veefshar shebbeyom ze sheheidu bevet din bo bayyom chatmu al hashshetar sheyyesh lo kamma shanim vehem shikkeru veamru bizmanno katavnu:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 20: En edim zommin neheragin velo lokin velo meshallemin ad sheyyihyu shenehem reuyin leedut veyizzomu shenehem achar shennigmar haddin. aval im huzam echad mehen bilvad o shehuzammu shenehem kodem gemar din o achar gemar din venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul en neenashin af al pi shehuzammu venifselu lechol edut shebbattora:

Neherag ze sheheidu alav veachar kach huzammu enan neheragin min haddin. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 19)</small> "kaasher zamam laasot" vaadayin lo asa. vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala. aval im laka ze sheheidu alav lokin. vechen im yatza hammamon miyyad ze leyad ze beedutan chozer livalav umeshallemin lo:

Hayu haedim shelosha afillu mea im heidu bevet din ze achar ze veheid kol echad mehen achar chavero betoch kede dibbur vehuzammu miktzatan en neenashin ad sheyyuzammu kullan. aval im haya hefsek ben ze laze yeter mikkede dibbur shehu kede sheelat shalom talmid lerav. hare nechleka haedut vehashshenayim shehuzammu neenashin vehashshenayim haacherim shehaya ben divrehen vedivre harishonim hefsek en neenashin. veaf al pi shebbatla haedut kullah. mippene shehen kat achat hoil venifsela mikketzatah nifsela kullah:

Heid haechad venechkera eduto veamar hashsheni af ani kamohu o sheamar hen kayyotze baze vehuzammu shenehen hare shenehen neheragin o lokin o meshallemin. shekkol ed sheamar achar edut chavero hen hare ze kemi shennechkar veheid kemo sheheid chavero. veen leedim zommin shegaga lefi sheen bah maase. lefichach en tzerichim hateraa kemo shebbearnu:

Keshem shehashshenayim mezimin et hammea im heidu hammea bevat achat. kach hen mezimin otan afillu hayu chamishshim kat uvau shenayim achar shenayim. ketzad. kat sheheida al reuven sheharag et shimon birushalayim uvau shene edim vehezimuha. uvat kat sheniyya veheida otah edut atzmah sheruven harag shimon birushalayim veamdu otan hashshenayim vehezimuha gam zo hakkat hashsheniyya vechen hashshelishit vechen harviit afillu mea kullan hen neheragin al pi ellu hashshenayim:

Kat sheheida al reuven sheharag et shimon birushalayim uvaa kat sheniyya vehezima et hakkat rishona yehargu haedim hazzommin veyinnatzel reuven. baa kat shelishit vehezima et hakkat hashsheniyya tehareg hakkat hashsheniyya ureuven vetinnatzel hakkat rishona. baa kat reviit vehezima et hakkat shelishit tehareg hakkat hashshelishit veharishona veyinnatzel reuven vehakkat hashsheniyya. vechen afillu hen mea kat zo mezimma et zo kat nichneset vechat yotzet:

Edim sheheidu al ish terefa sheharag vehuzammu en neheragin. sheafillu haraguhu bidehen en neheragin lefi shehu terefa. vechen haedim shehayu terefa veheidu bedavar shechayyavin alav mitat bet din vehuzammu en neheragin. sheim yuzammu zommehen en zommehen neheragin shello hezimu ella terefa:

Edim sheheidu al echad vehirshiuhu resha sheen bo lo malkot velo mita velo chiyyuv mamon veachar kach huzammu. hare ellu lokin af al pi shello zammu lehalekot ze velo lechayyevo mamon. ketzad. heidu al kohen shehu chalal kegon sheheidu befanenu nitgarsha immo o nechletza bemakom peloni beyom peloni vehuzammu hare hen lokin. vechen im heidu al adam sheharag bishgaga vehuzammu lokin veenan golin. heidu al shoro shel ze sheharag hannefesh vehuzammu. hare hen lokin veen meshallemin et hakkofer. heidu alav shennimkar beeved ivri vehuzammu lokin. vearbaa devarim ellu mippi hakkabbala hen:

Kach kibbelu chachamim sheshshenayim shehirshiu et hatztzaddik vehitzdiku et harasha beedutan. uvau edim acherim vehezimum vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha. hare edim harishonim lokim af al pi shello hirshiu hatztzaddik lehalekoto. aval im heidu alav sheachal basar bechalav o shellavash shaatnez hare ellu lokin. mishshum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 19)</small> "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam":
Shenayim sheheidu al reuven shennaaf im bat kohen venigmar din reuven lechanek vedin hannoefet lisrefa veachar kach nimtzeu zommin hare ellu nechnakin velo nisrafin. vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 21:
Edim sheheidu sheppeloni geresh ishto velo natan lah ketubba vehuzammu. vahalo ben hayyom ben lemachar im geresh sofo litten ketubba. omdin kamma rotze adam litten bichtubbatah shel zo shettimkor otah betovat hanaa umeshallemin deme tovat hanaa zo. umeshaarin beishsha uvichtubbatah. sheim haishsha hayta chola o zekena o shehaya shalom benah leven balah en deme hakketubba keshettimmacher kemo dameha im hayta haishsha beria uketanna im yesh benehen ketata shezzo kerova min haggerushin urechoka min hammita. vechen en tovat hanaa shel ketubba hamerubba lefi tovat hanaa shel ketubba hammuetet. sheim hayta ketubbatah elef zuz hare hi nimkeret betovat hanaa bemea. veim hayta mea enah nimkeret baasara ella befachot. devarim ellu kefi ma sheyyeshaaru haddayyanim: 
Heidu al ze shechayyav lifloni elef zuz al menat litten mikkan vead sheloshim yom. vehallo omer ad chamesh shanim achar hashsheloshim yom. venimtzeu zommin. omdin kamma rotze adam litten veyihyu beyado elef zuz chamesh shanim umeshallemin ken lallo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Heidu al shoro shel ze shennagach venimtzeu zommin meshallemin chatzi nezek. veim en hashshor shave chatzi nezek meshallemin deme hashshor bilvad sheen meshallem chatzi nezek ella miggufo. lefichach im heidu alav sheachal perot o shavar kelim bederech hillucho meshallemin nezek shalem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Heidu al peloni shehippil shen avdo veachar kach simme et eno vehuzammu. meshallemin laadon deme haeved udeme eno. heidu shessimme et eno veachar kach hippil et shinno vehuzammu (veachar kach) venimtza haddavar hefech shehaadon hippil et shinno veachar kach simme et eno meshallemin deme ayin laeved. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Ede kinnuy usetira shehuzammu lokin. ba ed echad veheid shezzinneta achar kinnuy usetira [venimtza oto haed zomem meshallem ketubbatah. hayu shenayim vehen ede hakkinnuy vehassetira vehattuma] venimtzeu zommin meshallemin keneged hakketubba veen lokin. velamma lo yehargu vahare heidu battuma. lefi shello hitru bah: 
Shenayim sheheidu al ze shegganav vetavach o machar vehuzammu meshallemin et hakkol. heidu shenayim shegganav veheidu shenayim acherim shettavach o machar vehuzammu ellu veellu. hare harishonim meshallemin tashlume kefel veacharonim meshallemin shenayim ushelosha. huzammu haacharonim bilvad hare haggannav meshallem tashlume kefel vehaedim haacharonim meshallemin laggannav tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. nimtza echad min haacharonim zomem batla edut sheniyya. nimtza echad min harishonim zomem batla kol haedut sheim en geneva en hattevicha o hammechira mechayyavto leshallem kelum: 
Shenayim sheheidu sheachal sade zo shalosh shanim venimtzeu zommin meshallemin levaal hassade deme hassade. heidu shenayim sheachalah shana rishona ushenayim sheachalah shana sheniyya ushenayim sheachalah shana shelishit vehuzammu kullan meshalleshin benehen. sheaf al pi sheedut hachazaka shalosh eduyyot hen hare hen keedut achat lahazama. lefichach shelosha achim veechad mitztaref im kol echad veechad veheidu beshana shana hare ellu shalosh eduyyot vetitkayyem bahen hachazaka vehen keedut achat lahazama. sheim huzammu kullan hare shelosha haachin meshallemin chatzi deme hassade veze shennitztaref im kol echad mehen meshallem chatzi dameha: 
Shalosh kitte edim shennitkayyem beedutan sheshshor ze muad venimtzet kat rishona usheniyya zommin kullan peturin. nimtzeu shelashtan zommin kullan chayyavin leshallem hannezek sheaf al pi shehu tam meshallem chatzi nezek. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu kullan romzin ze et ze. o shebbau retzufin. o shehayu makkirin baal hashshor velo hikkiru hashshor. aval im en sham achat meellu hare kat rishona usheniyya peturin shehare hen omrin lo banu ella lechayyevo chatzi nezek velo yadanu shettavo kat acheret veyease muad: 
Vechen shenayim sheheidu beven sorer umore edut harishona uvau shenayim acharehem veheidu alav edut haacharona shebbah yehareg vehuzammu shetehen. kat harishona loka veenah nehereget mippene sheyyecholim lomar lehalekoto banu. aval kat haacharona nehereget sheal pihen bilvad hu neherag. hayta hakkat haacharona arbaa shenayim omrim befanenu ganav ushenayim omrim befanenu achal vehuzammu kullan neheragin. heidu shenayim shezze ganav nefesh miyyisrael umecharo vehuzammu hare ellu nechnakin. heidu shenayim sheggenavo veheidu shenayim acherim shemmecharo. ben shehuzammu ede geneva ben shehuzammu ede mechira kol kat mehen shehuzamma nehereget. shehaggeneva hi techillat chiyyuvo shel ze lemita. heidu shenayim shemmecharo leze hayyisrael vehuzammu velo hayu sham edim sheggenavo hare ellu peturin. sheafillu lo huzammu lo haya ze neherag mippene sheyyachol lomar avdi macharti. bau ede geneva achar shehuzammu ede mechira afillu rainu otan romzin ze et ze en neheragin: 
Motzi shem ra al ishto shehevi edim shezzinneta keshehi arusa vehevi aviha edim vehezimum hare ede habbaal neheragin. chazar habbaal vehevi edim vehezimu ede haav. hare ede haav neheragin umeshallemin mamon labbaal. neheragin mippene sheede habbaal nigmar dinam lahariga beedutan umeshallemin kenas mippene shennigmar din habbaal leshallem kenas beedutan venimtzeu chayyavin nefashot laze umamon laze. vechen shenayim sheheidu al ze shebba al naara hameorasa vehuzemu neheragin veen meshallemin. ba al bitto shel peloni vehuzammu neheragin umeshallemin hakkenas leaviha. peloni rava hashshor vehuzammu niskalin veen meshallemin. shoro shel peloni niskalin umeshallemin deme hashshor levaal hashshor. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 22:
Shete kitte edim hammachchishot zo et zo shebba ed echad mikkat zo veed echad mikkat zo veheidu beedut acheret en kan edut. shehare bevadday echad mehen sheker veen yadua mi hu mishshenehen. baa kat zo bifne atzmah veheida edut uvaa kat zo veheida edut acheret bifne atzmah mekabbelin kol achat mehen bifne atzmah: 
Reuven shehotzi al shimon shene shetarot echad bemane veechad bematayim vechafar shimon bishne hashshetarot veede shetar ze kat achat meotan hashshenayim shehichchishu zo et zo. veede hashshetar hashsheni hakkat hashsheniyya. hare shimon meshallem mane sheyyad baal hashshetar al hattachtona veyishshava al hashshear. yerae li sheshshevua zo sheyyishshava al hashshear binkitat chefetz kedin mode bemiktzat. shehare alav shene edim kesherim meidin bemiktzat hammamon shekkafar bechullo. velo tehe hodaat piv gedola mehaadaat edim kemo shebbearnu: 
Hotzi reuven shetar al levi veedav kat achat mishshetehen. vehotzi shimon shetar sheni al levi veedav hakkat hashsheniyya. velevi kofer bishnehen. hare reuven nishba venotel veshimon nishba venotel shebbevadday echad mehen yesh lo etzlo. ushevua zo betakkanat chachamim kedin chenvani al pinkaso: 
Hotzi reuven shetar al shimon veedav kat achat mehen vehotzi shetar sheni al levi veedav hakkat hashsheniyya vechol echad mehen kofer bo hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. hoil veen reuven yachol lekayyem echad mishshene shetarot hare kol shetar mehen kecheres ushene hannitanin nishbain hesset veniftarin. bamme devarim amurim keshebbau shete hakkittot lehaid keachat. aval kol hammotzi shetar sheyyesh bo edut kat achat mishshetehen hare ze gove bo. veim hotzi achar kach ben hu ben acher shetar sheyyesh bo edut hakkat hashsheniyya hare ze gove bo ben mimmalve harishon ben meacher. shehare kol kat mishshetehen baa bifne atzmah veheida: 
Mi shehevi edim venechkera edutan vehuzammu vechazar vehevi edim acherim beotah hattaana atzmah vehuzammu afillu mea kat. veachar kach hevi edim acherim beotah hattaana atzmah venimtzet edut ellu haacharonim mechuvvenet. danin al pihen. sheaf al pi shehuchzak ze shettaan taana zo lehavi edim shakranim hare lo huchzeku ellu haedim haacharonim shehen meshakkerin. aval shetar shekkara alav arar vehu sheyyavou shenayim veyomru mimmennu shaal lezayyef lo shetar ze af al pi shennitkayyem hashshetar mechotmav en govin bo leolam. veyerae li sheim bau ede hashshetar veheidu hen beatzman al ketav yadan govin bo: seliku lehu hilchot edut besad
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 1:
Mitzvat ase laasot bayit laAdonai muchan lihyot makrivim bo hakkarbanot. vechoggin elav shalosh peamim bashshana shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 8)</small> "veasu li mikdash". uchevar nitparesh battora mishkan sheasa moshe rabbenu. vehaya lefi shaa shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 9)</small> "ki lo vatem ad atta" vegomer:
Kevan shennichnesu laaretz heemidu hammishkan baggilgal arba esre shana shekkavshu veshechilleku. umishsham bau leshilo uvanu sham bayit shel avanim ufarsu yeriot hammishkan alav velo hayta sham tikra. veshst shana amad mishkan shilo ucheshemmet eli charav uvau lenov uvanu sham mikdash. ucheshemmet shemuel charav uvau legivon uvanu sham mikdash. umiggivon bau levet haolamim. vime nov vegivon sheva vachamishshim shana:
Kevan shennivna hammikdash birushalayim neesru kol hammekomot kullan livnot bahen bayit laAdonai ulehakriv bahen karban. veen sham bayit ledore haddorot ella birushalayim bilvad uvehar hammoriyya shebbah neemar <small>(divrei hayamim 1 22 1)</small> "vayyomer david ze hu bet Adonai haelohim veze mizbeach leola leyisrael" veomer <small>(Tehillim 132 14)</small> "zot menuchati ade ad":
Binyan shebbana shelomo kevar meforash bimlachim. vechen binyan heatid lehibbanot af al pi shehu katuv bichezkel eno meforash umevoar. veanshe bayit sheni keshebbanu bime ezra banuhu kevinyan shelomo umeen devarim hameforashim bichezkel:
Veellu hen haddevarim shehen ikkar bevinyan habbayit. osin bo kodesh vekodesh hakkadashim veyihye lifne hakkodesh makom echad vehu hannikra ulam. ushelashtan nikrain hechol. veoshin mechitztza acheret saviv lahechol rechoka mimmennu keen kale hechatzer shehayu bammidbar. vechol hammukkaf bimchitza zo shehu keen chatzar ohel moed hu hannikra azara vehakkol nikra mikdash:
Veosin bammikdash kelim. mizbeach laola velishar hakkarbanot. vechevesh sheolim bo lammizbeach. umekomo lifne haulam mashuch ledarom. vechiyyor vechanno lekaddesh mimmennu hakkohanim yedehem veraglehem laavoda. umekomo ben haulam velammizbeach mashuch ledarom shehu semol hannichnas lammikdash. umizbeach lakketoret umenora veshulchan ushelashtan betoch hakkodesh lifne kodesh hakkadashim:
Hammenora baddarom missemol hannichnas veshulchan miyyamin shealav lechem happanim. ushenehem betzad kodesh hakkadashim mibbachutz umizbach hakketoret mashuch mibben shenehem lachutz. veosin betoch haazara gevulin ad kan leyisrael ad kan lakkohanim. uvonim bah battim lishar tzarche hammikdash kol bayit mehem nikra lishka:
Keshebbonin hahechol vehaazara bonin baavanim gedolot. veim lo matzu avanim bonin bilvenim. veen mefatztzelin et avne habbinyan behar habbayit ella mefatztzelin otan umesattetin otan mibbachutz veachar kach machnisin otan labbinyan. shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 5 lo)</small> "avanim gedolot avanim yekarot leyassed habbayit avne gazit". veomer <small>(Melachim 1 6 7)</small> "umakkavot vehaggarzen kol keli varzel lo nishma babbayit behibbanoto":
Veen bonin bo etz bolet kelal ella o baavanim o bilvenim vesid. veen osin achsadrot shel etz bechol haazara ella shel avanim o levenim:
Umeratztzefin et kol haazara baavanim yekarot. veim neekra even af al pi shehi omedet bimkomah. hoil venitkalkela pesula veasur lakkohen haoved laamod aleha bishat haavoda ad shettikkava baaretz:
Umitzva min hammuvchar lechazzek et habbinyan ulehagbiho kefi koach hatztzibbur shenneemar <small>(Ezra 9 9)</small> "uleromem et bet elohenu". umefaarin oto umeyappin kefi kochan im yecholin latuach oto bezahav ulehagdil bemaasav hare ze mitzva:
En bonin et hammikdash ballayla shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 15)</small> "uveyom hakim et hammishkan" bayyom mekimin lo ballayla. veoskin babbinyan mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkochavim. vehakkol chayyavin livnot ulesaed beatzman uvemamonam anashim venashim kemikdash hammidbar. veen mevattelin tinokot shel bet rabban labbinyan. veen binyan bet hammikdash doche yom tov:
Hammizbeach en osin oto ella binyan avanim (gazit) veze shenneemar battora <small>(Shemot 20 21)</small> "mizbach adama taase li" sheyyihye mechubbar baadama shello yivnuhu lo al gabbe kefin velo al gabbe mechillot. veze shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 22)</small> "veim mizbach avanim" mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno reshut ella chova:
Kol even shennifgema kede shettachgor bah hatztzipporen kesakkin shel shechita hare zo pesula lakkevesh velammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Devarim 27 6)</small> "avanim shelemot tivne et mizbach Adonai". umehechan hayu meviin avne mizbeach min betulat hakkarka chofrin ad shemmaggiin lemakom hannikkar sheeno mekom avoda uvinyan umotziin mimmennu haavanim. o min hayyam haggadol. uvonin mehen. vechen avne hahechol vehaazarot shelemot hayu:
Avne hechol vaazarot shennifgemu o shennigmemu pesulin veen lahen pidyon ella nignazim. kol even shennaga bah habbarzel af al pi shello nifgema pesula levinyan hammizbeach uvinyan hakkevesh shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 22)</small> "ki charbecha henafta aleha vattechalleha". vehabbone even shennaga bah barzel bammizbeach o bakkevesh loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 22)</small> "lo tivne ethen gazit". vehabbone even pagum over baase:
Even shennifgema o shennaga bah barzel achar shennivnet bammizbeach o bakkevesh otah haeven pesula vehashshear kesherot. umelabbenin et hammizbeach paamayim beshana bappesach uvechag. ucheshemmelabbenin otan melabbenin bemappa. aval lo bechafis shel barzel shemma yigga baeven veyifsol:
En osin madregot lammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 23)</small> "lo taale vemaalot al mizbechi". ella bonin kemo tel bidromo shel mizbeach mitmaet veyored merosh hammizbeach ad haaretz vehu hannikra kevesh. vehaole bemaalot al hammizbeach loke. vechen hannotetz even achat min hammizbeach o mikkol hahechol o mibben haulam velammizbeach derech hashechata loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 3)</small> "venittatztem et mizbechotam" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 4)</small> "lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem":
Hammenora vecheleha vehashshulchan vechelav umizbach hakketoret vechol kele sharet en osin otan ella min hammattechet bilvad. veim asaum shel etz o etzem o even o shel zechuchit pesulin:
Hayu hakkahal aniyyim osin otan afillu shel bedil veim heeshiru osin otan zahav afillu hammizrakot vehashshippudin vehammaggerefot shel mizbach haola vehammiddot im yesh koach batztzibbur osin otan shel zahav afillu shaare haazara mechappin otan zahav im matza yadam:
En osin kol hakkelim mittechillatan ella leshem hakkodesh. veim naasu mittechillatan lehedyot en osin otan legavoah. ucheli gavoah ad shello nishtammesh bahen gavoah rashshay lehishtammesh bahen hedyot. umishshennishtammesh bahen gavoah asurin lehedyot. avanim vekorot shechatzavan mittechilla levet hakkeneset en bonin otan lehar habbayit:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 2:
Hammizveach mekomo mechuvvan beyoter. veen meshannin oto mimmekomo leolam. shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 1 22 1)</small> "ze mizbach leola leyisrael". uvammikdash neekad yitzchak avinu shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 22 2)</small> "velech lecha el eretz hammoriyya". veneemar bedivre hayyamim <small>(divrei hayamim 2 3 1)</small> "vayyachel shelomo livnot et bet Adonai birushalayim behar hammoriyya asher nira ledavid avihu asher hechin bimkom david begoren arnan hayevusi":
Umasoret beyad hakkol shehammakom shebbana bo david ushelomo hammizbeach begoren aravna hu hammakom shebbana bo avraham hammizbeach veakad alav yitzchak. vehu hammakom shebbana bo noach kesheyyatza min hatteva. vehu hammizbeach shehikriv alav kayin vehevel. uvo hikriv adam harishon karban keshennivra umishsham nivra. amru chachamim adam mimmekom kapparato nivra:
Middot hammizbeach mechuvvanot harebe vetzurato yedua ish meish. umizbeach shebbanu bene haggola keen mizbeach sheatid lehibbanot asuhu veen lehosif al middato velo ligroa mimmenna:
Ushelosha neviim alu immahem min haggola. echad heid lahen al mekom hammizbeach. veechad heid lahen al middotav. veechad heid lahen shemmakrivin al hammizbeach hazze kol hakkarbanot af al pi sheen sham bayit:
Mizbeach sheasa moshe vesheasa shelomo vesheasu bene haggola vesheatid leheasot kullan eser ammot gova kol echad mehen. veze hakkatuv battora <small>(Shemot 27 1)</small> "veshalosh ammot komato" mekom hammaaracha bilvad. umizbeach sheasu bene haggola vechen heatid lehibbanot middat arko verachbo 32 ammot al 32 ammot:
Eser ammot shel gova hammizbeach mehen beamma bat chamishsha tefachim umehen beamma bat shishsha tefachim. ushear kol ammot habbinyan beamma bat shishsha tefachim. vegova kol hammizbeach 58 tefachim:
Vechach hayta middato vetzurato. ala chamishsha tefachim vechanas chamishsha tefachim zehu yesod. nimtza rochav sheloshim amma ushene tefachim al rochav sheloshim amma ushene tefachim. ala sheloshim tefachim vechanas chamishsha tefachim zehu sovev [ala 18 tefachim zehu mekom hammaaracha] nimtza rachbo shemone veesrim amma vearbaa tefachim al shemone veesrim amma vearbaa tefachim [ala 18 tefachim vechones lekeren zavit shel haych binyan chalul merubba lechol arba keranot] umekom hakkeranot amma mizze veamma mizze saviv. vechen mekom ragle hakkohanim amma saviv. nimtza mekom hammaaracha rachbo esrim vearba ammot vearbaa tefachim al esrim vearba ammot vearbaa tefachim:
Gova kol keren vekeren chamishsha tefachim. veribbua kol keren amma al amma. vearba hakkeranot chalulot hayu mittochan. vegova mekom hammaaracha 18 tefachim. nimtza chatzi gova hammizbeach 29 tefachim missof hassovev ulematta:
Vechut shel sikra haya choger beemtza hammizbeach [keshishsha tefachim missof hassovev ulematta] lehavedil ben damim haelyonim ledamim hattachtonim. venimtza gavho min haaretz ad mekom hammaaracha tesha ammot pachot tefach:
Yesod hammizbeach lo haya makkif mearba ruchotav kemo hassovev. ella haya hayesod mashuch keneged kol ruach tzafon umaaravi veochel baddarom amma achat uvammizrach amma achat. vekeren deromit mizrachit lo haya lah yesod:
Uvekeren maaravit deromit hayu shene nekavim kemin sheni chotamin dakkin. vehen hannikrain shitin shehaddamim yordin bahen umitarvin beotah hakkeren baamma veyotzin lannachal kidron:
Ulematta baritzpa beoto hakkeren haya mekom amma al amma vetavla shel shayish vetabbaat kevua bah shebbo yordin lashshitin umenakkin oto:
Vechevesh haya banuy lidromo shel mizbeach. arko sheloshim ushetayim amma al rochav 16 amma vehaya ochel baaretz sheloshim amma mitztzad hammizbeach. uforeach mimmenna amma al hayesod veamma al hassovev. vaavir meat haya mafsik ben hakkevesh lammizbeach kede litten haevarim lammizbeach bizrika. vegova hakkevesh tesha ammot pachot shetut ad keneged hammaaracha:
Ushene kevashim ketannim yotzim mimmennu shebbahem ponim laysod velassovev umuvdalin min hammizbeach kimlo nima. vechallon hayta bemaaravo shel kevesh amma al amma urevuva hayta nikret. shebbah notnin pesule chattat haof ad shettaavor tzuratah vetetze levet hasserefa:
Ushene shulchanot hayu bemaarav hakkevesh echad shel shayish shennotnin alav et haevarim veechad shel kesef shennotnin alav kele hashsharet:
Keshebbonin hammizbeach bonin oto kullo atum kemin ammud veen osin bo chalal kelal. ella mevi avanim shelemot gedolot uketannot umevi sid vezefet vekuneya umemache veshofach letoch malben gadol kemiddato uvone veole. venoten betoch habbinyan guf shel etz o even bekeren deromit mizrachit kemiddat hayesod. vechen noten betoch kol keren vekeren ad sheyyashlim habbinyan veyasir haggufim shebbetoch habbinyan kede shettishshaer keren deromit mizrachit belo yesod veyishshaaru hakkeranot chalulin:
Arba keranot shel mizbeach visodo veribbuo meakkevin. vechol mizbeach sheen lo keren yesod vechevesh veribbua hare hu pasul shearbatan meakkevin. aval middat arko umiddat rachbo umiddat komato enan meakkevin. vehu shello yifchot meamma al amma berum shalosh ammot keshiur mekom hammaaracha shel mizbach midbar:
Mizbeach shennifgam mibbinyano im nifgam mibbinyano tefach pasul pachot mittefach kasher vehu shello yihye bannishar even peguma:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 3:
Hammennora meforeshet tzuratah battora. vearbaa geviim ushene kaftorim ushene perachim hayu bikne hammenora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 34)</small> <small>(Shemot 37 20)</small> "uvammenora arbaa geviim meshukkadim kaftoreha uferacheha". veod perach shelishi haya samuch lirechah shel menora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 8 4)</small> "ad yerechah ad pirchah": 
Veshalosh raglayim hayu lah. ushelosha kaftorim acherim hayu bikne hammenora shemmehen yotzim sheshet hakkanim. shelosha mitztzad ze ushelosha mitztzad ze. uvechol kane vekane mehen shelosha geviim vechaftor vaferach. vehakkol meshukkadim kemo shekedim baasiyyatan:
Nimtzeu kol haggeviim shenayim veesrim. vehapperachim tisha. vehakkaftorim achad asar. vechullan meakkevin ze et ze vaafillu chaser echad min hashshenayim vearbaim meakkev et kullan:
Bamme devarim amurim besheasauha zahav. aval shear mine mattachot en osin bah geviim kaftorim uferachim. vechen menora habbaa zahav tihye kullah kikkar im neroteha vetihye kullah miksha min haashatot. veshel shear mine mattachot en makpidin al mishkalah. veim hayta chalula keshera:
Veen osin otah leolam min haggerutaot ben shehayta shel zahav ben shehayta shel shear mine mattachot:
Hammelkachayim vehammachtot uchele hashshemen enan mikkelal hakkikkar shehare neemar bammenora <small>(Shemot 25 lo)</small> <small>(Shemot 37 17)</small> "zahav tahor" vechazar veamar umalkacheha umachtoteha zahav tahor. velo neemar neroteha zahav tahor mippene shehannerot kevuin bammenora vehem mikkelal hakkikkar: 
Shivat kene hammenora meakkevin ze et ze. veshivat neroteha meakkevin ze et ze ben shehayta shel zahav ben shehayta shel shear mine mattachot. vechol hannerot kevuim bakkanim:
Sheshet hannerot hakkevuim besheshet hakkanim hayyotzim min hammenora kullan penehem lanner haemtzai sheal kene hammenora veze hanner haemtzai panav keneged kodesh hakkadashim vehu hannikra ner maaravi:
Haggeviim domin lechosot alekkesanderia sheppihen rachav veshulehen katzar. vehakkaftorim kemin tappuchim kerutiyyim shehen arukkin meat kevetza sheshshene rasheha kaddin. vehapperachim kemo pirche haammudim shehen kemin keara usefatah kefula lachutz:
Gova hammenora haya shemona asar tefach. haraglayim vehapperach shelosha tefachim. ushene tefachim chalak. vetefach shebbo gavia kaftor vaferach. utefachayim chalak. vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzin mimmennu echad helach veechad helach venimshachim veolin keneged gova hammenora. vetefach chalak. vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzim mimmennu echad helach veechad helach venimshachin veolin keneged gova hammenora. vetefach chalak. vetefach kaftor ushene kanim yotzim mimmennu echad helach veechad helach venimshachin veolin keneged gova hammenora. utefachayim chalak. nishtayyeru shelosha tefachim shebbahen shelosha geviim kaftor vaferach:
Veeven hayta lifne hammenora uvah shalosh maalot shealeha kohen omed umetiv et hannerot umanniach aleha kele shamnah umalkacheha umachtoteha bishat hatava:
Hashshulchan haya arko shenem asar tefach verachbo shishsha tefachim. vehaya munnach arko leorech habbayit verachbo lerochav habbayit. vechen shear kol hakkelim shebbammikdash arkan learko shel bayit verachban lerochav habbayit chutz min haaron shehaya arko lerochav habbayit. vechen nerot hammenora keneged rochav habbayit ben hatztzafon uven haddarom:
Arbaa senifin shel zahav hayu lashshulchan mefutztzalin berashehen shehayu somchin bahen shete hammaarachot shel lechem happanim. shenayim misseder ze. ushenayim misseder ze. vehem hanneemarim battora <small>(Shemot 25 29)</small> "ukesotav":
Ushemona veesrim kanim shel zahav kol echad mehen kachatzi kane chalul hayu lo. arbaa asar leseder ze vearbaa asar leseder ze. vehem hannikraim <small>(Shemot 25 29)</small> "menakkiyyotav". ushene habbezichin shemmannichin bahen hallevona al hashshulchan betzad hammaarachot hen hannikrain <small>(Shemot 25 29)</small> "kappotav". vehaddefusin sheosin bahem lechem happanim hem hannikraim <small>(Shemot 25 29)</small> "kearotav":
Ellu haarbaa asar kanim noten hachalla harishona al atzmo shel shulchan venoten ben rishona usheniyya shelosha kanim. vechen ben kol challa vechalla shelosha kanim. uven shishshit vachamishit shene kanim bilvad lefi sheen al hashshishshit acheret. nimtzeu arbaa asar bechol maaracha umaaracha:
Ushene shulchanot hayu baulam mibbifnim al petach habbayit. echad shel shayish notnin alav lechem happanim bichnisato. veechad shel zahav notnin alav lechem bitziato. shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin:
Mizbach hakketoret haya merubba amma al amma. vehu natun bahechol mechuvvan ben hatztzafon laddarom mashuch ben hashshulchan vehammenora lachutz. ushelashtan hayu munnachin mishshelish hahechol velifnim keneged happarochet hammavdil ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim:
Hakkiyyor hayu lo shenem asar dad kede sheyyihyu kol hakkohanim haoskim battamid mekaddeshim mimmennu keechad. umucheni asu lo sheyyihyu bah hammayim tamid. vehi chol kede shello yihyu hammayim shebbah nifsalin belina shehakkiyyor mikkele hakkodesh umekaddesh vechol davar sheyyitkaddesh bichli kodesh im lan nifsal:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 4:
Even hayta bekodesh hakkadashim bemaaravo shealeha haya haaron munnach. ulefanav tzintzenet hamman umatte aharon. uveet shebbana shelomo et habbayit veyada shessofo lecharev bana bo makom lignoz bo haaron lematta bematmoniyyot amukot vaakalkallot veyoshiyyahu hammelech tzivva ugenazo bammakom shebbana shelomo shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 la 3)</small> "vayyomer lalviyyim hammevinim lechol yisrael hakkedoshim laAdonai tenu et aron hakkodesh babbayit asher bana shelomo ven david melech yisrael en lachem massa bakkatef atta ivdu et Adonai elohechem" vegomer. venignaz immo matte aharon vehatztzintzenet veshemen hammishcha vechol ellu lo chazru bevayit sheni. veaf urim vetummim shehayu bevayit sheni lo hayu meshivin beruach hakkodesh. velo hayu nishalin bahen shenneemar <small>(Ezra 2 63)</small> <small>(Nechemya 7 65)</small> "ad amod kohen leurim vetummim". velo hayu osin otan ella lehashelim shemona begadim lechohen gadol kede shello yehe mechussar begadim: 
Bevayit rishon haya kotel mavdil ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim avyo amma. vechevan shebbanu habbayit sheni nistappek lahem im ovi hakkotel haya mimmiddat hakkodesh o mimmiddat kodesh hakkadashim lefichach asu kodesh hakkadashim avyo esrim amma temimot veasu hakkodesh arbaim amma temimot vehinnichu amma yetera ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim velo banu kotel bevayit sheni ella asu shete parochot achat mitztzad kodesh hakkadashim veachat mitztzad hakkodesh uvenehen amma keneged ovi hakkotel shehaya barishon. aval bemikdash rishon lo hayta sham ella farochet achat bilvad shenneemar <small>(Shemot 26 33)</small> "vehivdila happarochet lachem" vegomer:
Hahechol shebbanu bene gola haya mea amma al mea amma al rum mea. vechen hayta middat rumo. banu gova shesh ammot atum satum kemo yesod lo. verum katle habbayit arbaim amma verum hakkiyyur shebbattikra amma veal gabbav gova shete ammot panuy sheyyikkanes bo haddelef vehu hannikra bet dilfa. voovi hattikra sheal gabbe bet dilfa amma. umaaziva gova amma. vaaliyya benuya al gabbav gova ketaleha arbaim amma. uvegaggah gova amma kiyyur veammatayim gova bet dilfa veamma tikra veamma maaziva vegova hammaake shalosh ammot vetas shel barzel kemo sayif gavho amma al gabbe hammaake saviv kede shello yanuchu alav haofot vehu hannikra kale orev. hare hakkol mea amma:
Min hammaarav lammizrach mea amma vezehu cheshbonan. arbaa ketalim ze lefanim mizze uvenehen shelosha mekomot penuyin. ben hakkotel hammaaravi uven hakkotel shellefanim mimmennu chamesh ammot uven kotel sheni ushelishi shesh ammot uven kotel shelishi urevii shesh ammot. veellu hammiddot hen shel ovi hakkotel im hammakom happanuy shebben shene ketalim. veorech kodesh hakkadashim esrim amma. uven shete happarochot hammavdilot beno uven hakkodesh amma. veorech hakkodesh arbaim amma. voovi hakkotel hammizrachi shebbo hashshaar shesh ammot vehaulam achat esre amma. voovi kotel haulam chamesh ammot. nimtza hakkol mea amma:
Min hatztzafon laddarom mea amma. ovi kotel haulam chamesh ammot. umikkotel ulam ad kotel hakkodesh eser ammot. vechatle hakkodesh shishsha ketalim ze lefanim mizze uvenehen chamishsha mekomot penuyin. ben kotel chitzon uven hashsheni chamesh ammot. uven sheni ushelishi shalosh ammot. vechamesh ben shelishi urevii. uven revii vachamishi shesh. uven chamishi vechotel happenimi shesh. nimtza hakkol arbaim amma mitztzad ze vearbaim amma mitztzad shekkenegdo verochav habbayit mibbifnim esrim. hare mea amma:
Happishpash vehu shaar hakkatan. ushene pishpashin hayu lahechol mitztzidde hashshaar haggadol shebbeemtza. echad batztzafon veechad baddarom. shebbaddarom lo nichnas bo adam meolam vealav hu meforash al yede yechezkel <small>(Yechezkel 44 2)</small> "hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach". veshebbatztzafon bo nichnasin. umehallech ben sheni hakketalim ad shemmaggia lemakom patuach lakkodesh missemolo venichnas letoch hahechol umehallech ad shaar haggadol ufotcho:
Hashshaar haggadol haya rachbo eser ammot vegavho esrim amma. vearba daltot hayu lo shetayim bifnim ushetayim bachutz. hachitzonot niftachot letoch happetach lechassot avyo shel kotel vehappenimiyyot niftachot letoch habbayit lechassot achore haddelatot:
Pitcho shel ulam haya gavoah arbaim amma verochav esrim. velo haya lo shearim. vechamesh malteriyyot shel mila hayu al gabbe pitcho millemala. hattachtona odefet al happetach amma mizze veamma mizze. vechol achat mechamishtan odefet al shellematta mimmenna amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtzet haelyona sheloshim amma. venidbach shel avanim haya ben kol achat veachat:
Hahechol haya binyano rachav millefanav vetzar meachorav kemo ari. vitziim hayu makkifin labbayit kullo missaviv chutz lechotel hammesibba. veyatzia hattachtona chamesh veroved al gabbah shesh veyatzia emtzait shesh veroved al gabbah sheva vehaelyona sheva shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 6 6)</small> "hayyatzia hattachtona" vegomer. vechen hayu hashshalosh yetziim makkifim labbayit mishshelosha ruchotav vechen saviv lechatle haulam millematta ad lemala kach hayu amma achat chalak veroved shalosh ammot. veamma chalak veroved shalosh ammot ad lemala. venimtzeu harvadin mukkafin lakketalim. rochav kol roved shalosh ammot ad lemala. uven kol roved veroved amma. veroved haelyon haya rachbo arba ammot:
Kol ellu hammekomot happenuyim shebben hakketalim hem hannikraim taim. nimtzeu hattaim hammukkafin lammikdash chamishsha min hatztzafon vachamishsha min haddarom ushelosha min hammaarav. veshalosh deyotot hayu deyota al gabbe deyota. nimtzeu 15 taim baddarom chamishsha al gabbe chamishsha vachamishsha al gabbehen vechen batztzafon chamishsha asar. ushemona taim hayu bammaarav shelosha al gabbe shelosha ushenayim al gabbehen bidyota achat hakkol 38 taim:
Shelosha petachim hayu lechol echad veechad min hattaim. echad latta min hayyamin. veechad latta min hassemol. veechad latta sheal gabbav. uvekeren mizrachit tzefonit batta shebbaddeyota haemtzait hayu chamishsha petachim. echad latta miyyamin. veechad latta sheal gabbav. veechad lammesibba. veechad latta sheyyesh bo happishpash. veechad lahechol:
Umesibba hayta ola mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit lekeren tzefonit maaravit shebbah hayu olin legaggot hattaim. haya ole bammesibba ufanav lammaarav halach et kol pene hatztzafon ad shehu maggia lammaarav. higgia lammaarav hafach panav laddarom halach et kol pene hammaarav ad shehu maggia laddarom. higgia laddarom hafach panav lammizrach vehaya mehallech laddarom ad shehu maggia lefitchah shel aliyya sheppitchah shel aliyya haya patuach laddarom:
Uvefitchah shel aliyya hayu shete kelunesot shel erez shebbahen olin legaggah shel aliyya. verashe pispesin hayu mavdilin baaliyya ben gag hakkodesh legag kodesh hakkadashim. velulin hayu petuchin baaliyya levet kodesh hakkadashim shebbahen meshalshelin et haummanin betevot kede shello yazunu enehem mibbet kodesh hakkadashim. ufaam achat beshana mippesach lefesach melabbenin et hahechol:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 5: Har habbayit vehu har hammoriyya haya chamesh meot amma al chamesh meot amma vehaya mukkaf choma. vechefin al gabbe kefin hayu benuyot mittachtav. mippene ohel hattuma. vechullo haya mekore setav lefanim missetav:
Vachamishsha shearim hayu lo. echad min hammaarav veechad min hammizrach veechad min hatztzafon ushenayim min haddarom. rochav kol shaar eser ammot vegavho esrim. veyesh lahem daltot:

Lefanim mimmennu soreg makkif seviv gavho asara tefachim ulefanim min hassoreg hachel [gavho] eser ammot. vealav hu omer bakkinot <small>(Eicha 2 8)</small> "vayyaavel chel vechoma" zo chomat haazara:

Lefanim min hachel haazara. vechol haazara hayta orech 187 al rochav 135. veshiva shearim hayu lah. shelosha min hatztzafon hassemuchin lammaarav. ushelosha min haddarom semuchin lammaarav. veechad bammizrach mechuvvan keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim baemtza:

Kol shaar mehen haya rachbo eser ammot vegavho esrim amma. vehayu lo delatot mechuppot zahav. chutz mishshaar mizrachi shehaya metzuppe nechoshet doma lezahav. veshaar ze hu hannikra shaar haelyon vehu shaar nikanor:

Haazara lo hayta mechuvvenet beemtza har habbayit. ella rechoka midderom har habbayit yeter mikkol haruchot ukerova lammaarav yeter mikkol haruchot. uvenah uven hatztzafon yeter mimma shebbenah uven hammaarav. uvenah uven hammizrach yeter mimma shebbenah uven hatztzafon:

Velifne haazara bammizrach hayta ezrat hannashim. vehi hayta orech mea amma vachamishsha usheloshim al rochav 135. vearba leshachot hayu bearba miktzeoteha shel arbaim arbaim amma velo hayu mekorot vechen atidin lihyot:

Uma hem meshammeshot. deromit mizrachit lishkat hannezirim sheshsham mevashshelin et shalmehem umegallechin et saaram. mizrachit tzefonit lishkat dir haetzim sheshsham kohanim baale mumin matliim baetzim. shekkol etz shennimtza bo tolaat pasul. tzefonit maaravit lishkat hametzoraim. maaravit deromit bah hayu notnin yayin veshemen vehi hayta nikret lishkat bet shamnayya:

Ezrat hannashim hayta mukkefet gezuzetra kede sheyyihyu hannashim root millemalan vehaanashim millemattan kede shello yihyu meerbavin. uvayit gadol haya betzad haazara bitzfonah mibbachutz ben haazara vehachel vehaya banuy kippa umukkaf revadin shel even vehu haya nikra bet hammoked. ushene petachim hayu lo echad patuach laazara veechad patuach lachel:

Vearba leshachot hayu bo. shetayim kodesh ushetayim chol. verashe pispesin mavdilin ben hakkodesh vehachol. uma hayu meshammeshot maaravit deromit lishkat hattelaim. uderomit mizrachit lishkat ose lechem happanim. mizrachit tzefonit bah ganzu bet chashmonay avne mizbeach sheshshikketzum malche yavan. tzefonit maaravit bah yordin levet hattevila:

Hayyored levet hattevila millishka zo haya holech bammesibba haholechet tachat hammikdash kullo vehannerot dolkot mikkan umikkan ad shemmaggia levet hattevila. umedura hayta sham. uvet hakkisse shel kavod. vezehu kevodo, metzao naul beyadua sheyyesh sham adam:

Orech haazara min hammizrach lammaarav 187 vezehu cheshbonan. mikkotel maaravi shel azara ad kotel hahechol achat esre amma. veorech hahechol kullo mea amma. ben haulam velammizbeach shetayim veesrim. hammizbeach shetayim usheloshim. mekom derisat ragle hakkohanim vehu hannikra ezrat kohanim achat esre amma. mekom derisat ragle yisrael vehu hannikra ezrat yisrael achat esre amma:

Verochav haazara min hatztzafon laddarom mea usheloshim vechamesh vezehu cheshbonan. mikkotel tzefoni ad bet hammitbachayim shemone ammot. bet hammitbachayim 12 ammot umechetza. vesham tolin umafshitin et hakkadashim betziddo:

Mekom hashshulchanot shemone ammot uvo shulchanot shel shayish shemmannichin alehen hannetachim umedichin et habbasar levashshelo. ushemona shulchanot hayu. uvetzad mekom hashshulchanot mekom hattabbaot 24 amma. vesham shochatin et hakkadashim:

Uven mekom hattabbaot vehammizbeach shemone ammot vehammizbeach 32. vehakkevesh sheloshim. uven hakkevesh ulechotel deromi 12 amma umechetza. mikkotel tzefoni shel azara ad kotel hammizbeach shehu rochav shishshim umechetza. uchenegdo mikkotel haulam ad kotel mizrachi shel azara shehu orech shesh veshivim:
Kol hamerubba hazze hu hannikra tzafon hu hammakom sheshshochatin bo kadshe kadashim:

Shemone leshachot hayu beezrat yisrael. shalosh batztzafon. veshalosh baddarom. shebbaddarom lishkat hammelach. lishkat happarva. lishkat hammedichin. lishkat hammelach sham notnin melach lakkarban. lishkat happarva sham molchin orot hakkadashim. veal gaggah hayta bet tevila lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. lishkat hammedichin sham hayu medichin kirve hakkadashim umishsham mesibba ola legag bet happarva. vehashshalosh shebbitzfon lishkat haggazit. lishkat haggula. lishkat haetz. lishkat haggazit shebbah sanhedri gedola yoshevet. vechetzyah haya kodesh vechetzyah haya chol. velah shene petachim echad lakkodesh veechad lechol uvachetzi shel chol hayu hassanhedrin yoshvin. lishkat haggula sham hayta bor shemmemallein mimmennu baggula umishsham mesappekin mayim lechol haazara. velishkat haetz hayta achore shetehen vehi hayta lishkat kohen gadol vehi hannikret lishkat parhedrin. vegag shelashtan shave. ushete leshachot acherot hayu sham beezrat yisrael. achat mimin shaar mizrachi vehu lishkat pinchas hammalbish. veechad missemolo vehu lishkat ose chavitin:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 6: Hammikdash kullo lo haya bemishor ella bemaale hahar. kesheadam nichnas mishshaar mizrachi shel har habbayit mehallech ad sof hachel beshave. veole min hachel leezrat hannashim bishtem esre maalot rum kol maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma:
Umehallech kol ezrat hannashim beshave. veole mimmenna leezrat yisrael shehu techillat haazara bachamesh esre maalot. rum kol maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma:

Umehallech kol ezrat yisrael beshave veole mimmennu leezrat hakkohanim bemaala gevoha amma vealeha duchan yesh bo shalosh maalot. rum kol mala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma. nimtzet ezrat hakkohanim gevoha al shel yisrael shete ammot umechetza:

Umehallech kol ezrat hakkohanim vehammizbeach. uven haulam velammizbeach beshave. veole mishsham laulam bishtem esre maalot. rum kol mala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma vehaulam vehahechol kullo beshave:

Nimtza gova karka hahechol al karka shaar hammizrach shel har habbayit shetayim veesrim ammot. vegova shaar har habbayit esrim amma. lefichach haomed keneged shaar hammizrach eno roe petach hahechol. umippene ze asu kotel sheal gabbe shaar ze namuch. kede sheyyehe kohen haomed behar hammishcha roe petach hahechol beshaa shemmazze middam happara nochach hahechol:

Uleshachot hayu sham tachat ezrat yisrael petuchot leezrat hannashim. sheshsham haleviyyim notnin hakkinnorot vehannevalim vehammetziltayim vechol kele hashshir. veal hadduchan haole meezrat yisrael leezrat hakkohanim hayu haleviyyim omdim beshaa sheomrim shira al hakkarban:

Halleshachot habbenuyot bakkodesh ufetuchot lachol im hayu gaggotehen shavin im karka haazara tochan chol vegaggotehen kodesh veim enan shavin af gaggotehen chol shehaggaggot vehaaliyyot lo nitkaddeshu. lefichach gaggim ellu en ochlin sham kadshe kadashim velo shochatin kadashim kallim:
Hayu benuyot lachol ufetuchot lakkodesh tochan kodesh laachilat kadshe kadashim aval en shochatin sham kadashim kallim vehannichnas lesham betuma patur. vegaggotehen chol lechol davar:
Hammechillot happetuchot laazara kodesh vehappetuchot lehar habbayit chol. hachallonot voovi hachoma kelifnim ben laachilat kadshe kadashim ben letuma:
Bet din sheratzu lehosif al yerushalayim o lehosif al haazara mosifin. veyesh lahem limshoch haazara ad hammakom sheyyirtzu mehar habbayit velimshoch chomat yerushalayim ad makom sheyyirtzu:

En mosifin al hair o al haazarot ella al pi hammelech veal pi navi uveurim vetummim veal pi sanhedrin shel shivim veechad zekenim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 9)</small> "kechl asher ani mare otcha" vechen taasu ledorot. umoshe rabbenu melech haya:

Vechetzad mosifin al hair. osin bet din shete todot velokchin lechem chametz shebbahem veholchim bet din achar shete hattodot ushete hattodot zo achar zo veomdin bechinnorot uvinvalim uvetziltzal al kol pinna ufinna veal kol even (veeven) shebbirushalayim veomer <small>(Tehillim 30 2)</small> "aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani" vegomer. ad shemmaggiin lesof hammakom shemmekaddeshin oto veomdin sham. veochlim sham lechem toda achat mishshete hattodot vehashsheniyya nisrefet. veal pi hannavi sorfin et zo veochlin et zo:

Vechen im hosifu al haazara mekaddeshin otah bishyare hammincha. ma yerushalayim hattoda shenneechelet bah mekaddashtah af haazara sheyare hammenachot sheen neechalin ella bah hen shemmekaddeshin otah bahen. veochlin otan besof hammakom shekkiddeshu:

Kol makom shello naasa bechol ellu vechasseder hazze en kadosh gamur. veze sheasa ezra shete todot zikkaron hu sheasa lo bemaasav nitkaddesh hammakom shello haya sham lo melech velo urim vetummim. uvema nitkaddesha bikdushsha rishona shekkiddeshah shelomo shehu kiddesh haazara virushalayim lishatan vekiddeshan leatid lavo:

Lefichach makrivin hakkarbanot kullan af al pi sheen sham bayit banuy. veochlin kadshe kadashim bechol haazara af al pi shehi chareva veenah mukkefet bimchitztza veochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol yerushalayim af al pi sheen sham chomot shehakkedushsha rishona kadsha lishatah vekadsha leatid lavo:

Velamma ani omer bammikdash virushalayim kedushsha rishona kadsha leatid lavo. uvikdushshat shear eretz yisrael leinyan sheviit umaasrot vechayyotze bahen lo kadsha leatid lavo. lefi shekkedushshat hammikdash virushalayim mippene hashshechina ushechina enah betela. vahare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 26 lo)</small> "vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem" veamru chachamim af al pi sheshshommin bikdushshatan hen omdim aval chiyyuv haaretz bishviit uvemaasrot eno ella mippene shehu kibbush rabbim vechevan shennilkecha haaretz midehem batal hakkibbush veniftera min hattora mimmaasrot umishsheviit shehare enah min eretz yisrael. vechevan sheala ezra vekiddeshah lo kiddeshah bechibbush ella bachazaka shehechziku bah ulefichach kol makom shehechziku bah ole bavel venitkaddesh bikdushshat ezra hashsheniyya hu mekuddash hayyom veaf al pi shennilkach haaretz mimmennu vechayyav bishviit uvemaasrot al hadderech shebbearnu behilchot teruma:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 7:
Mitzvat ase leyira min hammikdash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 30)</small> <small>(Vayikra 26 2)</small> "umikdashi tirau". velo min hammikdash atta yare ella mimmi shetztzivva al yirato: 
Vee zo hi yirato lo yikkanes adam lehar habbayit bemaklo o beminal shebberaglav o baafundato o baavak sheal raglav o bemaot hatztzerurin lo bisdino veen tzarich lomar sheasur larok bechol har habbayit ella im nizdammen lo rok mavlio bichsuto. velo yaase har habbayit derech sheyyikkanes mippetach zo veyetze mippetach shekkenegdah kede lekatztzer hadderech ella yakkifo mibbachutz. velo yikkanes lo ella lidvar mitzva:
Vechol hannichnasin lehar habbayit nichnasin derech yamin umakkifin veyotzin derech semol chutz mimmi sheero davar shehu makkif al hassemol. lefichach hayu shoalin lo ma lecha makkif al hassemol. sheani avel. hashshochen babbayit hazze yenachemcha. sheani menudde. hashshochen babbayit hazze yitten bilvavcha vetishma ledivre chaverecha vikarvucha:
Kol shehishlim avoda venistallek lo eno yotze vaachorav lahechol ella mehallech achorannit meat meat umehallech benachat al tziddo ad sheyyetze min haazara. vechen anshe mishmar veanshe maamad uleviyyim midduchanan kach hem yotzin min hammikdash kemi shepposea achar tefilla laachorav. kol ze leyira min hammikdash:
Lo yakel adam et rosho keneged shaar mizrachi shel azara shehu shaar nikanor. mippene shehu mechuvvan keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim. vechol hannichnas laazara yehallech benachat bemakom shemmuttar lo lehikkanes lesham. veyire atzmo shehu omed lifne Adonai kemo shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 9 3)</small> <small>(divrei hayamim 2 7 16)</small> "vehayu enay velibbi sham kol hayyamim". umehallech beema uveyira ureada shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 55 15)</small> "bevet elohim nehallech beragesh": 
Veasur lechol adam leshev bechol haazara veen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 18)</small> <small>(divrei hayamim 1 17 16)</small> "vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai". vehassanhedrin shehayu yoshvin belishkat haggazit lo hayu yoshvin ella bechetzyah shel chal: 
Af al pi shehammikdash hayyom charev baavonotenu chayyav adam bemorao kemo shehaya noheg bo bevinyano. lo yikkanes ella lemakom shemmuttar lehikkanes lesham velo yeshev baazara velo yakel rosho keneged shaar hammizrach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 30)</small> <small>(Vayikra 26 2)</small> "et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau". ma shemirat shabbat leolam af mora mikdash leolam sheaf al pi shecharev bikdushshato omed: 
Bizman shehammikdash banuy asur lo leadam lehakel et rosho min hatztzofim shehu chutz lirushalayim velifnim. vehu sheyyihye roe et hammikdash. velo yihye gader mafsik beno uven hammikdash:
Asur leadam leolam sheyyippane o sheyyishan ben mizrach lammaarav. veen tzarich lomar sheen kovin bet hakkisse ben mizrach lammaarav bechol makom mippene shehahechol bemaarav. lefichach lo yippane lemaarav velo lemizrach mippene shehu keneged hammaarav. ella ben tzafon ledarom nifnim vishenim. vechol hammetil mayim min hatztzofim velifnim lo yeshev ufanav kelappe hakkodesh ella letzafon o ledarom o yesallek hakkodesh latztzedadin:
Veasur leadam sheyyaase bayit tavnit hechol. achsadra tavnit ulam. chatzer keneged haazara. shulchan betzurat shulchan. umenora betzurat menora. aval ose hu menora shel chamishsha kanim o shel shemona kanim o menora sheenah shel mattechet af al pi sheyyesh lah shiva kanim:
Shelosha machanot hayu bammidbar. machane yisrael vehu arba machanot. umachane leviyya shenneemar bah <small>(Bamidbar 1 50)</small> "vesaviv lammishkan yachanu". umachane shechina vehu mippetach chatzar ohel moed velifnim. uchenegdan ledorot. mippetach yerushalayim ad har habbayit kemachane yisrael. umippetach har habbayit ad petach haazara shehu shaar nikanor kemachane leviyya. umippetach haazara velifnim machane shechina. vehachel veezrat hannashim maala yetera bevet olamim:
Kol eretz yisrael mekuddeshet mikkol haaratzot. uma hi kedushshatah shemmeviin mimmenna haomer ushete hallechem vehabbikkurim ma sheen meviin ken mishshear aratzot:
Eser kedushshot hen beeretz yisrael vezo lemala mizzo. ayarot hammukkafot choma mekuddashot mishshear haaretz shemmeshallechin mittochan et hametzoraim veen kovrin betochan met ad sheyyirtzu shiva tove hair o kol anshe hair. veim yatza hammet chutz lair en machazirin oto letochah af al pi sheratzu kullan lehacheziro. ratzu bene hair lehotzi hakkever min hammedina mefannin oto. vechol hakkevarot mefannin chutz mikkever navi o melech. kever shehikkifattu hair ben mearba ruchotav ben mishshete ruchot zo keneged zo im hayta beno uven hair yeter mechamishshim amma lechan vachamishshim lechan en mefannin oto ad sheyyirtzu kullan. pachot mikkan mefannin oto:
Yerushalayim mekuddeshet mishshear haayarot hammukkafot choma. sheochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni lefanim mechomatah. veellu devarim shenneemru birushalayim. en melinin bah et hammet. veen maavirin betochah atzmot adam. veen maskirin betochah battim. veen notnin betochah makom leger toshav. veen mekayyemin bah kivrot chutz mikkivre bet david vekever chulda shehayu bah mimot neviim harishonim. veen notin bah gannot ufardesim. veenah nizraat veenah nechereshet shemma tisrach. veen mekayyemin bah ilanot chutz migginnat veradim shehayta sham mimot neviim harishonim. veen mekayyemin bah ashpa mippene hashsheratzim. veen motziin hemenna zizin ugezuzetraot lirshut harabbim mippene ohel hattuma. veen osin bah kivshonot mippene heashan. veen megaddelin bah tarnegolot mippene hakkadashim. vechen lo yegaddelu hakkohanim tarnegolim bechol eretz yisrael mippene hattohorot. veen habbayit nechlat bah. veeno mittamme bingaim. veenah naaset ir hanniddachat. veenah mevia egla arufa lefi shello nitchalleka lishvatim:
Har habbayit mekuddash mimmenna sheen zavin vezavot niddot veyoldot nichnasin lesham. umuttar lehachenis hammet atzmo lehar habbayit veen tzarich lomar teme met shehu nichnas lesham:
Hachel mekuddash mimmennu sheen akkum uteme met uvoel nidda nichnasim lesham:
Ezrat hannashim mekuddeshet min hachel sheen tevul yom nichnas lesham. veissur ze middivrehem aval min hattora muttar litvul yom lehikkanes lemachane leviyya. uteme met shennichnas leezrat hannashim eno chayyav chattat:
Ezrat yisrael mekuddeshet meezrat nashim sheen mechussar kippurim nichnas lesham. vetame shennichnas lesham chayyav karet:
Ezrat hakkohanim mekuddeshet mimmenna. sheen yisrael nichnasin lesham ella bishat tzarchehem lismicha ulechappara velishchita velitnufa:
Ben haulam velammizbeach mekuddash mimmenna sheen baale mumin uferue rosh ukerue begadim nichnasin lesham:
Hahechol mekuddash mibben haulam velammizbeach. sheen nichnas lesham ella rechutz yadayim veraglayim:
Bet kodesh hakkadashim mekuddash mimmennu sheen nichnas lesham ella kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim bishat haavoda:
Makom shehaya baaliyya mechuvvan al kodesh hakkadashim en nichnasin lo ella paam achat beshavua leda ma hu tzarich lechazzek bidko. beshaa shennichnasin habbannaim livnot uletakken bahechol o lehotzi mishsham et hattuma. mitzva sheyyihyu hannichnasin kohanim temimim. lo matzu temimim yikkansu baale mumin. veim en sham kohanim yikkansu leviyyim. lo matzu leviyyim yikkansu yisrael. mitzva bithorim. lo matzu tehorim yikkansu temeim. tame uvaal mum yikkanes baal mum veal yikkanes tame shehattuma dechuya betzibbur. vechol hannichnasin lahechol letakken yikkansu betevot. im en sham tevot o i efshar lahem sheyyaasu betevot yikkansu derech petachim:
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 8: Shemirat hammikdash mitzvat ase. veaf al pi sheen sham pachad meoyvim velo millistim. sheen shemirato ella kavod lo. eno dome palterin sheyyesh alav shomrin lefalterin sheen alav shomrin:

Ushemira zo mitzvatah kol hallayla. vehashshomrim hem hakkohanim vehaleviyyim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 2)</small> "veatta uvanecha ittach lifne ohel haedut". kelomar attem tihyu shomrim lo. vahare neemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 4)</small> "veshamru et mishmeret ohel moed" veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 3 38)</small> "vehachonim kedma lifne ohel moed mizracha moshe veaharon uvanav shomre mishmeret hakkodesh":

Veim bittelu shemira avru belo taase shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 5)</small> "veshamru et mishmeret hakkodesh". uleshon shemira azhara hi ha lamadta sheshshemirato mitzvat ase. uvittul shemirato mitzvat lo taase:
Mitzvat shemirato sheyyihyu hakkohanim shomrim mibbifnim vehaleviyyim mibbachutz. vechd eda shomrin oto bechol layla tamid bechd makom. hakkohanim bishlosha mekomot vehaleviyyim bech makom:

Vehechan hayu shomrim. kohanim hayu shomrim bevet avtinas uvevet hannitzotz uvevet hammoked. bet avtinas uvet hannitzotz hayu aliyyot benuyot betzad shaare haazara veharovin hayu shomrim sham. bet hammoked kippa uvayit gadol haya mukkaf revadin shel even vezikne bet av shel oto hayyom hayu yeshenim sham umaftechot haazara beyadam:
