Lo hayu hakkohanim hashshomrim yeshenim bevigde kehunna ella mekappelin otan umannichin otan keneged rashehen velovshin bigde atzman vishenim al haaretz. kederech kol shomre chatzrot hammelachim shello yishnu al hammittot:

Era keri laechad mehen. holech bammesibba shettachat hakkarka shehammechillot happetuchot lehar habbayit lo nitkaddeshu vetovel vechozer veyoshev etzel echav hakkohanim ad shenniftachin hashshearim babboker yotze veholech lo:

Vehechan hayu haleviyyim shomrim. al chamishsha shaare har habbayit. veal arba pinnotav mittocho. veal arba pinnot haazara mibbachutz sheasur leshev baazara. veal chamishsha shaare haazara chutz laazara shehare hakkohanim shomrim al shaar hammoked veal shaar hannitzotz. hare shemona asar makom:
Veod shomrim belishkat hakkarban uvelishkat happarochet vaachore bet hakkapporet:

Umaamidin memunne echad al kol mishmerot hashshomrim. veish har habbayit haya nikra. vehaya mechazzer al kol mishmar umishmar kol hallayla. vaavukot delukot lefanav. vechol mishmar sheeno omed veomer lo ish har habbayit shalom alecha nikkar shehu yashen chovto bemakkelo. ureshut haya lo lisrof et kesuto ad shehayu omrin birushalayim ma kol baazara kol ben levi loke uvegadav nisrafin sheyyashan al mishmarto:

Bashshachar kodem sheyyaale ammud hashshachar samuch lo yavo hamemunne shel mikdash veyidpok al hakkohanim shebbevet hammoked vehen potchin lo. natal et hammafteach ufatach et hashshaar hakkatan shebben bet hammoked uven haazara venichnas mibbet hammoked laazara venichnesu acharav hakkohanim ushete avukot shel ur beyadam venechleku lishte kittot. kat holechet lemizrach vechat holechet lemaarav. vehayu bodkin veholchin et kol haazara ad sheyyaggiu shete hakkittot limkom bet ose chavitin. higgiu ellu veellu omrin shalom hakkol shalom. veheemidu ose chavitin laasot chavitin:
Kasseder hazze osin bechol layla velayla chutz millele shabbat sheen beyadam ur ella bodkin bannerot haddelukin sham meerev shabbat:
Mishneh Torah, The Order of Prayer 1: Nahagu haam likrot bechol yom bashshachar achar shekkorin parashat tzav uvirkat kohanim korin mishna zo. ellu devarim sheen lahem shiur happea vehabbikkurim vehareayon ugemilut chasadim vetalmud tora. ellu devarim sheadam ochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba. kibbud av vaem ugemilut chasadim veiyyun tefilla uvikkur cholim vehashekamat bet hammidrash vehachenasat orchim vahavaat shalom ben adam lachavero vetalmud tora keneged kullam. amar rabbi zera benot yisrael hen hechmiru al atzman sheafillu root tippat dam kechardal yoshvot aleha shiva nekiyyim. tana deve eliyyahu kol hashshone halachot bechol yom muvtach lo shehu ben haolam habba shenneemar halichot olam lo al tikre halichot ella halachot. amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam shenneemar vechol banayich limmude Adonai vechulei. mizmor ledavid Adonai mi yagur beoholecha mi yishkon behar kadshecha holech tamim ufoel tzedek. leolam yehe adam yere shamayim basseter umode al haemet vedover emet bilvavo veyashkem veyomar. ribbon haolamim lo al tzidkotenu anachnu mappilim tachanunenu lefanecha ki al rachamecha harabbim ma anu me chayyenu ma chasdenu ma tzidkatenu ma kochenu uma gevuratenu ma nomar lefanecha Adonai elohenu halo kol haggibborim keayin lefanecha veanshe hashshem kelo hayu vachachamim kivli madda unevonim kivli hasekel ki chol maasenu tohu vavohu vime chayyenu hevel lefanecha kemo shekkatuv bedivre kadshecha umotar haadam vegomer. aval anachnu ammecha bene veritecha bene avraham ohavcha shennishbata lo behar hammoriyya. zera yitzchak yechidcha shenneekad al gabbe mizbechecha. adat yaakov bincha bechorecha shemmeahavatcha sheahavta oto umissimchatcha shessamachta bo karata oto yisrael vishurun.

Lefichach anu chayyavin lehodot lecha uleshabbechacha ulefaercha velitten shevach vehodaa lishmecha. vechayyavin anu lomar lefanecha bechol yom erev vavoker shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. ashrenu ma tov chelkenu ma naim goralenu ma yafa yerushshatenu. ashrenu sheanu mashkimin umaarivin bechol yom tamid erev vavoker veomrim shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. atta hu kodem shennivra haolam atta hu achar shennivra haolam atta hu baolam hazze veatta hu laolam habba atta hu rishon veatta hu acharon. kaddesh shimcha haggadol vehakkadosh beolamecha uvishuatcha tarum vetagbiah karnenu baruch hamekaddesh shemo barabbim. atta hu Adonai elohenu bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat uvishme hashshamayim haelyonim. atta hu rishon veatta hu acharon umibbaladecha en elohim kabbetz koycha mearba kanfot haaretz yakkiru veyedu kol bae olam ki atta hu haelohim levaddecha lechol mamlechot haaretz atta asita et hashshamayim veet haaretz umi bechol maase yadecha baelyonim o vattachtonim mi sheyyomar lecha ma taase. avinu shebbashshamayim ase immanu kemo shehivtachtanu al yede chozecha baet hahi avi etchem uvaet kabbetzi etchem ki etten etchem leshem velithilla bechol amme haaretz beshuvi et shevutechem leenechem amar Adonai. veneemar atta hu Adonai levaddecha atta asita et hashshamayim sheme hashshamayim vechol tzevaam haaretz vechol asher aleha hayyammim vechol asher bahem veatta mechayye et kullam utzeva hashshamayim lecha mishtachavim. atta hu Adonai haelohim asher bacharta beavram vehotzeto meur kasdim vesamta shemo avraham. atta hu ushenotecha lo yittammu. Adonai melech Adonai malach Adonai yimloch leolam vaed. Adonai melech kulei ad baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen:

Beracha rishona shemmevarchin lifne pesuke hazzemirot zehu nuschah. baruch sheamar vehaya haolam baruch hu baruch omer veose baruch gozer umekayyem baruch merachem al haaretz baruch merachem al habberiyyot baruch maavir afela umevi ora baruch meshallem sachar tov lireav baruch sheen lefanecha lo avla lo shichcha velo kazav velo mirma lo masso fanim velo mikkach shochad baruch el chay laad vekayyam lanetzach. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hael hamehullal befi ammo meshubbach umefoar bilshon kol chasidav vaavadav uveshire david avdecha meshichecha nehallelcha Adonai elohenu bishvachot uvizmirot nodecha uneshabbechacha unefaercha venazkir shimcha malkenu elohenu yachid che haolamim meshubbach umefoar ade ad shemo baruch atta Adonai melech mehullal battishbachot. vekorin pesukin ellu yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav kulei ashre kulei ad sof tillim. veachar kach kore pesukim ellu baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen. vayvarech david et Adonai leene kol hakkahal vayyomer david baruch atta Adonai elohe yisrael vechulei:

Beracha acharona shel achar pesuke hazzemirot zehu nuschah. yishtabbach shimcha laad malkenu hael hammelech haggadol vehakkadosh bashshamayim uvaaretz ki lecha nae Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu vechulei. vekore hashshira ad sofah keminhag hammakom. beshabbat nahagu kol haam lehosif lifne beracha zo nosach ze. nishmat kol chay tevarech et shimcha Adonai elohenu veruach kol basar tefaer uteromem zichrecha malkenu tamid ledor vador umeolam vead olam atta el umibbaladecha en elohim veen lanu melech goel umoshia pode umatztzil bechol et tzara vetzuka ella atta mefarnes umerachem eloah kol beriyyot adon hattoladot hamehullal battishbachot hamenaheg olamo bechesed uveriyyotav berachamim rabbim. elohim emet lo yanum velo yishan hameorer yeshenim vehammekitz nirdamim somech noflim verofe cholim umattir asurim ulecha anachnu modim. veillu finu male shira kayyam uleshonenu rinna kahamon gallav vesiftotenu shevach kemerchave rakia veenenu meirot kashshemesh vechayyareach veyadenu perusot kenishre shamayim veraglenu kallot kaayyalot en anu maspikin lehodot lecha Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu ulevarech et shemecha al achat meelef alfe alafim verov rubbe revavot peamim hattovot nissim ugevurot sheasita immanu veim avotenu. millefanim mimmitzrayim gealtanu Adonai elohenu mibbet avadim peditanu. baraav zantanu uvesava kilkaltanu. mecherev hitztzaltanu umiddever millattanu umecholaim raim rabbim dillitanu. vead henna azarunu rachamecha Adonai elohenu velo azavunu chasadecha al ken evarim sheppillagta banu veruach uneshama shennafachta beappenu velashon asher samta befinu hen hem yodu vivarchu et shimcha Adonai elohenu vechulei yishtabbach vechulei. vechen nahagu likrot kol mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat kodem sheyyatchilu pesuke hazzemirot beyom hashshabbat uveyom hakkippurim. veyesh mekomot shennahagu likrot hallel haggadol beshabbatot kodem pesuke hazzemirot. veyesh mekomot shennahagu likrot shir hammaalot hakkol keminhagam:

Beracha rishona shellifne keriat shema zo hi nuschah. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam yotzer or uvore choshech kulei ad yotzer hammeorot. beracha sheniyya ahavat olam ahavtanu Adonai elohenu chemla gedola vitera chamalta alenu avinu malkenu kulei ad beammo yisrael beahava:

Beracha acharona shelleachar keriat shema zo hi nuschah. emet veyatztziv vechulei ad baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael. uvearvit beracha rishona baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bidvaro maariv aravim ad baruch atta Adonai hammaariv aravim. beracha sheniyya ahavat olam bet yisrael ammecha ahavta vechulei ad baruch atta Adonai ohev ammo yisrael.
Beracha rishona shelleachar keriat shema shel arvit zo hi nuschah. emet veemuna kol zot kayyam alenu kulei ad baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael.

Beracha acharona zo hi nuschah. hashekivenu Adonai elohenu leshalom vechulei ad baruch shomer ammo yisrael laad. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen kulei ad padita oti Adonai el emet. yiru enenu veyismach libbenu kulei ad Adonai melech Adonai malach Adonai yimloch leolam vaed.

Venahagu miktzat haam levarech pesukim beemtza beracha vekorin benosach ze. vayyar kol haam vayyippelu al penehem vayyomru Adonai hu haelohim Adonai hu haelohim. hoshienu elohe yishenu vekabbetzenu vehatztzilenu min haggoyim lehodot leshem kadshecha lehishtabbeach bithillatecha. ki lo yittosh Adonai et ammo baavur shemo haggadol ki hoil Adonai laasot etchem lo leam vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav vehayta laAdonai hammelucha vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. elohenu shebbashshamayim yached shimcha hakkaruy alenu kayyem et shemecha umalchutecha alenu tamid. beyadcha nafshot hachayyim vehammetim asher beyado nefesh kol chay veruach kol besar ish beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet. vaanachnu ammecha vetzon maritecha node lecha leolam ledor vador nesapper tehillatecha. Adonai hatztzila nafshi missefat sheker millashon remiyya. yisrael nosha baAdonai teshuat olamim lo tevoshu velo tikkalmu ad olme ad. yehi Adonai elohenu immanu kaasher haya im avotenu al yaazvenu veal yitteshenu lehattot levavenu elav lalechet bechol derachav lishmor mitzvotav vechukkav umishpatav asher tzivva et avotenu. kol hanneshama tehallel yah haleluyah. baruch Adonai bayyom baruch Adonai ballayla baruch Adonai beshachvenu baruch Adonai bekumenu tamid nehallelcha sela venasiach bechukkecha uveemunatecha. baruch atta Adonai hammolech bichvodo chay vekayyam tamid yimloch alenu vechulei:
Mishneh Torah, The Order of Prayer 2: Nosach berachot hattefilla vasedaveran
(1) Baruch atta Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora vechulei:
(2) Atta gibbor leolam adonay mechayye metim atta rav lehoshia (morid hattal) (mashshiv haruach umorid haggashem) mechalkel chayyim bechesed mechayye metim berachamim rabbim somech noflim vechulei:
(3) Atta kadosh veshimcha kadosh ukedoshim bechol yom yehallucha sela baruch atta Adonai hael hakkadosh:
(4) Atta chonen leadam daat umelammed leenosh bina vechannenu meittecha dea chachma uvina vehasekel baruch atta Adonai chonen haddaat:
(5) Hashivenu avinu letoratecha vedabbekenu bemitzvotecha vekarvenu malkenu laavodatecha vehachazirenu bitshuva shelema lefanecha baruch atta Adonai harotze bitshuva:
(6) Selach lanu avinu ki chatanu mechol lanu malkenu ki pashanu lecha ki el tov vesallach atta baruch atta Adonai channun hammarbe lisloach:
(7) Ree na veanyenu veriva rivenu vedun dinenu umaher legoolenu ki el melech goel chazak atta baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael:
(8) Refaenu Adonai elohenu venerafe hoshienu venivvashea ki tehillatenu atta vehaale refua shelema lechol tachaluenu ki el rofe verachaman atta baruch atta Adonai rofe chole ammo yisrael:

(9) Barchenu Adonai elohenu bechol maase yadenu uvarech et shenotenu veten (tal umatar li) beracha al kol pene haadama vesabba et haolam mibbirchotecha veravve pene tevel baruch atta Adonai mevarech hashshanim:
(10) Teka beshofar gadol lecherutenu vesa nes lekabbetz et kol galuyyotenu mearba kanfot kol haaretz leartzenu baruch atta Adonai mekabbetz niddeche ammo yisrael:

(11) Hashiva shoftenu kevarishona veyoatzenu kevattechilla vehaser mimmennu yagon vaanacha umeloch alenu atta levaddecha bechesed uverachamim betzedek uvemishpat baruch atta Adonai melech ohev tzedaka umishpat:
(12) Lammalshinim al tehi tikva vechol haeppikorosin kullam kerega yovedu umalchut zadon teakker uteshabber bimhera veyamenu baruch atta Adonai shover reshaim umachnia zedim:
(13) Al hachasidim veal hatztzaddikim veal gere hatztzedek veal sheerit ammecha bet yisrael yehemu rachamecha Adonai elohenu veten sachar tov lechol habbotchim beshimcha beemet vechulei:
(14) Tishkon betoch yerushalayim ircha kaasher dibbarta uvene otah binyan olam bimhera veyamenu baruch atta Adonai bone yerushalayim:
(15) Et tzemach david bimhera tatzmiach vekarno tarum bishuatecha baruch atta Adonai matzmiach keren yeshua:
(16) Shema kolenu Adonai elohenu vechus verachem alenu vekabbel berachamim uveratzon et tefillatenu malkenu rekam al teshivenu ki atta shomea vechulei:
(17) Retze Adonai elohenu beammecha yisrael velitfillatam shee vehashev haavoda lidvir betecha veishshe yisrael utefillatam vechulei baruch atta Adonai hammachazir shechinato letziyyon:
(18) Modim anachnu lach shaatta hu Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu tzur chayyenu umagen yishenu atta ledor vador node lecha unesapper tehillatecha al chayyenu vechulei:
(19) Sim shalom tova uveracha chen vachesed verachamim alenu veal yisrael ammecha uvarchenu kullanu mimmeor panecha natatta lanu Adonai elohenu tora vechayyim ahava vechulei.

Bimot hachamma omer bivracha sheniyya rav lehoshia morid hattal mechalkel chayyim bechesed vechulei. umevarech beracha teshiit benosach ze barchenu Adonai elohenu bechol maase yadenu uvarech et shenatenu betalle ratzon beracha unedava kashshanim hattovot baruch atta Adonai mevarech hashshanim.

Belel motzae shabbat uvemotzae yom hakkippurim uvemotzae yamim tovim mevarech beracha reviit benosach ze. atta chonen leadam daat umelammed leenosh bina atta hivdalta ben kodesh lechol ben or lechoshech ben yisrael laammim ben yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase keshem shehivdalta ben kodesh lechol ken pedenu vehatztzilenu mikkol mine mashchit umikkol mine furanuyyot hammitraggeshot lavo baolam veshamrenu min hakkol vechannenu meittecha vechulei.

Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed mosif bevirkat 17 bearvit veshacharit umincha umevarech otah benosach ze. retze Adonai elohenu vechulei ad avodat yisrael ammecha elohenu velohe avotenu yaale veyavo vechulei vetechezena enenu vechulei.
Uvechullo shel moed omer beyom mikra kodesh hazze beyom moed chag hammatztzot hazze o beyom moed chag hashshavuot hazze o beyom moed chag hassukkot hazze.

Beyom taanit mevarech hayyachid birkat 16 benosach ze. shema kolenu Adonai elohenu chus verachem alenu vekabbel berachamim uveratzon et tefillatenu millefanecha malkenu rekam al teshivenu anenu avinu anenu beyom tzom taanitenu ki vetzara gedola anachnu al taster panecha mimmennu veal taalem aznecha mishshemoa bakkashatenu veheye karov leshavenu terem nikra veatta taane nedabber veatta tishma kaddavar shenneemar vehaya terem yikrau vaani eene od hem medabberim vaani eshma ki atta shomea tefillat kol pe baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla. usheliach tzibbur omer nosach ze beracha bifne atzmah achar beracha sheviit omer anenu vechulei ad ki el one beet tzara pode umatztzil bechol et tzara vetzuka baruch atta Adonai haone beet tzara.

Betisha beav mevarech birkat arba esre benosach ze. rachem Adonai alenu al yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha hair haavela hachareva hashshomema hannetuna beyad zarim hayyoshevet verosh lah chafuy keishsha akara shello yalada vayyevalleuha ligyonot vayyirashuha ovde fesilim vayyittenu nivlat avadecha maachol leof hashshamayim ulevehemat haaretz al ken tziyyon (bemerer) [bemar] tivke virushalayim titten kolah libbi libbi al challehem meay meay al harugehem ree Adonai vehabbita uree shommoteha venachamenna ki vaesh hitztzattah uvaesh atta atid livnotah kakkatuv vaani ehye lah neum Adonai chomat esh saviv ulechavod ehye vetochah baruch atta Adonai bone yerushalayim.

Befurim mevarech birkat shemone esre benosach ze. modim anachnu lach shaatta hu Adonai elohenu al chayyenu hammesurim beyadecha al nishmotenu happekudot lach al nissecha shebbechol yom vayom veal nifleotecha shebbechol et kulei al hannissim veal haggevurot veal hatteshuot vechulei. veal kullam Adonai elohenu anu modim lach hattov ki lo chalu vechulei.
Bachanukka mevarech beracha zo benosach ze. modim anachnu lach kulei ad veal nifleotecha shebbechol et erev vavoker vetzohorayim al hannissim kulei ad veachar ken bau vanecha vechulei.

Sheliach tzibbur mevarech leolam beracha shelishit benosach ze. nakdishcha venamlichcha uneshallesh lecha kedushsha meshulleshet kaddavar haamur al yad neviecha vekara ze el ze veamar kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot melo chol haaretz kevodo. kevodo vegadlo male olam umeshartav shoalim ayye mekom kevodo lehaaritzo leummatam meshabbechim veomrim baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. mimmekomcha malkenu tofia vetimloch alenu ki mechakkim anachnu lach matay timloch betziyyon bechayyenu uveyamenu tishkon titgaddal vetitkaddash betoch yerushalayim ircha ledor vador lenetzach netzachim veenenu tirena bemalchut uzzecha kaddavar haamur bedivre kadshecha al yede david meshiach tzidkecha yimloch Adonai leolam elohayich tziyyon ledor vador haleluyah. ledor vador naggid gadlecha ulenetzach netzachim kedushshatcha nakdish veshivchacha elohenu mippinu lo yamush ki el melech gadol vekadosh atta baruch atta Adonai hael hakkadosh. beet sheshsheliach tzibbur omer bivracha zo vekara ze el ze kol haam onin kadosh kadosh kadosh vechulei. ucheshehu omer ayye mekom kevodo kol haam onin meshabbechim veomrim baruch kulei. ucheshehu omer bechayyenu uveyamenu kol haam onin amen. ucheshehu omer al yede david meshiach tzidkecha kol haam omrim yimloch Adonai leolam. vechol ellu haddevarim sheonin hatztzibbur hu kore immahen. velo yagbiah kolo beet shehen onin immo. veechad hayyachid veechad hashshatz baasara yamim shemmerosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim omer besof beracha zo kaamur vayyigba Adonai tzevaot bammishpat vehael hakkadosh nikdash bitzdaka baruch atta Adonai hammelech hakkadosh.
Kaddish unefilat appayim

Sheliach tzibbur omer kaddish leolam kodem kol tefilla veachar kol tefilla veachar sheomer seder hayyom bechol et sheyyomar seder hayyom yitchannen meat veyomar kaddish. uchesheyyashlim likrot battora uvechol et sheyyitchannen bedivre tachanunim kesheyyigmor tachanunav yomar kaddish:

Yitgaddal veyitkaddash shemeh rabba bealma divra chiruteh veyamlich malchuteh veyatzmach purekaneh vikarev meshicheh veyifrok ammeh bechayyechon uveyomechon uvechayyehon dechol bet yisrael baagala kaddish sheomer sheliach tzibbur achar sheggomer hattefilla sheeno omer acharav kelum ella kol haam shomin oto veniftarin nahagu haam lehosif besofo nuscha zo. titkabbel tzelothon vetitabbed bautehon verachamav yaase shalom alenu veal kol yisrael amen. kaddish derabbanan kol asara miyyisrael o yater sheoskin betalmud tora sheal pe vaafillu bemidrashot o behaggadot keshehen mesayyemin omer echad nucheraa min ara velaatava pulechana dishmayya leatreh beziveh veyichudeh veyamlich malchuteh vechulei ad venechamata daamiran bealma veimru amen. al rabbanan veal talmidehon veal talmide talmidehon kaddish derabbanan.

Minhagenu lehitchannen binfilat panim bidvarim ufesukim ellu peamim bechullan ufeamim bemiktzatan. lefichach ani korea umishtachave umitchannen lefanecha adon haolam elohe haelohim vaadone haadonim ki lo al tzidkotenu anachnu mappilim tachanunenu lefanecha ki al rachamecha harabbim. Adonai shemaa Adonai selacha Adonai hakeshiva vaase al teachar. ma nomar lefanecha hashshem ma nedabber uma nitztaddak chatanu avinu vehirshanu umaradnu vesarnu mimmitzvotecha umimmishpatecha lecha Adonai hatztzedaka velanu boshet happanim. hushcharu panenu mippene chattotenu venichpefa komatenu mippene ashmotenu en lanu pe lehashiv velo metzach leharim rosh. elohay boshti venichlamti leharim elohay panay elecha ki avonotenu ravu ad lemala rosh veashmatenu gadla ad lashshamayim. en banu maasim ase immanu tzedaka lemaan shemecha vehoshienu kemo shehivtachtanu al yede neviecha lemaan shemi aarich appi utehillati echetam lach levilti hacheritecha lo lemaanchem ani osho bet yisrael ki im leshem kadshi asher chillaltem baggoyim asher batem sham. lo lanu Adonai lo lanu ki leshimcha ten kavod al chasdecha al amittecha lamma yomru haggoyim ayye na elohehem anna Adonai al tefen el keshi haam hazze veel risho veel chattato selach na laavon haam hazze kegodel chasdecha vechaasher nasata laam hazze mimmitzrayim vead henna vesalachta laavonenu ki rav hu. Adonai shemaa Adonai selacha Adonai hakeshiva vaase veal teachar lemaancha elohay ki shimcha nikra al ircha veal ammecha:

Nahagu haam lehitchannen achar nefilat panim keshemmagbiah panav min hakkarka bifsukim ellu. vaanachnu lo neda ma naase ki alecha enenu. zechor rachamecha Adonai vachasadecha ki meolam hemma. al tizkar lanu avonot rishonim maher yekaddemunu rachamecha ki dallonu meod. kuma ezrata lanu ufedenu lemaan chasdecha. yehi chasdecha Adonai alenu kaasher yichalnu lach. im avonot tishmar yah Adonai mi yaamod ki immecha hasselicha lemaan tivvare. Adonai hoshia hammelech yaanenu veyom karenu. ki hu yada yitzrenu zachur ki afar anachnu. azrenu elohe yishenu al devar kevod shemecha vehatztzilenu vechapper al chattotenu lemaan shemecha. vechen nahagu haam lehitchannen achar seder hayyom betachanunim ellu. Adonai elohe avraham yitzchak veyisrael avotenu shamra zot leolam leyetzer machshevot levav ammecha vehachen levavam elecha vehu rachum yechapper avon vegomer. ki atta Adonai tov vesallach verav chesed lechol korecha tzidkatcha tzedek leolam vetoratcha emet. mi el kamocha nose avon veover al pesha yashuv yerachamenu yichbosh avonotenu vegomer. baruch Adonai yom yom yaamas lanu hael yeshuatenu sela. Adonai tzevaot immanu misgav lanu elohe yaakov sela Adonai tzevaot ashre adam boteach bach. baruch adonenu baruch borenu baruch shebberaanu lichvodo vehivdilanu min hattoim venatan lanu torat emet al yede moshe rabbenu vechayye olam nata betochenu. harachaman yiftach libbenu letalmud torato veyitten belibbenu ahavato veyirato vetorato laasot retzono uleavdo belevav shalem uvenefesh chafetza lemaan lo niga larik velo neled labbehala. ken yehi ratzon verachamim millefanecha Adonai elohenu shennichye lishmor chukkecha baolam hazze velimot hammashiach kede shennizke venirash tov lechayye haolam habba lemaan yezammercha chavod velo yiddom Adonai elohay leolam odekka. yihyu leratzon imre fi vehegyon libbi lefanecha Adonai tzuri vegoali:

Nahagu miktzat haam likro bechol yom achar tachanunim ellu shir mizmor shehayu haleviyyim omrim bevet hammikdash beoto hayyom vekorin ledavid elecha Adonai nafshi essa kol hammizmor. vekorin amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina talmide chachamim marbim shalom vechulei. en kelohenu en kadonenu en kemalkenu en kemoshienu mi chelohenu mi chadonenu mi chemalkenu mi chemoshienu node lelohenu node ladonenu node lemalkenu node lemoshienu atta hu elohenu atta hu adonenu atta hu malkenu atta hu moshienu. atta takum terachem tziyyon ki et lechennah ki va moed. ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha veyivtechu vecha yode shemecha ki lo azavta dorshecha Adonai. ki kol haammim yelchu ish beshem elohav vaanachnu nelech beshem Adonai elohenu leolam vaed.

Kevar amarnu bassefer hazze shebbime hashshabbatot veyamim tovim mitpallel adam bechol tefilla sheva berachot shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot uveracha achat emtzait meen hayyom. uverosh hashshana uveyom hakkippurim shel yovel mitpallel baemtza shalosh berachot uvitfillat musaf bilvad. venimtza mitpallel bemusaf bishne yamim ellu tesha berachot. uvemusaf rosh chodesh uvemusaf chullo shel moed mitpallel sheva shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot uveracha achat baemtza:
Mishneh Torah, The Order of Prayer 3: Beracha emtzait shel lele shabbat atta kiddashta et yom hashshevii lishmecha tachlit maase shamayim vaaretz uverachto mikkol hayyamim vekiddashto mikkol hazzemannim kaamur vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii vaykaddesh oto vegomer. elohenu velohe avotenu retze na vimnuchatenu vechulei. beracha emtzait shel yotzer yismach moshe bemattenat chelko ki eved neeman karata lo kelil tiferet berosho natatta beamdo lefanecha al har sinay horid beyado shene luchot avanim vechatuv bahen shemirat shabbat vechen katuv betoratecha veshamru vene yisrael vechulei. yismechu bemalchutecha shomre shabbat kore oneg am mekaddeshe shevii. elohenu velohe avotenu retze na vimnuchatenu kulei ad baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat.

Beracha emtzait shel musaf shabbat. lemoshe tzivvita al har sinay mitzvat shabbat shamor vezachor uvo tzivvitanu Adonai elohenu lehakeriv lecha karban musaf karauy. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettaalenu leartzenu vechulei veet musaf yom hammanoach hazze naase venakriv kulei ad al yede moshe avdecha. velo netatto malkenu legoye haaratzot velo hinchalto malkenu leovde elilim gam bimnuchato lo yishkenu arelim levet yisrael netatto zera yeshurun asher bam bacharta chemdat yamim oto karata. elohenu velohe avotenu retze na vimnuchatenu kulei ad baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat. beracha emtzait shel minchat shabbat atta echad veshimcha echad umi keammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz ateret tehilla vaateret yeshua leammecha natatta avraham yagel yitzchak yerannen yaakov uvanav yanuchu vo menucha shelema shaatta rotze bah yakkiru vanecha veyedu ki meittecha hi menuchatam tanchilenu avinu veal tehi tzara veyagon beyom menuchatenu. elohenu velohe avotenu vechulei.

Beracha emtzait shel musaf rosh chodesh. rashe chodashim leammecha natatta zeman kappara lechol toldotam lihyotam makrivim lefanecha zivche ratzon useire chattat lechapper baadam. zikkaron lechullam yihyu teshuat nafsham miyyad sone. mizbeach chadash betziyyon tachin veolat rosh chodesh naale alav. shire david nishma beirecha haamurim lifne mizbechecha. ahavat olam tavi lahem uverit avot labbanim tizkor. elohenu velohe avotenu mippene chataenu galinu meartzenu venitrachaknu meal admatenu yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettaalenu leartzenu veet musaf yom rosh hachodesh hazze kulei ad al yede moshe avdecha. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu vilohe avotenu shettechaddesh alenu et rosh hachodesh hazze letova velivracha lechen ulechesed ulerachamim lechayyim uleshalom vihi rosh hachodesh hazze ketz vesof lechol chattotenu vetzarotenu techilla varosh lifdut nafshenu ki veammecha yisrael mikkol haummot bacharta verashe chodashim lahem natatta. baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael verashe chodashim. beracha emtzait mimmusaf rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat. atta yatzarta olamcha mikkedem killita melachtecha bayyom hashshevii bacharta banu mikkol haammim veratzita banu mikkol halleshonot vekiddashtanu bemitzvotecha vekeravtanu malkenu laavodatecha veshimcha haggadol vehakkadosh alenu karata vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu shabbatot limnucha veyom rosh chodesh hazze lechapper baadenu shechatanu lefanecha. umippene chataenu vechulei ad umusafim kehilchatan veet musefe yom hammanoach hazze veyom rosh hachodesh hazze naase venakriv et karbenot chovotenu temidin kesidran kemitzvat retzonecha kemo shekkatavta alenu betoratecha al yede moshe avdecha. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu vilohe avotenu shettechaddesh vechulei ad lifdut nafshenu. retze na vimnuchatenu vekaddeshenu bemitzvotecha kulei ad veyanuchu vam kol yisrael ohave shemecha. baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael verashe chodashim.

Beracha emtzait shel yom tov shel pesach arvit shacharit umincha. atta vechartanu mikkol haammim ahavta otanu veratzita banu mikkol halleshonot vekiddashtanu bemitzvotecha vekeravtanu malkenu laavodatecha veshimcha haggadol vehakkadosh alenu karata vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu moadim lesimcha chaggim uzemannim lesashon et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze et yom chag hammatztzot hazze zeman cherutenu beahava zecher litziat mitzrayim. elohenu velohe avotenu yaale veyavo kulei. vehassienu Adonai elohenu et birkat moadecha lechayyim uleshalom kaasher amarta veratzita levarchenu ken tevarchenu sela veten chelkenu betoratecha vesammach nafshenu bishuatecha vechulei. baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim.

Beracha emtzait mimmusaf happesach. atta vechartanu mikkol haammim kulei ad zecher litziat mitzrayim. umippene chataenu galinu meartzenu venitrachaknu meal admatenu veen anu yecholin laalot leheraot ulehishtachavot lefanecha bevet bechiratecha binve hadderech babbayit haggadol vehakkadosh shennikra shimcha alav mippene hayyad shennishtallecha bemikdashecha. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettashuv uterachem alav vealenu berachamecha harabbim utekabbetz pezurenu mibben haggoyim unefutzotenu kannes miyyarkete aretz vahavienu letziyyon ircha berinna velirushalayim bet mikdashcha besimchat olam vesham naase lefanecha et karbenot chovotenu temidin kesidran umusafin kehilchatan veet musaf yom tov mikra kodesh hazze yom chag hammatztzot hazze naase venakriv lefanecha kemitzvat retzonecha kemo shekkatavta alenu betoratecha al yede moshe avdecha. melech rachaman rachem alenu vechulei. vehassienu vechulei. baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim. uvannosach hazze hu mitpallel bechag shavuot uvechag hassukkot belo chesron uvelo yater. ella shebbechag hashshavuot hu omer et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze et yom chag hashshavuot hazze zeman mattan toratenu beahava zecher litziat mitzrayim. uvemusaf hu omer veet musaf yom tov mikra kodesh hazze yom chag hashshavuot hazze. vechen besukkot hu omer et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze yom chag hassukkot hazze zeman simchatenu beahava vechulei. uvishmini atzeret omer et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze et yom chag shemini atzeret hazze zeman simchatenu kulei. vechen bemusaf omer veet musaf yom tov mikra kodesh hazze yom chag shemini kulei.

Veim chal yom tov lihyot beshabbat omer atta vechartanu kulei ad vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu shabbatot limnucha moadim lesimcha chaggim uzemannim lesashon et yom hammanoach hazze veet yom tov mikra kodesh hazze et yom peloni kulei. vechen bemusaf omer veet musefe yom hammanoach hazze kulei. veal derech zo hu mazkir hashshabbat berosh hashshana uveyom hakkippurim im chalu lihyot beshabbat ben bishar tefillot ben bemusaf. vechotem bechol hattefillot shel shalosh regalim mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim. uverosh hashshana chotem melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hazzikkaron. uveyom hakkippurim melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hakkippurim.

Rosh hashshana. nahagu rov haam merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim lehosif bechol tefilla baaseret hayyamim. bivracha rishona mosifim zachrenu lechayyim kulei baruch atta Adonai magen avraham. umosifin bivracha sheniyya mi chamocha av harachamim zocher yetzurav berachamim baruch atta Adonai mechayye hammetim. umosifin bevirkat 18 zechor rachamecha vechulei. uvivracha acharona mosifin uvesefer chayyim vechulei. uvitfillat neila shel yom hatztzom omer bivracha zachrenu lechayyim chatmenu vechol ellu hattosafot minhag mekomot. veyesh mekomot shennahagu shello yosifu davar. minhag pashut shemmevarchin beracha shelishit benosach ze bishne yamim shel rosh hashshana bechol tefilla utefilla mearba hattefillot vechen nahagu miktzat levarech otah beoto hannosach bechol tefilla utefilla mechamesh tefillot shel yom hakkippurim vezehu nuschah. atta kadosh veshimcha kadosh ukedoshim bechol yom yehallucha sela. uvechen ten pachdecha Adonai elohenu al kol maasecha veematcha al kol ma shebbarata veyiraucha kol hammaasim veyishtachavu lefanecha kol habberuim veyeasu chullam agudda echat laasot retzoncha belevav shalem kulei. uvechen ten kavod leammecha tehilla lireecha vetikva tova ledorshecha ufitchon pe lamyachalim lach simcha leartzecha sason leirecha utzemichat keren ledavid avdecha vaarichat ner leven yishay meshichecha bimhera veyamenu. veaz tzaddikim yiru veyismachu visharim yaalozu vachasidim kulei kakkatuv bedivre kadshecha yimloch Adonai leolam elohayich tziyyon ledor vador haleluyah vechatuv vayyigba Adonai vegomer baruch atta Adonai hammelech hakkadosh. beracha emtzait shel rosh hashshana arvit shacharit umincha. atta vechartanu mikkol haammim kulei. vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze zichron terua beahava zecher litziat mitzrayim. elohenu vilohe avotenu yaale veyavo kulei. elohenu velohe avotenu meloch al kol haolam kullo bichvodecha vehinnase al kol haaretz bikarecha vehofa bahadar geon uzzecha al kol yoshve tevel artzecha veyeda kol paul ki atta fealto veyavin kol yetzur ki atta yetzarto veyomar kol asher ruach uneshama veappo Adonai vechulei. kaddeshenu kulei. baruch atta Adonai melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hazzikkaron.

Beracha rishona mishshalosh berachot emtzaiyyot shel musaf rosh hashshana. atta vechartanu. umippene chataenu kulei. veet musefe kulei kemo shekkatuv. alenu leshabbeach laadon hakkol latet gedulla leyotzer bereshit shello asanu kegoye haaratzot vechulei. ochila lael achalle fanav eshala mimmennu maane lashon asher bikhal am ashira uzzo abbia renanot bead mifalav kulei. baruch atta Adonai lammedeni chukkecha. al ken nekavve lecha Adonai elohenu lirot mehera betiferet ezzecha vechulei. elohenu velohe avotenu meloch kulei. baruch atta Adonai melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hazzikkaron. hayyom harat olam hayyom yaamid bammishpat kol yetzure olam im kevanim im kaavadim im kevanim rachamenu kerachem av al banim im kaavadim enenu lecha teluyot vechulei. beracha sheniyya atta zocher maase olam ufoked kol yetzure kedem kulei ki zocher hannishkachot atta hu meolam veen shichcha lifne chisse chevodecha vaakedat yitzchak lezaro tizkor vechulei. hayyom harat olam hayyom yaamid bammishpat kol yetzure olam im kevanim im kaavadim im kevanim rachamenu kerachem av al banim kulei. beracha shelishit atta nigleta baanan kevodecha al am kadshecha ledabber immam min hashshamayim hishmatam kolecha kulei ki atta shomea kulei baruch atta Adonai shomea terua. hayyom harat olam kulei kakkatuv lemala.

Beracha emtzait shel tzom yom hakkippurim bearvit veshacharit umincha uneila atta vechartanu kulei. vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu et yom hakkippurim hazze veet yom mikra kodesh hazze limchila vechulei. elohenu velohe avotenu yaale veyavo yaggia yerae veyeratze yishshama veyippaked veyizzacher lefanecha zichronenu zichron avotenu zichron yerushalayim irecha vezichron mashiach ben david vechulei. elohenu velohe avotenu mechol laavonotenu vechulei. elohenu velohe avotenu meloch kulei. kaddeshenu kulei. udevarcha emet vekayyam kulei baruch atta Adonai melech al kol haaretz melech mochel vesoleach vechulei. beracha emtzait shel musaf atta vechartanu umippene chataenu veet musefe yom mikra kodesh hazze naase venakriv lefanecha kemitzvat retzonecha kulei. elohenu velohe avotenu mechol laavonotenu beyom tzom hakkippurim hazze meche vehaaver peshaenu kulei ad umibbaladecha en lanu melech mochel vesoleach vechulei. elohenu velohe avotenu meloch al kol haolam kullo bichvodecha vehinnase al kol haaretz bikarecha vehofa bahadar geon ezzecha vechulei ad umalchuto bakkol mashala. kaddeshenu bemitzvotecha veten chelkenu betoratecha vesabbeenu mittuvecha vesammechenu bishuatecha vetaher libbenu leavdecha beemet udevarcha kulei ad baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael veyom hakkippurim. nahagu haam bechol tefillot hammusafin keshehu omer kemo shekkatavta alenu betoratecha al yede moshe avdecha mazkir karbenot oto hayyom kemo shehem ketuvim battora vekore otam happesukim. veim lo hizkir kevan sheamar kemo shekkatavta alenu betoratecha shuv eno tzarich:
Mishneh Torah, The Order of Prayer 4: Elohenu velohe avotenu tavo lefanecha tefillatenu veal titallam mittechinnatenu sheen anu azze fanim ukeshe oref shennomar lefanecha tzaddikim anachnu velo chatanu aval anachnu vaavotenu ashamnu bagadnu gazalnu dibbarnu dofi heevinu vehirshanu zadnu chamasnu kulei. ad ki emet asita vaanachnu hirshanu. ma nomar lefanecha Adonai elohenu yoshev marom uma nesapper lefanecha shochen shechakim halo hannistarot vehanniglot atta yodea. atta yodea raze olam vetaalumot sitre kol chay atta chofes kol chadre vaten uvochen kelayot valev en kol davar nelam mimmekka veen nistar minneged enecha. uvechen yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu shettimchol lanu al kol chattotenu utechapper lanu al kol avonotenu vetislach lanu al kol peshaenu. al chet shechatanu lefanecha beones veal chet shechatanu lefanecha bivli daat. al chet shechatanu lefanecha begaluy veal chet shechatanu lefanecha bedaat uvemirma. al chet shechatanu lefanecha beharehor hallev veal chet shechatanu lefanecha bevidduy pe. al chet shechatanu lefanecha bezadon veal chet shechatanu lefanecha bechozek yad. al chet shechatanu lefanecha betumat sefatayim veal chet shechatanu lefanecha beyetzer hara. al chet shechatanu lefanecha beyodim veal chet shechatanu lefanecha belo yodim. al chet shechatanu lefanecha vechachash uvechazav veal chet shechatanu lefanecha belashon hara. al chet shechatanu lefanecha bemarit haayin veal chet shechatanu lefanecha beneshech uvemarbit. al chet shechatanu lefanecha besiach siftotenu veal chet shechatanu lefanecha beenayim ramot. al chet shechatanu lefanecha befitchon pe veal chet shechatanu lefanecha betzaade raglayim. al chet shechatanu lefanecha bikfitzat yad veal chet shechatanu lefanecha beratzon uvedaat. al chet shechatanu lefanecha bishgaga veal chet shechatanu lefanecha betimhon levav. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem chattat. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem ola. (al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem karban). al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem asham vadday. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem asham taluy. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem karban ole veyored. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem ase. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem lo taase) shennitteku laase. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem mita bide shamayim. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem karet. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem malkot. al chataim sheanu chayyavin alehem arba mitot bet din sekila serefa hereg vechenek. al haggeluyim lanu veal sheenan geluyim lanu haggeluyim lanu kevar amarnum lefanecha Adonai elohenu vesheenam geluyim lanu kol chataenu atta yodea kol hannistarot kakkatuv hannistarot laAdonai elohenu vehanniglot lanu ulevanenu ad olam vechulei. ki atta salchan leyisrael min haolam umocholan leshivte yeshurun umibbaladecha en lanu melech mochel vesoleach. elohay ad shello notzarti eni cheday veachshav shennotzarti keillu lo notzarti afar ani bechayyay kal vachomer bemitati hare ani lefanecha Adonai elohay kichli male vusha uchelimma yehi ratzon millefanecha shello echeta od uma shechatati meche berachamecha harabbim aval lo al yede yissurin. yihyu leratzon imre fi vehegyon libbi lefanecha Adonai tzuri vegoali.

Kasseder hazze mitvadde bearvit shacharit umusaf umincha ben yachid ben sheliach tzibbur. ella shehayyachid omer vidduy ze achar tefillato achar sheggomer sim shalom kodem sheyyafsia shalosh pesiot usheliach tzibbur omro betoch beracha emtzait kodem sheyyomar elohenu velohe avotenu mechol laavonotenu mitvadde vidduy kasseder hazze veachar kach omer mechol laavonotenu beyom tzom hakkippurim:

Binila mitvadde kasseder hazze. ma nomar lefanecha yoshev marom kulei ki avonotenu rabbu millimnot kulei ma anu me chayyenu me chasdenu ma tzidkenu ma maasenu ma nomar lefanecha Adonai elohenu halo kol haggibborim keayin lefanecha veanshe hashshem kelo hayu vachachamim kivli madda unevonim kivli hasekel ki kol maasenu tohu vime chayyenu hevel lefanecha kakkatuv umotar haadam min habbehema ayin ki hakkol havel. aval atta hivdalta enosh merosh vattakkirehu laamod lefanecha ki mi yomar lecha ma taase veim yitzdak ma yitten lach vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu et yom hakkippurim hazze ketz mechila lechol chattotenu lemaan nechdal meoshek yadenu venashuv laasot chukke retzonecha belev shalem kaddavar shenneemar dirshu Adonai behimmatzo kerauhu bihyoto karov yaazov rasha darko veish aven machshevotav veyashov el Adonai virachamehu veel elohenu ki yarbe lisloach. veatta eloah selichot tov umetiv channun verachum erech appayim verav chesed marbe lehetiv rotze bitshuvatan shel reshaim veen atta chafetz bemitatan kakkatuv chay ani neum Adonai im echpotz bemot harasha ki im beshuv rasha middarko vechaya shuvu shuvu middarchechem haraim velamma tamutu bet yisrael. hashivenu vekabbelenu umechol lanu uselach kegodel chasdecha. yihyu leratzon imre fi vehegyon libbi lefanecha Adonai kulei. osho shalom vechulei:
Mishneh Torah, The Order of Prayer 5: Varuch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hazzan et haolam kullo betuvo bechen uvechesed uverachamim umefarnes lakkol kaamur poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chay ratzon umechin mazon lechol beriyyotav asher bara baruch atta Adonai hazzan et hakkol. node lecha Adonai elohenu unevarechcha malkenu ki hinchalta et avotenu eretz chemda tova urechava berit vetora al shehotzetanu meeretz mitzrayim ufeditanu mibbet avadim al toratcha shellimmadtanu al chukke retzoncha shehodatanu al kullam Adonai elohenu anu modim lach umevarchim et shimcha kaamur veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha al haaretz hattova asher natan lach baruch atta Adonai al haaretz veal hammazon. rachem Adonai elohenu al yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal tziyyon mishkan kevodecha veal habbayit haggadol vehakkadosh shennikra shimcha alav umalchut david meshichecha tachazir limkomah beyamenu uvene yerushalayim bekarov kaasher dibbarta baruch atta Adonai bone berachamav et yerushalayim. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hael avinu malkenu addirenu borenu goalenu kedoshenu kedosh yaakov hammelech hattov vehammetiv shebbechol yom vayom gomlenu chen vachesed verachamim vechol tov. harachaman yishtabbach ledor dorim. harachaman yitpaar lenetzach netzachim. harachaman yezakkenu limot hammashiach ulevinyan bet hammikdash ulechayye haolam habba. migdol yeshuot malko vegomer kefirim rashu veraevu vegomer hodu laAdonai ki tov ki leolam chasdo:

Hammaftir bannavi mevarech lefaneha baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar binviim tovim veratza bedivreyihem hanneemarim beemet. baruch atta Adonai habbocher battora uvemoshe avdo uveyisrael ammo uvinvie haemet vehatztzedek. umevarech leachareha baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam tzur kol haolamim tzaddik bechol haddorot hael hanneeman haomer veosho medabber umekayyem asher kol devarav emet vatzedek neeman atta hu Adonai elohenu veneemanim devarecha vedavar echad middevarecha achor lo yashuv rekam ki el neeman atta baruch atta Adonai hael hanneeman bechol devarav. rachem al tziyyon ki hi bet chayyenu velaagumat nefesh (toshia) mehera veyamenu vetivne mehera baruch atta Adonai bone yerushalayim. et tzemach david avdecha mehera tatzmiach vekarno tarum bishuatecha baruch atta Adonai magen david. al hattora veal haavoda veal hanneviim veal yom hammanoach hazze shennatatta lanu Adonai elohenu likdushsha lechavod uletifaret al hakkol anu mevarchin shimcha baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat. uveyom tov hu omer veal yom tov mikra kodesh hazze shennatatta lanu lesashon ulesimcha baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim. veim haya shabbat veyom tov kolel shenehem vechotem mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim. kannosach shehu chotem battefilla bivracha emtzait beoto hayyom kach hu chotem bivracha acharona zo.

(Hainyanot shennahagu rov haam likrot min hanneviim bechol shabbat veshabbat umaftirin bahen veellu hen:) bereshit. hen avdi etmach bo ad elle haddevarim asitim velo azavtim bishaya. toldot noach. ranni akara lo yalada ad hattu aznechem ulechu elay bishaya. lech lecha. veel mi tedammeyuni veeshve ad ki ani Adonai eenem elohe yisrael bishaya. vayyera elav. veishsha achat minneshe vene hanneviim ad vattissa et benah vattetze bimlachim. vayyihyu chayye sara. techillat hassefer ad yechi adoni hammelech leolam bimlachim. toldot yitzchak. massa devar Adonai el yisrael beyad malachi ad vearva laAdonai minchat vegomer bitre asar. vayyetze yaakov. veammi teluim limshuvati ad uvenavi heela bitre asar. vayyishlach yaakov. chazon ovadya ad sof sifro bitre asar. vayyeshev yaakov. al shelosha pishe yisrael ad arye shaag mi lo yira bitre asar. vayhi mikketz. vayyikatz shelomo vehinne chalom ad vayhi hammelech shelomo melech bimlachim. vayyiggash elav. veatta ven adam kach lecha etz echad ad veyadu haggoyim ki ani Adonai bichezkel. vaychi yaakov. vayyikrevu yeme david lamut ad ushelomo yashav al kisse david aviv bimlachim. veelle shemot. ben adam hoda et yerushalami ad vayyetze lach shem bichezkel. vaera. (velo yihye od levet) yisrael ad bayyom hahu atzmiach keren levet yisrael bichezkel. bo el paro. massa mitzrayim ad asher bercho Adonai tzevaot bishaya. vayhi beshallach. shirat devora min vayyachna elohim ad vattishkot haaretz arbaim shana beshoftim. vayyishma yitro. bishnat mot hammelech uzziyyahu ad lemarbe hammisra bishaya. veelle hammishpatim. haddavar asher haya el yirmeyahu ad lo yikkaret ish leyonadav ben rechav beyirmeya. veyikchu li. vaAdonai natan chachma lishlomo ad veshachanti betoch bene yisrael bimlachim. veatta tetzavve. hagged et (bene) [bet] yisrael et habbayit ad veratziti etchem bichezkel. ki tissa. udevar Adonai hayta el eliyyahu ad vayyirkav achav vayyelech bimlachim. vayyakhel. vayyishlach hammelech shelomo vayyikkach et chiram mitztzor ad vattittom melechet bimlachim. veelle fekude. vayyaas chirom ad vehappotot ledaltot habbayit. vayyikra. am zu yatzarti li ad ko amar Adonai melech yisrael bishaya. tzav et aharon. olotechem sefu al zivchechem ad veelle chafatzti neum Adonai beyirmeyahu. vayhi bayyom hashshemini. vayyosef od david et kol bachur beyisrael ad kol asher bilvavcha bimlachim. ishsha ki tazria. veish ba mibbaal shalisha ad vayyelech itto kivrat aretz bimlachim. zot tihye. vearbaa anashim (umedalleg) ad velo hishlicham meal panav bimlachim. achare mot. hatishpot hatishpot ad venichalt bach leene haggoyim bichezkel. kedoshim tihyu. bau anashim mizzikne yisrael ad tzevi hi lechol haaratzot bichezkel. emor el hakkohanim. vehakkohanim haleviyyim bene tzadok ad kol nevela uterefa bichezkel. behar sinay. Adonai uzzi umaezzi ad refaeni Adonai veerafe beyirmeya. im bechukkotay. hinnave al roe yisrael ad vehitztzaltim miyyad haovdim bahem bichezkel. bemidbar sinay. vehaya mispar bene yisrael ad veerastich li beemuna bitre asar. naso. vayhi ish echad mitztzara ad vayyigdal hannaar vayvarachehu Adonai beshoftim. behaalotcha. ranni vesimchi bat tziyyon ad yede zerubbavel yissedu habbayit bitre asar. shelach lecha. vayyishlach yehoshua bin nun ad vegam namogu kol yshve vegomer bihoshua. vayyikkach korach. vayyomer shemuel el haam ad ki lo yittosh Adonai et ammo bishmuel. zot chukkat hattora. veyiftach haggiladi ad miyyamim yamima beshoftim. vayyar balak. vehaya sheerit yaakov ad vehatzenea lechet im elohecha bitre asar. pinchas. veyad Adonai hayta el eliyyahu ad vayyakam vayyelech achare eliyyahu bimlachim. rashe hammattot. vayyitten moshe lematte vene reuven ad mechallek et haaretz bihoshua. elle mase. ellu hannechalot ad vayyittenu vene yisrael lalviyyim bihoshua. elle haddevarim. asher dibber Adonai el yisrael ad vihyitem li leam beyirmeya. vaetchannan. vaetpallel el Adonai achare tet et sefer hammikna ad sadot bakkesef yiknu beyirmeya. vehaya ekev. haloch vekarata veazne yerushalomi ad vehitbarchu vo kol goyim uvo yithallalu beyirmeya. ree anochi. hinne yamim baim neum Adonai vahakimoti ad im yissater ish bammistarim beyirmeya. shoftim. vayhi kaasher zaken shemuel ad vayyomer shemuel el anshe yisrael lechu bishmuel. ki tetze. vayyaasfu felishtim et machanehem ad vaAdonai yihye immach bishmuel. vehaya ki tavo. az yivne yehoshua mizbeach ad velo haya kayyom hahu bihoshua. attem nitztzavim. veyeesof yehoshua et kol shivte yisrael ad keramim vezetim asher lo netatem bihoshua. haazinu. velakachti ani mitztzammeret haerez ad vehashivu vichyu bichezkel. vezot habberacha. vayhi achare mot moshe eved Adonai umedalleg ad vayhi Adonai et yehoshua bihoshua. kol shabbat shekkorin bah shete parashiyyot maftirin bah meinyan parasha acharona vezo hamminhag berov hammekomot. vechen nahagu rov haam lihyot maftirin benechamot yeshayahu meachar tisha beav ad rosh hashshana. beshabbat sheachar tisha beav nachamu nachamu ammi. bashsheniyya vattomer tziyyon. bashshelishit aniyya soara. barviit anochi anochi hu menachemchem. bachamishit kumi ori. bashshishshit ranni akara. bashsheviit sos asis baAdonai:
