Mishneh Torah, The Sanhedrin and the Pen:
Mitzvat ase shel tora lemannot shoftim veshotrim bechol medina umedina uvechol pelech ufelech shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 18)</small> "shoftim veshotrim titten lecha bechol shearecha". shoftim ellu haddayyanim hakkevuin bevet din uvaale dinin baim lifnehem. shotrim ellu baale makkel uretzua vehem omdim lifne haddayyanin hamesabbevin bashshevakim uvarchovot veal hachanuyyot letakken hashshearim vehammiddot ulehakkot kol meavvet vechol maasehem al pi haddayyanim vechol sheyyiru bo iuut davar meviin oto levet din vedanin oto kefi risho: 
En anu chayyavin lehaamid batte dinim bechol pelech ufelech uvechol ir vair ella beeretz yisrael bilvad. aval bechutza laaretz enan chayyavin lehaamid bet din bechol pelech ufelech shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 18)</small> "titten lecha bechol shearecha asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lishvatecha": 
Kamma batte dinin kevuin yihyu beyisrael vechamma yihye minyanan. kovin battechilla bet din haggadol bammikdash. vehu hannikra sanhedri gedola. uminyanam shivim veechad. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 11 16)</small> "esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael" umoshe al gabbehen shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 11 16)</small> "vehityatztzevu sham immach" hare shivim veechad. haggadol bechachma shebbechullan moshivin oto rosh alehen vehu rosh hayeshiva vehu shekkorin oto hachachamim nasi bechol makom vehu haomed tachat moshe rabbenu. umoshivin haggadol shebbashshivim mishne larosh veyoshev mimino vehu hannikra av bet din ushear hashshivim yoshvin lefanav kefi shenehem uchefi maalatam. kol haggadol mechavero bechachma yihye karov lannasi missemolo yoter mechavero. vehem yoshvin bichmo chatzi goren beiggul kede sheyyihye hannasi im av bet din roin kullan. veod maamidin shene batte dinin shel esrim ushelosha esrim ushelosha echad al petach haazara veechad al petach har habbayit. umaamidin bechol ir vair miyyisrael sheyyesh bah mea veesrim o yoter sanhedri ketanna veyoshevet beshaar hair shenneemar <small>(Amos 5 15)</small> "vehatztzigu vashshaar mishpat". vechamma yihye minyanam esrim ushelosha dayyanim vehaggadol bechachma shebbechullan rosh alehen vehashshear yoshvin beiggul kemo chatzi goren kede sheyyehe harosh roe et kullan: 
Ir sheen bah mea veesrim maamidin bah shelosha dayyanim sheen bet din pachot mishshelosha kede sheyyehe bahen rov umiut im hayta benehen machloket bedin min haddinin: 
Kol ir sheen bah shene chachamim gedolim echad rauy lelammed ulehorot bechol hattora kullah veechad yodea lishmoa veyodea lishl ulehashiv en moshivin bah sanhedrin af al pi sheyyesh bah alafim miyyisrael: 
Sanhedrin sheyyesh bah shenayim ellu echad rauy lishmoa veechad rauy ledabber hare zo sanhedrin. hayu bah shelosha hare zo benonit. hayu bah arbaa yodim ledabber hare zo sanhedri chachama: 
Kol sanhedri ketanna moshivin lifnehen shalosh shurot shel talmide chachamim bechol shura veshura esrim ushelosha ish. shura rishona kerova lassanhedrin. veshura sheniyya lematta hemenna. ushelishit lematta hemenna. vechol shura veshura yoshvin bah lefi maalatan bechachma: 
Im nechleku hassanhedrin vehutzrechu lismoch echad lehosif al minyanan somchin min harishona gadol shebbah veharishon shebbeshura sheniyya ba veyoshev besof shura harishona kede lemalleot chesronah veharishon shebbashshelishit ba veyoshev besof shura sheniyya. uvorrin lahen echad mishshear hakkahal umoshivin oto besof shura shelishit. vechen im tzarchu lismoch sheni o shelishi al hasseder hazze hem osim: 
Kol makom sheyyesh bo sanhedrin yihyu sham shene sofre dayyanim omdin lifnehem echad min hayyamin veechad min hassemol. echad kotev divre hamechayyevin veechad kotev divre hamezakkim: 
Velamma en [maamidin] sanhedrin ella beir sheyyesh bah mea veesrim. kede sheyyihye mehen sanhedrin shel esrim ushelosha veshalosh shurot shel esrim ushelosha vaasara batlanin shel bet hakkeneset. ushene sofrim ushene chazzanim ushene baale dinin. ushene edim ushene zommin. ushene zomme zommin. ushene gabbae tzedaka veod echad kede sheyyihyu shelosha lechallek tzedaka. verofe umman. velavlar. umelammed tinokot. hare mea veesrim:

En maamidin besanhedrin ben bigdola ben biktanna ella anashim chachamim unevonim. muflagin bechachmat hattora baale dea merubba. yodim ketzat mishshear chachmot kegon refuot vecheshbon utekufot umazzalot veitztagninut vedarche hameonnim vehakkosmim vehamechashshefim vehavele avoda zara vechayyotze beellu kede sheyyihyu yodim ladun otam. veen maamidin besanhedrin ella kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim hameyuchasim haruyim lehassi lichhunna. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 11 16)</small> "vehityatztzevu sham immach" bedomin lecha bechachma uveyira uveyachas: 
Umitzva lihyot besanhedrin gedola kohanim uleviyyim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 9)</small> "uvata el hakkohanim haleviyyim". veim lo matzu afillu hayu kullam yisreelim hare ze muttar: 
En maamidin bechol hassanhedrin lo zaken muflag beshanim velo saris mippene sheyyesh bahen achzariyyut. velo mi sheen lo banim kede sheyyehe rachaman: 
Ven moshivin melech yisrael besanhedrin sheasur lachlok alav velamrot et devaro. aval moshivin kohen gadol im haya rauy bechachma: 
Malche bet david af al pi sheen moshivin otam besanhedrin yoshvin vedanim hem et haam. vedanim otam im yesh alehen din. aval malche yisrael en danin veen danin otam lefi sheen nichnaim ledivre tora shemma tavo mehen takkala: 
Keshem shebbet din menukkin betzedek kach tzerichin lihyot menukkin mikkol mume hagguf. vetzarich lehishtaddel velivdok ulechappes sheyyihyu kullan baale seva. baale koma. baale mare. nevone lachash. vesheyyedu berov halleshonot kede shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturgeman: 
Bet din shel shelosha af al pi sheen medakdekin bahen bechol ellu haddevarim tzarich sheyyehe bechol echad mehen shiva devarim veellu hen. chachma. vaanava. veyira. vesinat mamon. veahavat haemet. veahavat habberiyyot lahen. uvaale shem tov. vechol ellu haddevarim meforashin hen battora. hare hu omer <small>(Devarim 1 13)</small> "anashim chachamim unevonim" hare baale chachma amur. <small>(Devarim 1 13)</small> "viduim leshivtechem" ellu sheruach habberiyyot nocha mehem. uvamme yihyu ahuvim labberiyyot bizman sheyyihyu baale ayin tova. venefesh shefala. vechevratan tova. vedibburan umassaan benachat im habberiyyot. ulehallan hu omer <small>(Shemot 18 21)</small> "anshe chayil" ellu shehen gibborim bemitzvot umedakdekim al atzmam vechovshin et yitzran ad shello yehe lahen shum genay velo shem ra vihe pirkan nae. uvichlal anshe chayil sheyyihye lahen lev ammitz lehatztzil ashuk miyyad oshko kainyan shenneemar <small>(Shemot 2 17)</small> "vayyakam moshe vayyoshian". uma moshe rabbenu anav af kol dayyan tzarich lihyot anav. <small>(Shemot 18 21)</small> "yire elohim" kemashmao. <small>(Shemot 18 21)</small> "sone vatza" af mamon shellahem enan nivhalin alav. velo rodfin lekabbetz hammamon. shekkol mi shehu nivhal lahon cheser yevoennu. <small>(Shemot 18 21)</small> "anshe emet" sheyyihyu rodfin achar hatztzedek mechamat atzman bedatan. ohavin et haemet vesonin et hechamas uvorchin mikkol mine heavel: 
Amru chachamim shemmibbet din haggadol hayu sholchim bechol eretz yisrael uvodkin kol mi sheyyimtzauhu chacham vire chata veanav veshafuy ufirko nae veruach habberiyyot nocha hemennu. osin oto dayyan beiro. umishsham maalin oto lefetach har habbayit umishsham maalin oto lefetach haazara. umishsham maalin oto levet din haggadol: 
Bet din shel shelosha shehaya echad mehen ger hare ze pasul. ad shettihye immo miyyisrael. haya echad mamzer afillu shelashtan mamzerim hare ellu kesherin ladun. vechen im haya kol echad mehem suma beechad meenav kasher ma sheen ken besanhedrin. aval hassuma bishte enav pasul lakkol: 
Af al pi sheen bet din pachot mishshelosha muttar leechad ladun min hattora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "betzedek tishpot amitecha". umiddivre sofrim ad sheyyihyu shelosha. ushenayim sheddanu en dinehen din: 
Echad shehaya mumche larabbim o shennatal reshut mibbet din hare ze muttar lo ladun yechidi aval eno chashuv bet din. veaf al pi shehu muttar mitzvat chachamim hu shemmoshiv immo acherim shehare amru al tehi dan yechidi sheen dan yechidi ella echad: 
Yesh leadam laasot din leatzmo im yesh beyado koach hoil vechaddat vechahalacha hu ose eno chayyav litroach velavo levet din af al pi shello haya sham hefsed binchasav illu nitacher uva levet din. lefichach im kibbel alav baal dino vehevio levet din vedarshu umatzu sheasa kahalacha vedin emet dan leatzmo en sotrin et dino: 
Af al pi shebbet din shel shelosha bet din shalem hu kol zeman shehen rabbim hare ze meshubbach. umutav sheyyechatech haddin beachad asar yoter measara utzerichin sheyyihyu hayyoshvim kullam sham bevet din talmide chachamim ureuyin: 
Veasur leadam chacham sheyyeshev baddin ad sheyyeda im mi yeshev shemma yitztaref im anashim sheenan hagunim venimtza bichlal kesher bogdim lo bichlal bet din:

Ad ematay yoshvin haddayyanim bedin. sanhedri ketanna uvet din shel shelosha yoshvin meachar tefillat hashshachar ad sof shesh shaot bayyom. aval bet din haggadol hayu yoshvin mittamid shel shachar ad tamid shel ben haarbayim. uveshabbatot veyamim tovim hayu yoshvin bevet hammidrash shebbehar habbayit: 
En bet din shel shivim veechad tzerichin sheyyihyu yoshvin kullan keechad bimkoman shebbammikdash. ella beet sheyyehu tzerichin lehitkabbetz mitkabbetzin kullan. uvishar haittot kol mi shehaya lo esek yetze laasot cheftzo vechozer vehu shello yifchatu meesrim ushelosha yoshvin tamid kol zeman yeshivatan. hutzrach echad mehen latzet hare ze mistakkel bachaverav hannisharim im yishshaaru sham esrim ushelosha yetze veim lav lo yetze ad sheyyavo acher: 
En matchilin et haddinin ballayla. mippi hashshemua lamdu shehaddinin kingaim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 5)</small> "kol riv vechol naga" ma reiyyat negaim bayyom bilvad af haddinin bayyom bilvad: 
Vechen en mekabbelin edut veen mekayyemin shetarot ballayla. uvedine mamonot im hitchilu bayyom muttar ligmor haddin ballayla: 
Hannechalot kedinin shenneemar bahen lechukkat mishpat. lefichach en mappilin nechalot ballayla: 
Shenayim shennichnesu levakker et hachole vetzivva bifnehem. kotvim veen osim din. veim hayu shelosha ratzu kotvin ratzu osin din. bamme devarim amurim bayyom. aval ballayla kotvin veen osin din: 
Kol bet din shel yisrael shehu hagun shechina immahem. lefichach tzerichin haddayyanim leshev beema veyira vaatifa vechoved rosh veasur lehakel rosh o lischok o lesapper besicha betela bevet din ella bedivre tora vechachma: 
Kol sanhedrin o melech o rosh gola sheheemidu lahen leyisrael dayyan sheeno hagun veeno chacham bechachmat hattora verauy lihyot dayyan. af al pi shehu kullo machamaddim veyesh bo tovot acherot hare ze sheheemido over belo taase. shenneemar lo takkiru fanim bammishpat. mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze medabber keneged hamemunne lehoshiv dayyanin. amru chachamim shemma tomar ish peloni nae oshivennu dayyan. ish peloni gibbor oshivennu dayyan. ish peloni kerovi oshivennu dayyan. ish peloni yodea bechol lashon oshivennu dayyan. nimtza mezakke et hachayyav umechayyev et hazzakkay lo mippene shehu rasha ella mippene sheeno yodea. lechach neemar <small>(Devarim 1 17)</small> "lo takkiru fanim bammishpat". veod amru kol hammaamid leyisrael dayyan sheeno hagun keillu hekim matztzeva shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 22)</small> "velo takim lecha matztzeva asher sane Adonai elohecha". uvimkom talmide chachamim keillu nata ashera shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 21)</small> "lo titta lecha ashera kol etz etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha". vechen amru chachamim <small>(Shemot 20 20)</small> "lo taasun itti elohe chesef" eloah habba bishvil kesef vezahav ze haddayyan shemminnuhu mippene ashro bilvad: 
Kol dayyan shennatan mamon kede sheyyitmanne asur laamod mippanav. vetziuu chachamim lehakel oto ulezalzel bo. veamru chachamim shehattallit shemmitattef bah tehi beenecha kemirdaat shel chamor: 
Kach haya derech chachamim harishonim borchin millehitmannot. vedochakin atzman harebe shello yeshvu baddin ad sheyyedu sheen sham rauy kemotam vesheim yimmanu min haddin tekalkel hashshura. af al pi chen lo hayu yoshvin baddin ella ad shemmachbidin alehem et haam vehazzekenim ufotzrim bahen:

Echad bet din haggadol veechad sanhedrin ketanna o bet din shel shelosha tzarich sheyyihye echad mehen samuch mippi hassamuch. umoshe rabbenu samach yehoshua bayyad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 27 23)</small> "vayyismoch et yadav alav vaytzavvehu". vechen hashshivim zekenim moshe rabbenu semacham vesharta alehen shechina. veotan hazzekenim samchu laacherim vaacherim laacherim venimtzeu hassemuchin ish mippi ish ad bet dino shel yehoshua vead bet dino shel moshe rabbenu. veechad hannismach mippi hannasi o mippi echad min hassemuchin afillu lo haya oto samuch bassanhedrin meolam: 
Vechetzad hi hassemicha ledorot. lo sheyyismechu yedehen al rosh hazzaken ella shekkorin lo rabbi veomrim lo hare at samuch veyesh lecha reshut ladun afillu dine kenasot: 
Veen somchin semicha shehi minnuy hazzekenim ledayyanut ella bishlosha vehu sheyyihye haechad mehen samuch mippi acherim kemo shebbearnu: 
En karuy elohim ella bet din shennismach beeretz yisrael bilvad vehem haanashim hachachamim haruyin ladun shebbadku otan bet din shel eretz yisrael uminnu otam vesamchu otan: 
Barishona haya kol mi shennismach somech letalmidav. vachachamim chalku kavod lehillel hazzaken vehitkinu shello yehe adam nismach ella birshut hannasi. veshello yehe hannasi somech ella im ken haya av bet din immo. veshello yihye av bet din somech ella im ken haya hannasi immo. aval shear hachavura yesh lechol echad mehem lismoch birshut hannasi. vehu sheyyihyu shenayim immo sheen semicha pachot mishshelosha: 
En somchin zekenim bechutza laaretz veaf al pi sheellu hassomchin nismechu beeretz yisrael. afillu hayu hassomchin baaretz vehannismach chutza laaretz en somchin. veen tzarich lomar im hayu hassomchin bechutza laaretz vehannismachin baaretz. hayu shenehem baaretz somchin oto af al pi sheeno im hassemuchim bemakom echad. ella sholchin lo o kotvin lo shehu samuch venotnin lo reshut ladun dine kenasot hoil ushenehem baaretz. vechol eretz yisrael shehechziku bah ole mitzrayim reuya lismicha: 
Yesh lassomchin lismoch afillu mea befaam achat. vedavid hammelech samach sheloshim elef beyom echad: 
Veyesh lahen lemannot kol mi sheyyirtzu lidvarim yechidim. vehu sheyyihye rauy lechol haddevarim. ketzad. chacham mufla sherauy lehorot lechol hattora kullah yesh levet din lismoch oto velitten lo reshut ladun velo lehorot beissur vehetter. o yittenu lo reshut beissur vehetter velo ladun dine mamonot. o yittenu reshut laze velaze aval lo ladun dine kenasot. o ladun dine kenasot aval lo lehattir bechorot bemumin. o yittenu lo reshut lehattir nedarim bilvad o lirot ketamim. vechen kol kayyotze bahen: 
Vechen yesh lassomchin litten reshut ad zeman velomar lannismach yesh lecha reshut ladun o lehorot ad sheyyavo hannasi lechan. o kol zeman sheen atta immanu bammedina. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Chacham mufla shehu suma beeno achat af al pi shehu rauy ledine mamonot en somchin oto ledine mamonot mippene sheeno rauy lechol haddevarim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hare shello haya beeretz yisrael ella somech echad moshiv shenayim betziddo vesomech shivim keechad o ze achar ze veachar kach yaase hu vehashshivim bet din haggadol veyismechu batte dinin acherim. nirin li haddevarim sheim hiskimu kol hachachamim shebbeeretz yisrael lemannot dayyanim velismoch otam hare ellu semuchim veyesh lahen ladun dine kenasot veyesh lahen lismoch laacherim. im ken lamma hayu hachachamim mitztaarin al hassemicha kede shello yibbatlu dine kenasot miyyisrael. lefi sheyyisrael mefuzzarin vei efshar sheyyaskimu kullan. veim haya sham samuch mippi samuch eno tzarich daat kullan ella dan dine kenasot lakkol shehare nismach mippi bet din. vehaddavar tzarich hechrea: 
Bet din shennismechu beeretz yisrael veyatzu chutza laaretz hare hem danim dine kenasot bechutza laaretz kederech sheddanim baaretz. shessanhedrin noheget baaretz uvechutza laaretz vehu sheyyihyu semuchim: 
Rashe galuyyot shebbevavel bimkom melech hen omdim. veyesh lahen lirdot et yisrael bechol makom veladun alehen ben ratzu ben lo ratzu shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 49 10)</small> "lo yasur shevet mihuda" ellu rashe galuyyot shebbevavel: 
Vechol dayyan harauy ladun shennatan lo rosh galut reshut ladun yesh lo reshut ladun bechol haolam af al pi shello ratzu baale dinin ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz af al pi sheeno dan dine kenasot. vechol dayyan harauy ladun shennatnu lo bet din shebbeeretz yisrael reshut ladun yesh lo reshut ladun bechol eretz yisrael uvaayarot haomdot al haggevulim af al pi shello ratzu baale dinin. aval bechutza laaretz en reshutan moelet lo lachof et baale dinin. af al pi sheyyesh lo ladun dine kenasot bechutza laaretz eno dan ella lemi sherotze ladun etzlo. aval lachof et baale dinin veladun lahem en lo reshut ad sheyyittol reshut merosh galut: 
Mi sheeno rauy ladun mippene sheeno yodea o mippene sheeno hagun sheavar rosh galut venatan lo reshut o shettau bet din venatnu lo reshut en harshut moelet lo kelum ad sheyyehe rauy. shehammakdish baal mum lammizbeach en hakkedushsha chala alav:

En maamidin melech ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad. veen osin sanhedri ketanna lechol shevet veshevet ulechol ir veir ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad. veen danin lo et hashshevet shehuddach kullo velo et nevi hashsheker velo et kohen gadol bedine nefashot ella bevet din haggadol. aval dine mamonot [shel kohen gadol] bishlosha. vechen en osin zaken mamre velo osin ir hanniddachat velo mashkin et hassota ella bevet din haggadol. veen mosifin al hair veal haazarot velo motziin lemilchemet harshut velimdidat hechalal ella al pi bet din haggadol. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 18 22)</small> "kol haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha": 
En danin dine nefashot befachot meesrim ushelosha shehen sanhedri ketanna ben dine nefashot shel adam ben dine nefashot shel behema. lefichach en danin shor hanniskal velo habbehema hannirbaat o harovea ella bevet din shel esrim ushelosha. afillu ari vedov uvardelas shehen bene tarbut veyesh lahen bealim shehemitu mitatan beesrim ushelosha. aval nachash shehemit echad horeg oto: 
Hammotzi shem ra en danin oto techilla ella bevet din shel esrim ushelosha mippene sheyyesh bedino tzad dine nefashot shemma yihye haddavar emet vetissakel habbat. lo neemnu divre habbaal uva haav letavo biknas dino bishlosha. uminnayin sheen danin dine nefashot ella beesrim ushelosha. af al pi sheddivre kabbala hen hare hu omer <small>(Bamidbar la 24)</small> "veshaftu haeda" <small>(Bamidbar la 25)</small> "vehitztzilu haeda" eda shofetet veeda matztzelet. eda shofetet vehen hamechayyevin. veeda matztzelet vehen hamezakkin. veen eda pachot measara hare esrim. umosifin shelosha kede shello yehe bet din shakul veyihye bo achare rabbim lehattot: 
Makkot bishlosha veaf al pi sheefshar sheyyamut keshemmalkin oto: 
Arifat haegla bachamishsha: 
Ibbur hachodesh bishlosha: 
Ibbur hashshana beshiva. vechol ellu semuchin kemo shebbearnu: 
Dine kenasot kegon gezelot vechabbalot vetashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha vehaones vehamefatte vechayyotze bahen en danin otam ella shelosha mumchim vehem hassemuchin beeretz yisrael. aval shear dine mamonot kegon hodaot vehalevaot enan tzerichin mumche ella afillu shelosha hedyotot vaafillu echad mumche dan otan. lefichach danin behodaot vehalevaot vechayyotze bahen bechutza laaretz. af al pi sheen bet din shel chutza laaretz elohim shelichut bet din shel eretz yisrael osin. veen lahen reshut ladun dine kenasot bishlichutan: 
En danin bet din shel chutza laaretz ella devarim hammetzuyin tamid veyesh bahen chesron kis. kegon hodaot vehalevaot umazzik mamon chavero. aval devarim sheen metzuyin af al pi sheyyesh bahen chesron kis kegon behema shechavla bachavertah. o devarim hammetzuyin aval en bahen chesron kis kegon tashlume kefel. en danin otan dayyane chutza laaretz. vechen kol hakkenasot shekkansu chachamim betokea lachavero uvesoter et chavero vechayyotze bahen en govin otan dayyane chutza laaretz. vechol hameshallem chatzi nezek en govin oto dayyane chutza laaretz chutz mechatzi nezek tzerorot mippene shehu mamon veeno kenas: 
Kol hannishshom keeved en govin oto dayyane chutza laaretz. lefichach adam shechaval bachavero en govin hannezek vehatztzaar vehabboshet shehu chayyav bahen dayyane chutza laaretz. aval shevet verippuy govin mippene sheyyesh bahen chesron kis. vechen horu haggeonim veamru shemmaasim bechol yom ligbot shevet verippuy bevavel: 
Behema shehizzika et haadam en govin nizko dayyane chutza laaretz mippene shehu davar sheeno matzuy. aval adam shehizzik behemat chavero meshallem nezek shalem bechol makom kemi shekkara kesuto o shavar kelav o kitztzetz netiotav. vechen behema shehizzika beshen veregel hoil vehi muedet lahen mittechillatah hare ze davar matzuy vegovin oto dayyane chutza laaretz. ben shehizzika behema acheret kegon shennitchakkecha bah o achla perot sheddarkah leachlan vechayyotze baze. ben shehizzika ochalin vechelim shehi chayyevet alehen nezek shalem hakkol govin dayyane chutza laaretz. aval im hayta tamma vehuada vehizzika kegon shennashcha o nagfa o ravtza o baata o nagcha en govin hannezek hazze hashshalem dayyane chutza laaretz sheen muad bechutza laaretz. vaafillu huad baaretz veyatza lechutza laaretz vehizzik en govin nizko mippene sheeno davar matzuy: 
Mippene ma en muad bechutza laaretz. lefi shetztzarich lehaid bo bifne bet din veen sham bet din ella hassemuchin baaretz. lefichach im hayu bet din bechutza laaretz keshem shehen danim dine kenasot bechutza laaretz kach meidim et habbehema bifnehem bechutza laaretz: 
Mi shegganav o gazal govin mimmennu hakkeren dayyane chutza laaretz aval en govin et hakkefel: 
Velo kol hameshallem al pi atzmo govin mimmennu dayyane chutza laaretz shehare happegam vehabboshet vehakkofer meshallem adam al pi atzmo kegon sheamar pittiti bitto shel peloni vehemit shori et peloni veen govin oto dayyane chutza laaretz: 
Dine geramot enan kiknasot vegovin otan vedanin bahen bechutza laaretz: 
Vechen din hammoser mamon chavero af al pi shello asa maase govin oto dayyane chutza laaretz: 
Minhag hayeshivot bechutza laaretz af al pi sheen govin sham kenas menaddin oto ad sheyyefayyes levaal dino o yaale immo ledin leeretz yisrael. vechevan sheyyitten lo shiur harauy lo mattirin nidduyo ben shennitpayyes baal dino ben shello nitpayyes. vechen im tafas hannizzak shiur ma sherauy lo littol en motziin oto miyyado: 
Yachid shehu mumche larabbim af al pi shehu dan dine mamonot yechidi en hahodaa befanav hodaa bevet din vaafillu haya samuch. aval hashshelosha af al pi sheenan semuchin vahare hen hedyotot veen ani kore bahem elohim hare hahodaa bifnehem hodaa bevet din. vechen hakkofer bifnehem veachar kach bau edim huchzak kafran veeno yachol lachzor veliton kemo shebbearnu. kelalo shel davar hare hen leinyan hodaot vehalevaot vechayyotze bahen kevet din hassamuch lechol haddevarim:

Kol dayyan sheddan dine mamonot vetaa im taa baddevarim haggeluyim vehayeduim kegon dinin hameforashin bammishna o baggemara chozer haddin umachzirin haddavar keshehaya vedanin bo kahalacha. veim i efshar lehachezir kegon shehalach ze shennatal hammamon shello kaddin limdinat hayyam o shehaya allam o shettimme davar tahor o shehora bichshera shehi terefa veheechilah lakkelavim vechayyotze baze hare ze patur milleshallem. af al pi sheggaram lehazzik lo nitkavven lehazzik: 
Taa beshikkul haddaat kegon davar shehu machloket tannaim o amoraim velo nifseka halacha keechad mehen beferush veasa keechad mehen velo yada shekkevar pashat hammaase bechol haolam kedivre haacher. im haya ze dayyan mumche venatal reshut merosh galut. o shello haya notel reshut aval kibbelu oto baale dinin alehen. hoil vehu mumche chozer haddin. veim i efshar lehachezir patur milleshallem. echad hannotel reshut merosh galut o hannotel reshut mibbet din shel yisrael beeretz yisrael aval lo bechutza laaretz kemo shebbearnu: 
Haya hattoe mumche velo natal reshut velo kibbelu oto baale dinin alehen. o shello haya mumche aval kibbelu oto baale dinin alehen ladun lahen kaddin vetaa beshikkul haddaat. im nasa venatan bayyad ma sheasa asuy vishallem mibbeto. im lo nasa venatan bayyad yachzor haddin. veim i efshar lehachezir yeshallem mibbeto: 
Aval mi sheeno mumche velo kibbelu oto baale dinin af al pi shennatal reshut hare ze bichlal baale zeroa veeno bichlal haddayyanin. lefichach en dinav din ben taa ben lo taa vechol echad mibbaale dinin im ratza chozer vedan bifne bet din. veim taa venasa venatan bayyad chayyav leshallem mibbeto vechozer velokeach mibbaal din ze shennatan lo shello kahalacha. veim en lo lehachezir o shettimme o sheheechil davar hammuttar lakkelavim yeshallem kedin kol gorem lehazzik shezze mitkavven lehazzik hu: 
Dayyan shettaa vechiyyev shevua lemi sheeno chayyav bah veasa ze peshara im baal dino kede shello yishshava veachar kach yada sheeno ben shevua. af al pi shekkanu miyyado al happeshara enah kelum shello kibbel alav litten lo o limchol lo ella kede sheyyippater mishshevua shechiyyevo bah hattoe vechol kinyan betaut chozer. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shenayim shennitatztzemu baddin echad omer nadun kan veechad omer naale levet din haggadol shemma yitu ellu haddayyanin veyotziu mamon shello kaddin kofin oto vedan beiro. veim amar kitvu utenu li mee ze taam dantuni shemma teitem kotvim venotnin lo veachar kach motziin mimmennu. veim hutzrach lishl davar mibbet din haggadol shebbirushalayim kotvim vesholchin veshoalin vedanin lahem beiram kefi ma sheyyavo bichtav bet din haggadol: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishar haddinin shezze toen veze toen o kesheamar hammalve nadun kan vehallo omer nelech levet din haggadol. aval im amar hammalve nelech levet din haggadol kofin et hallo veole immo shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 22 7)</small> "eved lo leish malve". vechen im taan ze shehizziko o gezalo veratza hattoen laalot kofin bet din shebbeiro et hannitan laalot immo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Bamme devarim amurim kesheyyihyu sham edim o reaya lannigzal o lannizzak o lammalve. aval taana rekanit en mechayyevin et hannitan latzet kelal ella nishba bimkomo veniftar: 
Vechen haddin bazzeman hazze sheen sham bet din gadol aval yesh mekomot sheyyesh bahen chachamim gedolim mumchin larabbim umekomot sheyyesh bahen talmidim sheenan kemotan. im amar hammalve nelech lemakom peloni shebbeeretz pelonit lifloni ufeloni haggadol venadun lefanav bedin ze. shekkofin et hallo veholech immo. vechen hayu maasim bechol yom bisfarad:

Echad mibbaale dinin sheamar ish peloni yadun li veamar baal dino peloni yadun li hare ellu shene haddayyanim shebberer ze echad veze echad hem borrim lahen dayyan shelishi ushelashtan danin lishnehen shemmittoch kach yetze haddin laamitto. afillu haya haechad shebbarru baale haddin chacham gadol vesamuch eno yachol lachof et baal dino sheyyadun etzel ze ella gam hu borer mi sheyyirtze: 
Mi shekkibbel alav karov o pasul ben lihyoto dayyan ben lihyoto ed alav. afillu kibbel echad min happesulim baavera kishne edim kesherim lehaid alav o kishlosha bet din mumchin ladun lo. ben shekkibbel al atzmo leabbed zechuyyotav velimchol ma shehaya toen al pihen. ben shekkibbel sheyyitten kol ma sheyyiton alav chavero beedut zo happasul o bedino. im kanu miyyado al ze eno yachol lachzor bo. veim lo kanu miyyado yachol lachzor bo ad sheyyiggamer haddin. nigmar haddin vehotzi hammamon bedin ze happasul o beeduto eno yachol lachzor: 
Vechen mi shennitchayyev lachavero shevua bevet din veamar lo hishshava li bechayye roshcha vehippater o hishshava li bechayye roshcha veetten lecha kol ma shettiton. im kanu miyyado eno yachol lachzor bo veim lo kanu miyyado yachol lachzor bo ad sheyyiggamer haddin. nigmar haddin venishba kemo sheamar lo eno yachol lachzor vechayyav leshallem: 
Vehu haddin lemi shennitchayyev shevuat hesset vahafachah. im kanu miyyado o im nishba ze shennehpecha alav eno yachol lachzor bo: 
Vehu haddin bemi shello haya chayyav shevua veamar eshshava lecha shevua. im kanu miyyado eno yachol lachzor bo. veim lo kanu miyyado af al pi shekkibbel bevet din chozer ad sheyyiggamer haddin veyishshava: 
Mi shennitchayyev bevet din vehevi edim o reaya lizchuto. soter et haddin vechozer haddin. af al pi shekkevar nigmar haddin kol zeman shehu mevi reaya soter. amru lo haddayyanim kol reayot sheyyesh lecha have mikkan vead sheloshim yom af al pi shehevi reaya leachar sheloshim yom soter et haddin. ma yaase im lo matza betoch sheloshim umatza leachar sheloshim: 
Aval im satam et taanotav eno soter. ketzad. amru lo yesh lecha edim amar en li edim. yesh lecha reaya amar en li reaya. vedanu oto vechiyyevuhu. kevan sheraa shennitchayyev amar kirvu peloni ufeloni vehaiduni o shehotzi reaya mittoch afundato en ze kelum veen mashgichin al edav veal reayato: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayta haraya etzlo vehaedim immo bammedina. aval im amar en li edim veen li reaya uleachar mikkan bau lo edim mimmedinat hayyam. o shehayta hachemet shel aviv sheyyesh sham hashshetarot mufkedet beyad acherim uva ze shehappikkadon etzlo vehotzi lo reayato. hare ze mevi vesoter. umippene ma soter mippene sheyyachol liton velomar ze sheamarti en li edim en li reaya mippene shello hayu metzuyin etzli. vechol zeman sheyyachol liton velomar ze sheamarti en li edim en li reaya mippene shello hayu metzuyin etzli o mippene kach vechach amarti en li edim veen li reaya vehaya mammash bidvarav hare ze lo satam taanotav vesoter. lefichach im peresh veamar en li edim kelal lo henna velo bimdinat hayyam velo reaya kelal lo beyadi velo beyad acherim eno yachol listor: 
Bamme devarim amurim begadol shennitchayyev vehevi reayot vehevi edim achar shessatam taanotav. aval yoresh shehu katan keshemmet morisho uvau alav teanot mechamat morisho achar shehigdil veamar en li edim veen li reaya veachar sheyyatza mibbet din chayyav amru lo acherim anu yodim leavicha edut shettistor bah din ze. o amar lo echad morishcha hifkid reaya zo. hare ze mevi miyyad vesoter sheen hayyoresh katan yodea kol reayot morisho: 
Mi shekkanu miyyado sheim lo yavo beyom peloni veyishshava yihye chavero neeman betaanato veyittol kol ma shettaan belo shevua. o sheim lo yavo beyom peloni veyishshava veyittol ibbed et zechuto veen lo kelum veyippater chavero. veavar hayyom velo ba nitkayyemu hattenaim veibbed et zechuto. veim hevi reaya shehaya anus beoto hayyom hare ze patur mikkinyan ze veyishshava kesheyyitbaennu chavero keshehaya mikkodem. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Bet din shennechleku miktzatam omrim zakkay umiktzatam omrim chayyav holchin achar harov. vezo mitzvat ase shel tora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 2)</small> "achare rabbim lehattot". bamme devarim amurim bedine mamonot uvishar dine asur umuttar vetame vetahor vechayyotze bahen. aval bedine nefashot im nechleku baze hachote im yehareg o lo yehareg. im hayu harov mezakkim zakkay veim hayu harov mechayyevin eno neherag ad sheyyihyu hamechayyevin yeter al hamezakkim shenayim. mippi hashshemua lamdu sheal ze hizhira tora veamra <small>(Shemot 23 2)</small> "lo tihye achare rabbim leraot". kelomar im harov notim leraa laharog lo tihye acharehem ad sheyyittu hattaya gedola veyosifu hamechayyevin shenayim. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 2)</small> "lintot achare rabbim lehattot" hattayatcha letova al pi echad leraa al pi shenayim. vechol ellu haddevarim kabbala hem: 
Bet din shel shelosha shennechleku shenayim omrim zakkay veechad omer chayyav hare ze zakkay. shenayim omrim chayyav veechad omer zakkay hare ze chayyav. echad omer zakkay veechad omer chayyav veechad omer eni yodea. o sheamru shenayim zakkay o chayyav vehashshelishi omer eni yodea yosifu haddayyanim shenayim. nimtzeu chamishsha nosim venotnim baddavar. amru shelosha mehem zakkay ushenayim omrim chayyav hare ze zakkay. amru shelosha chayyav ushenayim zakkay hare ze chayyav. amru shenayim mehem zakkay ushenayim mehem chayyav veechad omer eni yodea mosifin shenayim. aval im amru arbaa zakkay o chayyav veechad omer eni yodea. o sheamru shelosha zakkay veechad chayyav veamar echad eni yodea ben shehaya ze sheamar eni yodea hu sheamar eni yodea battechilla ben sheamar acher holchim achar harov. hayu mechetza lemechetza veechad omer eni yodea hare ellu mosifin shenayim acherim. vechen im nistappek haddavar mosifin veholchin ad shivim veechad. higgiu leshivim veechad veamru sheloshim vachamishsha chayyav usheloshim vachamishsha zakkay veechad omer eni yodea nosim venotnim immo ad sheyyachazor ledivre hatztzad haechad venimtzeu sheloshim veshishsha mezakkim o mechayyevin. veim lo chazar lo hu velo echad mehen hare haddavar safek umaamidin et hammamon bechezkat bealav: 
Kol mi sheamar eni yodea eno tzarich latet taam lidvarav ulehodia mee ze taam ba lo hassafek. kederech shemmare hamezakke mee ze taam mezakke vehamechayyev mee ze taam mechayyev:

Sannehedrin sheppatchu kullam bedine nefashot techilla veamru kullan chayyav hare ze patur ad sheyyihyu sham miktzat mezakkin sheyyehappechu bizchuto veyirbu hamechayyevin veachar kach yaharog: 
Sanhedri ketanna shennechleku bedine nefashot shenem asar omrim zakkay veachad asar omrim chayyav hare ze zakkay. shenem asar omrim chayyav veachad asar omrim zakkay o sheamru achad asar zakkay veachad asar chayyav veechad omer eni yodea afillu esrim ushenayim mezakkin o mechayyevin vehaechad omer eni yodea yosifu shenayim. ze sheamar eni yodea hare hu kemi sheeno shehare eno chozer umelammed chova venimtzeu achar hattosefet esrim vearbaa chutz mizze hammistappek. amru shenem asar zakkay ushenem asar chayyav hare ze zakkay. achad asar omrim zakkay ushelosha asar omrim chayyav af al pi shehaechad min harishonim omer eni yodea hare ze chayyav shehare hamechayyevin rabbu bishnayim. amru shenem asar zakkay ushenem asar chayyav veechad omer eni yodea mosifin shenayim acherim. vechen mosifin veholchin ad sheyyirbu hamezakkin echad vihe zakkay o yirbu hamechayyevin shenayim o yoter vihe chayyav. hayu ellu keneged ellu veechad omer eni yodea o shehayu hamechayyevin yoter echad bilvad mosifin veholchin ad shivim veechad. higgiu leshivim veechad sheloshim veshishsha omrim zakkay usheloshim vachamishsha omrim chayyav hare ze zakkay. sheloshim veshishsha omrim chayyav usheloshim vachamishsha omrim zakkay danim ellu keneged ellu ad sheyyire echad mehen divre chavero umezakkin oto o mechayyevin oto. veim lo raa gadol shebbaddayyanim omer nizdakken haddin ufotrin oto. sheloshim vachamishsha omrim chayyav usheloshim vachamishsha omrim zakkay veechad omer eni yodea potrin oto. arbaa usheloshim omrim zakkay veshishsha usheloshim omrim chayyav veechad omer eni yodea chayyav shehare rabbu hamechayyevin shenayim: 
Bet din haggadol shebba lahem machloket ben bedine nefashot ben bedine mamonot ben bedine tora. en mosifin alehen ella danin ellu keneged ellu veholchin achar harov shellahen. veim bedin echad min hanneheragin nechleku danin ellu keneged ellu ad sheyyifteruhu o yitchayyev:

Echad min haddayyanim bedine nefashot shehaya min hamezakkin o min hamechayyevin lo mippene sheamar davar hannire lo bedato ella nata achar divre chavero hare ze over belo taase. veal ze neemar <small>(Shemot 23 2)</small> "velo taane al riv lintot". mippi hashshemua lamdu shello tomar bishat minyan day sheeheye keish peloni ella emor ma shellefanecha: 
Uvichlal lav ze shello yachzor hamelammed zechut bedine nefashot lelammed chova shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 2)</small> "lo taane al riv lintot". bamme devarim amurim bishat massa umattan. aval bishat gemar din yesh lamlammed zechut lachzor ulehitmannot im hamechayyevim: 
Talmid shehaya mezakke umet roin oto keillu hu mezakke bimkomo: 
Amar echad yesh li lelammed alav zechut venishtattek o met kodem sheyyelammed zechut veyomar mee ze taam mezakke hare hu kemi sheeno: 
Shenayim sheamru taam echad afillu mishshene mikraot en nimnin ella keechad: 
Umippi hashshemua lamdu sheen matchilin bedine nefashot min haggadol shemma yismechu hashshear al dato velo yiru atzman kedain lachlok alav. ella yomar kol echad davar hannire lo bedato: 
Vechen en potchin bedine nefashot lechova ella lizchut. ketzad. omrim laze shechata im lo asita davar ze sheheidu bo alecha al tira middivrehem: 
Amar echad min hattalmidim bedine nefashot yesh li lelammed alav chova meshattekin oto. amar yesh li lelammed alav zechut maalin oto immahen lassanhedrin. im yesh mammash bidvarav shomin lo veeno yored mishsham leolam. veim en mammash bidvarav eno yored mishsham kol hayyom kullo. afillu amar hanniddon atzmo yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut shomin lo veole leminyan. vehu sheyyihye mammash bidvarav: 
Bet din shettau bedine nefashot vechiyyevu et happatur vegamru dino lechova venire lahem hattaam sheyyisteru bo et dino kede lezakkoto sotrin vechozrin vedanin oto. aval im tau ufatru et hamechuyyav hariga en sotrin et dino veen machazirin oto. bamme devarim amurim beshettau bedavar sheen hatztzedokin modin bo. aval im tau bedavar shehatztzedokin modin bo machazirin oto lechova. ketzad. amru habba al haerva shello kedarkah patur ufetaruhu machazirin oto umemitin oto. aval im amru hameare shello kedarkah patur ufetaruhu en machazirin oto. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ma ben dine mamonot ledine nofashot. dine mamonot bishlosha dine nefashot beesrim ushelosha. dine mamonot potchin ben lizchut ben lechova dine nefashot potchin lizchut kemo shebbearnu veen potchin lechova. dine mamonot mattin al pi echad ben lizchut ben lechova dine nefashot mattin al pi echad lizchut veal pi shenayim lechova. dine mamonot machazirin ben lizchut ben lechova vedine nefashot machazirin lizchut veen machazirin lechova kemo shebbearnu. dine mamonot hakkol reuyin lelammed zechut o chova ben haddayyanim ben hattalmidim vedine nefashot hakkol melammedin zechut vaafillu hattalmidim veen melammed chova ella haddayyanim. dine mamonot haddayyan hamelammed chova chozer umelammed zechut vehamelammed zechut chozer umelammed chova dine nefashot hamelammed chova chozer umelammed zechut aval hamelammed zechut eno yachol lachzor ulelammed chova ella bishat gemar din yesh lo lachzor ulehimmanot im hamechayyevin kemo shebbearnu. dine mamonot danin bayyom vegomrin ballayla dine nefashot danin bayyom vegomrin bayyom. dine mamonot gomrin bo bayyom ben lizchut ben lechova dine nefashot gomrin bo bayyom lizchut uvayyom shelleacharav lechova: 
Lefichach en danin dine nefashot lo erev shabbat velo erev yom tov shemma yitchayyev vei efshar lehargo lemachar veasur leannot et dino ulehannicho achar hashshabbat ella osrin oto ad echad beshabbat umatchilin bedino: 
Dine mamonot af al pi sheddanin otan bechol yom min hattora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 18 22)</small> "veshaftu et haam bechol et" middivrehem lamdu sheen danin beerev shabbat: 
Echad dine nefashot veechad dine malkiyyot veechad dine galut haddinim haellu shavim bahen ella shehammalkot bishlosha veen echad mehen beshor hanniskal chutz middavar echad sheddino beesrim ushelosha: 
Hammassit en dinav kishar dine nefashot. mechamnin lo et haedim. veeno tzarich hateraa kishar hanneheragin. veim yatza mibbet din zakkay veamar echad yesh li lelammed alav chova machazirin oto. yatza chayyav veamar echad yesh li lelammed alav zechut en machazirin oto. veen toanin lemassit. umoshivin bedino zaken vesaris umi sheen lo banim kede shello yerachamu alav. shehaachzariyyut al ellu shemmatin et haam achare hahevel rachamim hu baolam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "lemaan yashuv Adonai mecharon appo venatan lecha rachamim": 
Dine mamonot vechen hattumot vehattohorot matchilin min haggadol shebbaddayyanim veshomin et devarav. vedine nefashot matchilin min hatztzad veen shomin divre haggadol ella baacharona: 
Dine mamonot vechen hattumot vechen hattohorot haav uveno harav vetalmido monin otan bishnayim. vedine nefashot umakkot vekiddush hachodesh veibbur hashshana av uveno o harav vetalmido monin otan beechad: 
Ze sheanu monin haav im habben ben beechad ben bishnayim kegon shehaya haechad mehen bassanhedrin vehashsheni haya min hattalmidim sheamar yesh li lelammed zechut o chova shomin devarav venosin venotnin immo venimnin immo: 
Uvishat gemar din en gomrin et haddin bikrovim shehaddayyanin hakkerovim pesulin ledin kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Talmid shehaya chacham umevin vehaya mechussar kabbala hare rabbo moser lo hakkabbala shehu tzarich lah bedin ze vehu dan immo bedine nefashot: 
Hakkol kesherim ladun dine mamonot afillu ger vehu shettihye immo miyyisrael. veger dan et chavero hagger af al pi sheen immo miyyisrael vechen hammamzer vehassuma beachat meenav kasher ladun dine mamonot. aval bedine nefashot en danin otan ella kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim hammassiin lichhunna velo yihye echad mehen suma afillu beachat meenav kemo shebbearnu:

Ketzad danin dine nefashot. kesheyyavou edim levet din veomrim rainu peloni ze sheavar avera pelonit. omrin lahen makkirin attem oto hitretem bo. im amru en anu makkirin oto o nistappek lanu o shello hitru bo hare ze patur: 
Echad talmid chacham veechad am haaretz tzarich hateraa shello nittena hateraa ella lehavechin ben shogeg lemeziyid shemma shogeg haya. vechetzad matrin bo. omrin lo perosh o al taase shezzo avera hi vechayyav atta aleha mitat bet din o malkot. im perash patur. vechen im shatak o hirkin berosho patur. vaafillu amar yodea ani patur ad sheyyattir atzmo lemita veyomar al menat ken ani ose. veachar kach yehareg. vetzarich sheyyaavor veyaase techef lahateraa betoch kede dibbur. aval achar kede dibbur tzarich hateraa acheret. uven shehitra bo echad min haedim uven shehitra bo acher bifne edim afillu ishsha o eved afillu shama kol hammatre velo raahu vaafillu hitra beatzmo hare ze neherag: 
Amru haedim hayta lo hateraa umakkirin anu oto meayyemin bet din alehen. vechetzad meayyemin al iske nefashot. omrim lahen shemma tomru meomed umishshemua ed mippi ed mippi adam neeman shematem. o shemma en attem yodim shessofenu livdok etchem bidrisha vachakira. hevu yodim shello kedine mamonot dine nefashot. dine mamonot adam noten mamono umitkapper lo dine nefashot damo vedam zaro teluyin bo ad sof kol haolam shehare bekayin neemar <small>(Bereshit 4 10)</small> "kol deme achicha tzoakim" damo vedam zaro. lefichach nivra adam yechidi baolam lelammed shekkol hameabbed nefesh achat min haolam maalin alav keillu ibbed olam male vechol hamekayyem nefesh achat baolam maalin alav keillu kiyyem olam male. hare kol bae olam betzurat adam harishon hem nivraim veen pene kol echad mehen domin lifne chavero. lefichach kol echad veechad yachol lomar bishvili nivra haolam. shemma tomru ma lanu uletzara zo halo kevar neemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "vehu ed o raa o yada". o shemma tomru ma lanu lachov bedamo shel ze vahalo kevar neemar <small>(Mishlei 11 10)</small> "uvaavod reshaim rinna". im amdu bedivrehen machnisin et haggadol shebbaedim uvodkim oto bidrisha vachakira kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot edut. im nimtzet eduto mechuvvenet machnisin et hashsheni uvodkin oto karishon. afillu hayu mea edim bodkin kol echad veechad bidrisha vachakira. nimtzeu divre kol haedim mechuvvanim potchin lizchut kemo shebbearnu. veomrim im lo chatata al tira middivrehem vedanin oto. im matzu lo zechut petaruhu veim lo matzu lo zechut osrin oto ad lemachar. uvo bayyom mizdavvegin hassanhedrin zugot zugot leayyen bedino. umemaatin bemaachol veen shotin yayin kol oto hayyom. venosin baddavar kol hallayla kol echad veechad im zug shello o im atzmo beveto. velammochorat mashkimin levet din. hamezakke omer ani hu hamezakke umezakke ani bimkomi vehamechayyev omer ani hu hamechayyev umechayyev ani bimkomi o chazarti bi vaani mezakke. veim tau baddavar velo yadu mi hem shechiyyevu o zikku mittaam echad sheenan nechshavin ella keechad kemo shebbearnu. hare sofre haddayyanin mazkirin otan shehare kotvin taam shel kol echad veechad. umatchilin bedino. im matzu lo zechut petaruhu veim hutzrechu lehosif mosifin. rabbu hamechayyevin venitchayyev motziin oto lehargo. vmakom shehorgin bo bet din haya chutz levet din verachok mibbet din. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 14)</small> "hotze et hamekallel el michutz lammachane". veyerae li sheyyihye rachok kemo shishsha milin kemo shehaya ben bet dino shel moshe rabbenu shehaya lifne petach ohel moed uven machane yisrael: 
Mishshennigmar dino en mashhin oto ella yehareg beyomo. afillu hayta ubbara en mamtinin lah ad shetteled. umakkin otah keneged bet haherayon ad sheyyamut havvalad techilla. aval im yashva al hammashber mamtinin lah ad shetteled. vechol ishsha shettehareg muttar lehanot bisarah: 
Mi sheyyatza lehareg vehaya zivcho zavuach en horgin oto ad shemmazzin alav middam chattato vaashamo. veim nigmar dino vaadayin lo nishchat hazzevach en mamtinin lo ad sheyyakrivu alav karbano sheen meannin et dino:

Mi shennigmar dino lemita motziin oto mibbet din veechad omed al petach bet din vehassudarin beyado vehassus rachok mimmennu. vehakkaroz yotze lefanav peloni yotze lehareg bemita pelonit al sheavar avera pelonit bemakom peloni bizman peloni ufeloni ufeloni edav mi sheyyodea lo zechut yavo vilammed alav. amar echad yesh li lelammed alav zechut ze menif bassudarin veze harochev al hassus ratz umachazir et hanniddon levet din. im nimtza lo zechut potrin oto veim lo yachzor veyetze lahariga. amar hu beatzmo yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut af al pi sheen mammash bidvarav machazirin oto paam rishona usheniyya. shemma mippene happachad nistattemu taanotav uchesheyyachazor levet din tityashshev dato veyomar taam. hechziruhu velo nimtza mammash bidvarav motziin oto paam shelishit. amar bashshelishit yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut im yesh mammash bidvarav machazirin oto afillu kamma peamim. lefichach mosrin lo shene talmide chachamim sheshshomin devarav badderech im yesh mammash bidvarav machazirin oto veim lav en machazirin oto. im lo nimtza lo zechut motziin oto. veedav hem hahorgin oto bechol mita sheyyitchayyev bah. verotzeach shello haraguhu edav chayyavin lahamito beyad kol adam. rachok mimmekom hahariga keeser ammot omer lo hitvadde shekken derech kol hammumatin mitvaddin vechol hammitvadde yesh lo chelek laolam habba. im eno yodea lehitvaddot omrim lo emor tehe mitati kappara al kol avonotay. afillu yada beatzmo sheshsheker heidu alav kach hu mitvadde: 
Veachar shemmitvadde mashkin oto koret shel levona bechos shel yayin kede shettittaref dato alav veyishtakker. veachar kach yehareg bammita shehu chayyav bah: 
Ze hayyayin vehallevona vehaeven sheyyissakel bah hanniskal. vehassayif sheyyehareg bo hanneherag. vehassudar shechonkin bo hannechnak. vehaetz shettolin alav hannitle. vehassudarin shemmenifin bah lifne haruge bet din. vehassus sheratz lehatztzilo. hakkol bain mishshel tzibbur. umi sheyyirtze lehitnaddev yavo veyitnaddev: 
En bet din yotzin achar hanneherag. vechol bet din shehargu nefesh asurim leechol kol oto hayyom hare ze bichlal lo tochlu al haddam. veen mavrin hakkerovim al haruge bet din mishshum lo tochlu al haddam. udevarim ellu asurin veen bahen malkot: 
Mi shennitchayyev mita bechullo shel moed meayyenin bedino veochlin bet din veshotin veachar kach gomrin et dino samuch lishkiat hachamma vehorgin oto: 
Haruge bet din en mitabbelin alehen. uvain kerovehen veshoalim et shelom haedim veet shelom haddayyanim lehodia sheen belibbam alehen kelum sheddin emet danu. veaf al pi sheen nohagin avelut hare hen onnim alehem sheen aninut ella ballev: 
Mi shennigmar dino uvarach uva levet din acher en sotrin et dino ella kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru meidin anu et ish peloni shennigmar dino bevet din peloni ufeloni ufeloni edav hare ze yehareg. bamme devarim amurim berotzeach. aval shear chayyave mitot ad sheyyavou edav harishonim veyaidu shennigmar dino veyaharguhu beyadam. vehu sheyyaidu bevet din shel esrim ushelosha: 
Mi shennigmar dino bevet din shehaya bechutza laaretz uvarach levet din shebbeeretz yisrael sotrin et dino al kol panim. veim hayu otan bet din atzman shennigmar dino bifnehem en sotrin et dino af al pi sheggemaruhu bechutza laaretz vehem atta beeretz yisrael:

Arba mitot nimsoru levet din. sekila userefa vahariga besayif vechenek. sekila userefa meforashin hen battora. umippi moshe rabbenu lamdu shekkol mita haamura battora setam hi chenek. vehahoreg et chavero mitato besayif. vechen anshe ir hanniddachat mitatan besayif:
Kol mita mehem mitzvat ase hi levet din laharog bah mi shennitchayyev bah. veen reshut lammelech laharog beachat mehen ella besayif bilvad:

Kol mechuyyav mitat bet din shello hemitu oto bet din bittelu mitzvat ase velo avru al mitzvat lo taase. chutz min hamechashshef sheim lo hemituhu avru al mitzvat lo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 17)</small> "mechashshefa lo techayye":

Sekila chamura min hasserefa userefa chamura min hassayif vehassayif chamura min hachenek. vechol mi shennitchayyev bishte mitot niddon bachamura ben sheavar shete averot zo achar zo ben sheavar avera achat shechayyav aleha shete mitot afillu nigmar dino lekalla veachar kach avar al hachamura venigmar dino niddon bachamura:
Veechad haish veechad haishsha danin otan bearba mitot:
Kol chayyave mitot shennitarvu ze baze niddon kol echad mehen bakkalla shebbahen:

Mi shennigmar dino shennitarev im shear haam velo noda mi hu meellu. o mi shello nigmar dino shennitarev im mi shennigmar dino velo noda mi hu. kullan peturin lefi sheen gomrin dino shel adam ella befanav:

Mi sheamad al nafsho velo yachlu bet din leasro ad sheyyemituhu bemita shehu chayyav bah horgin oto edav bechol mita sheyyecholin lahamito bah meachar shennigmar dino. veen reshut lishar haam lahamito techilla. lefichach im niktea yad haedim patur. veim hayu haedim giddemin mittechilla yehareg beyad acherim. bamme devarim amurim bishar mechuyyeve mitot bet din chutz min harotzeach. aval horeg nefesh shennigmar dino rodfin acharav bechol davar uveyad kol adam ad shemmemitin oto:

Kol haruge bet din en kovrin otan bekivre avotehem bichlal yisrael. ella shene kevarot metakkenin lahen bet din echad lanniskalin velannisrafin veechad lanneheragin velannechnakin. vedavar ze halacha mippi hashshemua. nitakkel habbasar hayu melakketin et haatzamot vekovrin otan bekivrot avotehen. veyesh likrovehen laasot lahen aron vetachrichin:

Tzerichin bet din lehityashshev bedine nefashot ulehamtin velo yaitzu. vechol bet din shehargu nefesh besheva shanim hare ellu chabbelanin. af al pi chen im era lahem laharog bechol yom veyom horgin. aval en danin leolam shenayim beyom echad ella danin ze hayyom vehashsheni lemachar. hayu shenehem baavera achat umita achat kegon noef im noefet danin shenehem beyom echad. lefichach im haya hannoef boel bat kohen hoil vehu bechenek vehi bisrefa en horgin shenehen beyom echad:

En danin dine nefashot ella bifne habbayit vehu sheyyihye bet din haggadol sham ballishka shebbammikdash shenneemar bezaken mamre <small>(Devarim 17 12)</small> "levilti shemoa el hakkohen" vegomer umippi hashshemua lamdu shebbizman sheyyesh kohen makriv al gabbe hammizbeach yesh dine nefashot vehu sheyyihye bet din haggadol bimkomo:

Battechilla keshennivna bet hammikdash hayu bet din haggadol yoshvin belishkat haggazit shehayta beezrat yisrael vehammakom shehayu yoshvin bo chol haya sheen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david. ucheshennitkalkela hashshura galu mimmakom lemakom velaasara mekomot galu vesofan litverya umishsham lo amad bet din gadol ad atta. vekabbala hi shebbitverya atidin lachzor techilla umishsham neetakin lammikdash:
Arbaim shana kodem churban bayit sheni batlu dine nefashot miyyisrael af al pi shehaya hammikdash kayyam. mippene sheggalu hassanhedrin velo hayu sham bimkoman bammikdash:
Bizman sheddanin dine nefashot beeretz yisrael danin dine nefashot bechutza laaretz. vehu sheyyihyu hassanhedrin semuchin baaretz kemo shebbearnu shehassanhedrin noheget baaretz uvechutza laaretz:

Ketzad mitzvat hanniskalin. rachok mibbet hassekila arba ammot mafshitin et hamechuyyav sekila begadav umechassin ervato millefanav. veen haishsha niskelet arumma ella bechaluk echad. uvet hassekila gavoah shete komot ole lesham hu veedav veyadav asurot. veechad min haedim dochafo al matnav meachorav vehu nehefach venofel al libbo laaretz. im met bah yatza shehare neemar <small>(Shemot 19 13)</small> "sakol yissakel o yaro yiyyare" hinne hishva hanniskal shennafal et haeven alav im hannidchaf shennafal hu beatzmo al haaretz. veim lo met middechifa zo magbihin haedim even shehayta munnachat sham massa shene bene adam vehaed hashsheni marpe et yado umashlich haeven al libbo. im met bo yatza veim lav regimato bechol yisrael shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 7)</small> "yad haedim tihye bo varishona lahamito veyad kol haam baacharona":

Oved avoda zara en soklin oto ella al shaar sheavad bo. veim hayta ir sherubbah akkum soklin oto al petach bet din. vedavar ze kabbala mippi hashshemua el shearecha ze shaar sheavad bo velo shennigmar dino bo:

Mitzvat hannisrafin hayu meshakkein oto bezevel ad arkubbotav venotnim sudar kashe letoch harach vechorech al tzavvaro. ushene edav ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo ad shehu poteach et piv. umattichim et habbedil veet haoferet vechayyotze bahen vehu zorek letoch piv vehi yoredet vesorefet et bene meav:
Mitzvat hanneheragin mattizin et rosho besayif kederech shehammelachim osim:
Mitzvat hannechnakin meshakkein et hamechuyyav bezevel ad arkubbotav venotnin sudar kashe letoch harach vechorchin al tzavvaro ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo ad shettetze nafsho:

Mitzvat ase litlot et hamegaddef veoved akkum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 23)</small> "ki killat elohim taluy" hare megaddef amur uveoved akkum neemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 30)</small> "et Adonai hu megaddef". vehaish nitle veen haishsha nitlet shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 22)</small> "ki yihye veish chet mishpat mavet vehumat vetalita oto":

Ketzad mitzvat hannitlin. achar shessoklin otan meshakkein et hakkora baaretz veetz yotze mimmenna umakkifin shete yadav zo lazo vetolehu samuch lishkiat hachamma umattirin oto miyyad. veim lan ovrin alav belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 23)</small> "lo talin nivlato al haetz":

Umitzvat ase likbor et kol haruge bet din beyom hahariga shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 23)</small> "ki kavor tikberennu bayyom hahu". velo haruge bet din bilvad ella kol hammelin et meto over alav belo taase. helino lichvodo lehavi lo aron vetachrichin eno over alav:

En tolin al ilan hamechubbar lakkarka ella al hattalush kede shello yehe mechussar ketzitza. shehaetz shennitla alav nikbar immo shello yehe lo zikkaron ra veyomru ze haetz shennitla alav peloni. vechen haeven shenniskal bah vehassayif shenneherag bo hanneherag vehassudarin shechonkin bahen hakkol nikbarin bitfisat hanneherag aval lo bakkever atzmo:

Kol hanniskalin shebbattora shemona asar veellu hen. habba al haem. veal eshet av. veal kallato. veal naara hameorasa. veal hazzachur. vehashshochev im behema. vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema aleha. vehamegaddef. veoved akkum. vehannoten mizzaro lammolech. uvaal ov. uvaal yiddeoni. vehammassit. vehammaddiach. vehamechashshef. vehamechallel et hashshabbat. umekallel aviv o immo. uven sorer umore:

Kol hannisrafin asara veellu hen. bat kohen shezzinneta tachat balah. uva al bitto. veal bat bitto. veal bat beno. veal bat ishto. veal bat bittah. veal bat benah. veal chamoto. veal em chamoto. veal em chamiv. vehu shebba alehen bechayye ishto. aval leachar mitat ishto hare hen becharet bilvad bichlal haarayot:
Hanneheragin shenayim. harotzeach vehanniddach:

Hannechnakin shishsha veellu hen. habba al eshet ish. hachovel beaviv o beimmo. vegonev nefesh miyyisrael. vezaken mamre. unevi hashsheker. vehammitnabbe beshem avoda zara. nimtzeu kol haruge bet din shishsha usheloshim:

Keshem shemmitzva lehamit et hamechuyyav mita kach mitzvat ase lehalekot et hamechuyyav malkot. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 2)</small> "vehippilo hashshofet vehikkahu lefanav". veaf al pi shemmalkot bishlosha bimkom mita hi omedet:
Malkin bazzeman hazze bechol makom min hattora bifne shelosha semuchin aval lo bifne hedyotot:
Vechol malkiyyot shemmalkin dayyane chutza laaretz bechol makom enah ella makkat mardut:

En adam loke ella beedim vehateraa uvodkin haedim bidrisha uvachakira kederech sheosim bedine nefashot. avar al lav shennittak laase vehitru bo veamru lo al taase davar ze sheim taasennu velo tekayyem ase shebbo tilke. veavar velo kiyyem haase hare ze loke. af al pi shehateraa besafek hi sheim yekayyem yippater hateraat safek hateraa hi:

Avar avera sheyyesh bah malkot umitat bet din keachat kegon sheshshachat oto veet beno laavoda zara. im hitru bo lemita soklin oto veeno loke shehare nitchayyev bedin gadol mizze. veim hitru bo lemalkot bilvad loke:

Eno tzarich shene edim lemalkot ella bishat maase aval haissur atzmo beed echad yuchzak. ketzad. amar ed echad chelev kelayot hu ze. kile hakkerem hem perot ellu. gerusha o zona ishsha zo. veachal o baal beedim achar shehitra bo. hare ze loke af al pi sheikkar haissur beed echad. bamme devarim amurim shello hichchish haed beet shekkava haissur. aval im amar eno chelev ze. vezo enah gerusha. veachal o baal achar shehichchish. eno loke ad sheyyikbeu haissur shene edim:
Shatak beet sheheid haed haechad bikviut haissur veachar sheavar vehitru bo taan lehachechish haed en shomin lo ella loke:

Ketzad malkin oto. kofet shete yadav al haammud elach veelach vechazzan hakkeneset ochez bivgadav. im nikreu nikreu veim nifremu nifremu. ad shehu megalle et libbo. sheeno makkehu al kesuto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 2)</small> "vehikkahu" velo lichsuto. vehaeven netuna meachorav shehachazzan hammakke omed aleha. uretzua shel egel beyado kefula lishnayim ushenayim learbaa. ushete retzuot shel chamor olot veyordot bo. verochav hartzua tefach vearkah kede shettehe maggaat ad pi kereso. veyad shel retzuot sheochez bah arkah tefach:

Haish hammakke tzarich lihyot yater bedea vechaser bechoach. umagbiah et hartzuot bishte yadav umakke beyado achat bechol kocho. umalkehu shelish millefanav [al chazehu] ben dadav ushene shelishim meachorav. shelish al katef ze ushelish al katef ze:

Hammukke eno omed velo yoshev ella mutte. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 2)</small> "vehippilo hashshofet vehikkahu lefanav" sheyyehu enav shel shofet bo lo sheyyihye mabbit bedavar acher umakkehu mikkan sheen makkim shenayim keechad:

Haggadol shebbaddayyanim kore kol zeman shezze loke <small>(Devarim 28 58)</small> "im lo tishmor laasot". <small>(Devarim 28 59)</small> "vehifla Adonai et makkotcha". umitkavven sheyyigmor happesukim im hammalkiyyot. veim lo gamar chozer litchillat hammikra vekore vechozer vekore ad shettiggamer kol hahakkaa. vehashsheni shebbaddayyanim mone vehashshelishi omer lachazzan hakke. kol zeman shemmakke al piv hu makke:

Met tachat yado patur. veim hosif retzua achat al haomed umet hare hachazzan gole. veim lo met hare hachazzan avar al mitzvat lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 3)</small> "lo yosif". vehu haddin lechol makke et chavero shehu belo taase. uma im ze shennatna tora reshut lehakkoto tzivva hakkatuv shello lehakkoto yater al risho kal vachomer lishar kol haadam. lefichach kol hammakke et chavero afillu hikka eved hakkaa sheen bah sheve peruta loke. aval im yesh bah sheve peruta hoil vehu chayyav leshallem mamon en adam meshallem veloke kemo shebbearnu bechamma mekomot:
